Awo Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa ne bamubuulira byonna ebyabatuukako mu kkubo; ne bwe baatuuka mu kifo ekyo, n’obuzibu bwe baayitamu.

Nsanyuse nnyo, bw’atyo Omubuulizi bwe yagamba, si lwa kuba nti musanze ebigezo, wabula olw’okuba nti muwangudde, era olw’okuba nti, newankubadde nga mulina obunafu bungi, mugenze mu maaso mu kkubo okutuusa leero.

Nzizzaamu nti, nsanyuse nnyo olw’ekyo, ku lwange era ne ku lwammwe: nze nasiga, mmwe ne mukungula; era olunaku lujja, “asiga n’akungula lwe balisanyukira wamu,” Yokaana 4:36; kwe kugamba, bwe munaagumiikiriza: “kubanga oluvannyuma mulikungula emikisa, bwe mutaggwaamu maanyi.” Abaggalatiya 6:9. Engule eri mu maaso gammwe, era nga teyonooneka; “muddukenga bwe mutyo nga mufubirira okuwangula ekirabo.” 1 Abakkolinso 9:24-27. Waliwo abamu abatandika okunoonya engule eno, ne bwe bamala okugitambulira ebbanga ddene, omulala n’ajja n’agibaggyako: kale “nnyweza ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo.” Okubikkulirwa 3:11. Temunnava wala okuva awatuuka emmundu ya Setaani; “temunnalwanagana na kibi okutuusa ne kukuyiwa omusaayi.” Obwakabaka bubeerenga bulijjo mu maaso gammwe, era mukkirize ebintu ebitalabika awatali kubuusabuusa. Tewabanga kintu kyonna ekya wano ku ludda luno olw’ensi endala ekiyingira munda mu mmwe. Era okusinga byonna, mwekuume nnyo emitima gyammwe n’okwegomba kwagyo; kubanga omutima “mulimba okusinga ebintu byonna, era gulwadde endwadde etawonyezeka.” Mukakanyaze amaaso gammwe ng’ejjinja; obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi buli ku ludda lwammwe.

Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’amwebaza olw’okubabuulirira kwe; naye n’amugamba nti baagala ayongere okwogera nabo okubayamba mu kkubo eribasigaddeko; na kino kubanga baali bamanyi bulungi nti yali nnabbi, era nti yali asobola okubabuulira ebintu ebiyinza okubatuukako, n’engeri gye bayinza okubiziyiza n’okubiwangula. Omwesigwa naye n’akkiriza okusaba okwo. Awo Omubuulizi n’atandika bw’ati.

Omubuulizi: Baana bange, muwulidde mu kigambo eky’amazima eky’Enjiri nti kibagwanidde “okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda nga muyita mu bibonoobono ebingi;” era nti “okusibibwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa bibalindiridde mu buli kibuga;” noolwekyo temuyinza kusuubira kutambula bbanga ddene mu lugendo lwammwe nga temubisanze, mu ngeri emu oba endala. Mumaze okulaba ku mazima g’obujulirwa buno, era ebirala bijja kuddirira amangu: kubanga kaakano, nga bwe mulaba, mumaze kumpi okuva mu ddungu lino, era mangu ddala mujja kutuuka mu kibuga kye munaatera okulaba mu maaso gammwe; era mu kibuga ekyo abalabe bajja kubazingiza nnyo, era bajja kufuba nnyo okubatta; era mukakase nti omu ku mmwe oba mwembi muteekwa okuteeka akabonero ku bujulirwa bwe mulina n’omusaayi; naye “mubeere beesigwa okutuusa okufa, era Kabaka alibawa engule ey’obulamu.” Oyo alifiira eyo, newankubadde ng’okufa kwe tekuliba kwa butonde, n’obulumi bwe oboolyawo nga bungi, aliba asinze munne; si lwa kuba nti alisooka okutuuka mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu kyokka, naye olw’okuba nti aliwona ennaku nnyingi munne z’alisanga mu lugendo lwe olusigaddeyo. Naye bwe mulituuka mu kibuga, ne musanga nga bye mbagambye bituukiridde, kale mujjukire mukwano gwammwe, mwebeeyise ng’abasajja, era “muwengayo obulamu bwammwe eri Katonda wammwe omwesigwa, nga mukola obulungi.”

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange, nti bwe baava mu ddungu, amangu ago ne balaba ekibuga mu maaso gaabwe, era erinnya ly’ekibuga ekyo ye Obutaliimu; era mu kibuga ekyo mulimu akatale, akayitibwa Akatale k’Obutaliimu. Kabaawo omwaka gwonna. Kayitibwa Akatale k’Obutaliimu kubanga ekibuga mwe kali kiweweevu okusinga obutaliimu, Zabbuli 62:9; era kubanga byonna ebitundibwayo, oba ebijjayo, butaliimu; ng’abagezi bwe boogera nti, “Ebyo byonna ebijja butaliimu.” Omubuulizi 11:8; laba ne 1:2-14; 2:11-17; Isaaya 40:17.

Akatale kano si kintu kyakatandikibwawo jjuuzi, wabula kya dda nnyo. Nja kubalaga entandikwa yaako.

Emyaka nga enkumi ttaano emabega, waaliwo abatambuze abaali batambula okugenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu, nga bano abantu ababiri ab’amazima bwe bali: era Beeruzebuli, Apolwoni ne Ligyoni, wamu ne bannaabwe, bwe baalaba okuva ku kkubo abatambuze lye baali bakuba nti ekkubo lyabwe erigenda mu Kibuga liyita mu kibuga kino eky’Obutaliimu, ne bateesa okussaawo akatale wano; akatale omunaatundibwanga buli ngeri ya butaliimu, era nga kabeerawo omwaka gwonna. Noolwekyo mu katale kano mutundibwamu ebyamaguzi ng’amayumba, ettaka, emirimu, ebifo, ebitiibwa, okukuzibwa, ebitiibwa by’amannya, ensi, obwakabaka, okwegomba, amasanyu; n’ebinyumu eby’engeri zonna, ng’abakazi abenzi, abakazi, abaami, abaana, abakama, abaddu, obulamu, omusaayi, emibiri, emmeeme, ffeeza, zaabu, luulu, amayinja ag’omuwendo, n’ebirala ebitabalika.

Era n’ekirala, mu katale kano buli kiseera mulabibwamu obufuusa, obukumpanya, emizannyo, ebivvulu, abasiru, enkima, abakuusa, n’abazigu, era ab’engeri zonna.

Era wano mulabibwa, ne bwe kitaba kya kusasula, obubbi, obutemu, obwenzi, abalayira eby’obulimba, era nga bya langi emmyufu ng’omusaayi.

Era, nga mu butale obulala obutali bukulu nnyo bwe mubaamu enkuubo n’enguudo ez’enjawulo ezirina amannya gaazo, ebyamaguzi ebimu we bitundirwa; bwe kityo ne wano, mulina ebifo byakwo, enkuubo, enguudo, (kwe kugamba ensi n’obwakabaka,) ebyamaguzi by’akatale kano we bisinga okusangibwa. Wano waliwo Oluguudo lwa Bungereza, Oluguudo lwa Bufalansa, Oluguudo lwa Yitale, Oluguudo lwa Sipeyini, Oluguudo lwa Bugirimaani, ebika by’obutaliimu eby’enjawulo we bitundirwa. Naye, nga mu butale obulala, ekyamaguzi kimu bwe kiba nga kye kisinga mu katale kyonna; bwe kityo ebyamaguzi bya Ruumi n’ebintu bye kitunda bisinga okutumbulwa mu katale kano; okuggyako eggwanga lyaffe Abangereza, wamu n’abalala abatonotono, abatabyagala.

Kaakano, nga bwe nnagambye, ekkubo erigenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu liyita wakati mu kibuga kino, omukolerwa akatale kano akajjudde okwegomba; era oyo ayagala okugenda mu Kibuga, naye nga tayagala kuyita mu kibuga kino, “kyandimugwanidde okuva mu nsi.” 1 Abakkolinso 4:10. Omulangira w’abalangira yennyini, bwe yali wano, yayita mu kibuga kino ng’agenda mu nsi ye, era ku lunaku olw’akatale; weewaawo, era, nga bwe ndowooza, Beeruzebuli, omukama omukulu ow’akatale kano, ye yamuyita okugula ku butaliimu bwe; weewaawo, yandimufudde mukama w’akatale, singa yamuvuunamira bwe yali ayita mu kibuga. Weewaawo, kubanga yali muntu wa kitiibwa bwe kityo, Beeruzebuli n’amutwala okuva mu luguudo okudda mu luguudo, n’amulaga obwakabaka bwonna obw’omu nsi mu kaseera katono, alyoke, bwe kiba kisoboka, asendesende Omutendereze oyo okulamuza n’okugula ku butaliimu bwe; naye teyafaayo ku byamaguzi, kyeyava ava mu kibuga, nga tasaasaanyizza wadde ssente emu ku butaliimu obwo. Matayo 4:8,9; Lukka 4:5-7. Noolwekyo akatale kano kya dda, kaabaawo okuva edda ennyo, era katale kanene nnyo.

Kaakano abatambuze bano, nga bwe nnagambye, kyali kibagwanidde okuyita mu katale kano. Kale ne bakola bwe batyo; naye laba, olwali okuyingira mu katale, abantu bonna mu katale ne basasamala; n’ekibuga kyennyini ne kiba ng’ekiri mu kasasamalo ku lwabwe, era olw’ensonga eziwerako: kubanga,

Ekisooka, Abatambuze baali bambadde engoye ez’enjawulo ku ngoye z’abo bonna abaali basuubulira mu katale ako. Abantu ab’omu katale kyebaava babeekaliriza nnyo: abamu ne bagamba nti basirusiru; 1 Abakkolinso 4:9,10; abalala nti balalu; n’abalala nti bagwira.

Ekyokubiri, Era nga bwe beewuunya engoye zaabwe, bwe batyo bwe beewuunya n’enjogera yaabwe; kubanga batono abaategeera bye baali boogera. Baali boogera mu butonde olulimi lwa Kanani; naye abaali bakuuma akatale baali bantu ba nsi eno: bwe kityo okuva ku nkomerero y’akatale emu okutuuka ku ndala, baali balabika ng’abannaggwanga eri bannaabwe. 1 Abakkolinso 2:7,8.

Ekyokusatu, Naye ekyo ekyewuunyisa ennyo abasuubuzi kye kino, nti abatambuze bano tebaafaayo n’akamu ku byamaguzi byabwe byonna. Tebaali na kwagala wadde okubitunuulira; era bwe baabayitanga okugula, baaziyizanga amatu gaabwe n’engalo zaabwe, ne bakaaba nti, “Kyusa amaaso gange galeme okunneegombesa ebitaliimu,” Zabbuli 119:37, ne batunula waggulu, nga balaga nti obusuubuzi bwabwe n’emirimu gyabwe biri mu ggulu. Abafiripi 3: 20,21.

Awo omu, ng’abasekerera, bwe yalaba enneeyisa y’abasajja abo, n’abagamba nti, “Mugula ki?” Naye bo ne bamutunuulira n’obukkakkamu, ne bagamba nti, “Tugula amazima.” Engero 23:23. Ekyo ne kibaviirako okunyoomebwa n’okusingawo; abamu nga babasekerera, abamu nga babaduulira, abamu nga babavuma, era abamu nga bakoowoola abalala babakube. Ku nkomerero, ne wabaawo oluyoogaano n’akasasamalo kanene mu katale, n’entegeka yonna n’etabuka. Amangu ago ne batuusa ebigambo ku mukulu w’akatale, n’ajja mangu, n’alonda mikwano gye abasinga okwesigika okukwata abasajja abo okubabuuliriza, abaali basse akatale kumpi okukyuusibwa. Awo abasajja ne baleetebwa okubuulirizibwa; era abaali babasalira ne babuuza gye baava, gye baali bagenda, ne kye baali bakola eyo nga bambadde engoye ez’engeri eyo eteri ya bulijjo. Abasajja ne babagamba nti baali bagenyi era abatambuze mu nsi, era nti baali bagenda mu nsi yaabwe, ye Yerusaalemi ey’omu ggulu, Abaebbulaniya 11:13-16; era nti tebaali bawadde nsonga yonna eri abantu b’ekibuga, wadde eri abasuubuzi, ebaleetera okubayisa obubi bwe batyo, n’okubaziyiza mu lugendo lwabwe, okuggyako olw’okuba nti omu bwe yababuuza kye bagula, baagamba nti bagula amazima. Naye abaali balondeddwa okubabuuliriza tebaakkiriza nti baali bantu balala okuggyako abalalu abafudde eddalu, oba abazze okutabulatabula ebintu byonna mu katale. Kyebaava babakwata ne babakuba, ne babasiiga ettosi, ne babateeka mu kayumba k’ebyuma, balyoke babeere ekyerolerwa eri abantu bonna ab’omu katale. Eyo ne bamalayo ekiseera, ne bafuuka eky’okusanyusa buli muntu, oba okumalako ettima lye, oba okwesasuza; omukulu w’akatale ng’ayongera okusekerera byonna ebyabatuukako. Naye abasajja abo nga bagumiikiriza, era “nga tebavumanga abavumye, wabula nga babasabira omukisa,” nga bawa ebigambo ebirungi mu kifo ky’ebibi, n’ekisa mu kifo ky’obulabe bwe baakolebwa, abamu ku bantu b’omu katale, abaali basinga abalala okwetegereza era abatalina kyekubiira kingi, ne batandika okunenya n’okukangavvula ab’ekika ekya wansi olw’okuyisa obubi abasajja abo buli kiseera. Abo ne babasunguwalira nnyo, ne babalumba, nga babatwala okuba ababi ng’abasajja abali mu kayumba, era nga babagamba nti balabika nga bakolagana nabo, era nti bajja kugabana nabo ku nnaku zaabwe. Abalala ne baddamu nti, ku ebyo bye baali balaba, abasajja abo baali bakkakkamu era beegendereza, nga tebaagala kukola muntu yenna kabi; era nti waaliwo bangi abaasuubuliranga mu katale kaabwe abaali basaanira okuteekebwa mu kayumba, weewaawo, n’okusibibwa mu nkondo, okusinga abasajja be baali bayisizza obubi. Bwe batyo, nga bamaze okwogera ebigambo bingi ku njuyi zombi, (abasajja abo bbo nga beeyisa n’amagezi n’obukkakkamu mu maaso gaabwe ekiseera kyonna,) ne batandika okukubagana bokka na bokka, ne balumyagana. Awo abasajja bano ababiri abaavu ne baleetebwa nate mu maaso g’ababuuliriza baabwe, ne bavunaanibwa omusango ogw’oluyoogaano olwali lwakabaawo mu katale. Kyebaava babakuba ekisaasizza, ne babateekako ebyuma, ne babatambuliza mu njegere okwetooloola akatale, okubeera eky’okulabirako n’entiisa eri abalala, waleme kubaawo abayimirira ku lwabwe oba abeegatta nabo. Naye Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa ne beeyisa n’amagezi n’okusingawo, ne bagumira ekivume n’ensonyi ebyabateekebwako n’obuwombeefu n’obugumiikiriza bungi, ne kisikiriza ku ludda lwabwe (newankubadde nga batono bw’ogeraageranya n’abalala) abasajja abawerako mu katale. Kino ne kyongera okusunguwaza nnyo ab’oludda olulala, ne basalawo okutta abasajja bano bombi. Kyebaava babakanga nti akayumba wadde ebyuma tebijja kumala, wabula nti bateekwa kufa olw’ekivume kye baakola, n’olw’okulimbalimba abantu b’akatale.

Awo ne bazzibwayo mu kayumba, okutuusa nga kulagiddwa ekirala ku bo. Ne babayingizaamu, ne basiba ebigere byabwe mu nvuba.

Era wano ne bajjukira nate bye baawulira okuva eri mukwano gwabwe omwesigwa Omubuulizi, ne beeyongera okunywezebwa mu kkubo lyabwe ne mu kubonaabona kwabwe olw’ebyo bye yabagamba nti bijja kubatuukako. Era kaakano ne bazzaamu buli omu munne amaanyi, nti oyo eyandigwiriddwa okubonaabona, ye yandifunye ekisinga obulungi: kyeyava buli omu yeegomba mu kyama ye afune ekitiibwa ekyo. Naye nga beewaayo eri entegeka ey’amagezi gonna ey’Oyo afuga ebintu byonna, ne babeera n’obumativu bungi mu mbeera gye baalimu, okutuusa lwe bandisaliddwawo ekirala.

Awo olunaku bwe lwateekebwawo, ne babafulumya okuwozesebwa, basalirwe omusango. Ekiseera bwe kyatuuka, ne baleetebwa mu maaso g’abalabe baabwe ne bavunaanibwa. Erinnya ly’omulamuzi lyali Omwami Akyawa-Obulungi; omusango gwabwe gwali gumu mu makulu, newankubadde nga gwawukanamu katono mu bigambo; era bwe gwali bwe guti: “Nti baali balabe era abataataaganya obusuubuzi; nti baaleeta okusasamala n’enjawukana mu kibuga, era baali bawangudde ekibinja ku ndowooza zaabwe ezisinga obubi, nga banyooma etteeka ly’omulangira waabwe.”

Awo Omwesigwa n’atandika okuddamu nti yali alwanyisa bulwanyisa ekyo ekyali kirwanyisa Oyo asinga abasinga bonna obukulu. Era, bw’atyo bwe yagamba, ku by’okutaataaganya, sirina kye ntaataaganya, kubanga ndi muntu wa mirembe: abo abaasikirizibwa ku ludda lwaffe baasikirizibwa olw’okulaba amazima gaffe n’obutaliiko musango bwaffe, era bakyusiddwa bukyusibwa okuva mu bubi okudda mu bulungi. Ate ku kabaka gwe mwogerako, olw’okuba nga ye Beeruzebuli, omulabe wa Mukama waffe, mmunyooma ye ne bamalayika be bonna.

Awo ne balangirira nti abo abalina kye boogera ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka nga bawawaabira omusibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga, bajje amangu ago bawe obujulirwa bwabwe. Awo ne wajja abajulirwa basatu, kwe kugamba: Obuggya, Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, ne Anoonya-Ttendo. Ne bababuuza oba nga bamanyi omusibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga; era kiki kye balina okumwogerako ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka.

Awo Obuggya n’ayimirira, n’ayogera bw’ati: Ssebo, omusajja ono mmumanyi ebbanga ddene, era nja kukakasa nga ndayidde mu maaso g’embuga eno ey’ekitiibwa, nti ye-

Omulamuzi: Linda; sooka mumulayize.

Awo ne bamulayiza. N’alyoka agamba nti, Ssebo, omusajja ono, newankubadde ng’erinnya lye liwulikika bulungi, y’omu ku basajja abasinga obubi mu nsi yaffe; tafaayo ku mulangira wadde ku bantu, ku mateeka wadde ku mpisa, wabula akola kyonna ky’asobola okujjuza abantu bonna endowooza ze ezimu ez’obujeemu, z’ayita okutwalira awamu emisingi gy’okukkiriza n’obutukuvu. Era mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, nze kennyini namuwulira omulundi gumu ng’agamba nti Obukristaayo n’empisa z’ekibuga kyaffe eky’Obutaliimu bikontana ddala, era tebiyinza kutabagana. Mu kwogera ekyo, ssebo, tasalira musango bikolwa byaffe byonna ebisiimibwa kyokka, naye naffe abakola ebikolwa ebyo.

Awo omulamuzi n’amugamba nti, Olina ekirala ky’oyogera?

Obuggya: Ssebo, nnyinza okwogera bingi nnyo, naye saagala kukooya kkooti. Naye bwe kinaaba kyetaagisa, abaami abalala bwe banaamala okuwa obujulirwa bwabwe, mu kifo ky’okubulwa ekintu kyonna ekinaamumalawo, nja kwongera ku bujulirwa bwange ku ye. Awo ne bamugamba ayimirire ebbali.

Awo ne bayita Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, ne bamugamba atunuulire omusibe. Era ne bamubuuza ky’ayinza okumwogerako ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka. Awo ne bamulayiza; n’atandika.

Enzikiriza-Enkyamu: Ssebo, omusajja ono simumanyi nnyo, era saagala kwongera kumumanya. Naye kino nkimanyi, nti musajja wa kabi nnyo, olw’emboozi gye nnali naye ennaku zino, mu kibuga kino; kubanga olwo, bwe nnali njogera naye, namuwulira ng’agamba nti eddiini yaffe teriimu nsa, era nga si ya ngeri omuntu gy’ayinza okusanyusiza Katonda. Ebigambo bye ebyo, ssebo, omanyi bulungi ekiteekwa okuvaamu, kwe kugamba, nti tukyasinza bwereere, tukyali mu bibi byaffe, era ku nkomerero tulisalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira: era kino kye nnina okwogera.

Awo Anoonya-Ttendo n’alayizibwa, ne bamugamba ayogere ky’amanyi ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka ku musibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga.

Anoonya-Ttendo: Ssebo, nammwe abaami mwenna, omusajja ono mmumanyi okuva edda, era mmuwulidde ng’ayogera ebintu ebitasaanidde kwogerwa; kubanga avvodde omulangira waffe ow’ekitiibwa Beeruzebuli, era ayogedde eby’okunyooma ku mikwano gye egy’ekitiibwa, amannya gaabwe nga ge gano: Omwami Omuntu-ow’Edda, Omwami Essanyu-ly’Omubiri, Omwami Ow’ebinyumu, Omwami Ayagala-Ekitiibwa-eky’Obwereere, Omwami Obukaba omukadde, Ssebo Omululu, wamu n’abakungu baffe abalala bonna: era ate yagamba nti, singa abantu bonna baali ba ndowooza ye, bwe kiba kisoboka, tewandibaddewo n’omu ku bakungu bano asigala mu kibuga kino. Ekirala, tatidde kukuvuma ggwe, ssebo, kaakano alondeddwa okumusalira omusango, ng’akuyita omubi atatya Katonda, n’ebigambo ebirala bingi eby’okuvuma ng’ebyo, by’asiize abakungu b’ekibuga kyaffe abasinga obungi.

Anoonya-Ttendo bwe yamala okwogera ebibye, omulamuzi n’akyukira omusibe, n’agamba nti, Ggwe omudduse, omukyamu mu nzikiriza, era omulyamaanyi, owulidde abaami bano abeesimbu bye bakulumirizza?

Omwesigwa: Nzikirizibwa okwogera ebigambo bitono okwewozaako?

Omulamuzi: Ggwe, ggwe, osaanidde obutaddayo kuba mulamu, wabula okuttibwa amangu ago wano wennyini; naye, abantu bonna balyoke balabe obukkakkamu bwaffe gy’oli, ka tuwulire ky’olina okwogera, ggwe omudduse omubi.

Omwesigwa: 1. Kale ngamba, okuddamu Omwami Obuggya bye yayogedde, sigambangako kirala okuggyako kino, nti buli kiragiro, oba mateeka, oba mpisa, oba bantu, ebikontana ddala n’ekigambo kya Katonda, bikontana ddala n’Obukristaayo. Bwe mba nga nsobezza mu kino, mundage ensobi yange, era ndi mwetegefu wano mu maaso gammwe okwejjulula.

2. Ku ky’okubiri, kwe kugamba Omwami Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, n’ekyo ky’ampaabira, nagamba kino kyokka, nti mu kusinza Katonda kyetaagisa okukkiriza okuva eri Katonda; naye tewayinza kubaawo kukkiriza okuva eri Katonda awatali kubikkulirwa okuva eri Katonda okw’okwagala kwe. Noolwekyo, kyonna ekiyingizibwa mu kusinza Katonda ekitakwatagana na kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, tekiyinza kukolebwa okuggyako olw’okukkiriza kw’omuntu; era okukkiriza okwo tekugasa ku bulamu obutaggwaawo.

3. Ku ebyo Omwami Anoonya-Ttendo by’ayogedde, ngamba, (nga nneewala ebigambo, ng’okugamba nti nvuma, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo,) nti omulangira w’ekibuga kino, wamu n’ekibinja kyonna eky’abakopi abamuweereza, omwami ono b’ayogeddeko, basaanira okubeera mu ggeyeena okusinga mu kibuga kino n’ensi eno. Kale Mukama ansaasire.

Awo omulamuzi n’ayita abasazi b’omusango, (abaali bayimiridde awo ekiseera kyonna nga bawulira era nga beetegereza,) Abaami abasazi b’omusango, mulaba omusajja ono eyaleese oluyoogaano olunene bwe lutyo mu kibuga kino; era muwulidde abaami bano ab’ekitiibwa bye bamulumirizza; era muwulidde n’okuddamu kwe n’okwatula kwe: kaakano kiri mu mitima gyammwe okumuwanika oba okuwonya obulamu bwe; naye ndaba nga kisaanidde mbayigirize ku tteeka lyaffe.

Waaliwo etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Falaawo Omukulu, omuweereza w’omulangira waffe, nti, abo ab’eddiini ekontana naye baleme okweyongera obungi n’okumusinza amaanyi, abaana baabwe ab’obulenzi basuulibwenga mu mugga. Okuva 1:22. Waaliwo n’etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Nebukadduneeza Omukulu, omuweereza we omulala, nti buli atalivuunama n’asinza ekifaananyi kye ekya zaabu, alisuulibwa mu kikoomi ekyaka omuliro. Danyeri 3:6. Waaliwo n’etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Daliyo, nti buli anaasabanga katonda omulala yenna okumala ekiseera, okuggyako ye, asuulibwe mu mpuku y’empologoma. Danyeri 6:7. Kaakano, omujeemu ono amenye ensa y’amateeka gano, si mu birowoozo byokka (ekitagumiikirizika), naye ne mu bigambo ne mu bikolwa; kale tekiyinza kugumiikirizibwa n’akatono.

Ku by’etteeka lya Falaawo, lyateekebwawo nga balowooza okuziyiza akabi, nga tewannabaawo musango gulabika; naye wano omusango gulabika. Ku ery’okubiri n’ery’okusatu, mulaba nga awakanya eddiini yaffe; era olw’obulyamaanyi bw’amaze okwatula, asaanidde okufa.

Awo abasazi b’omusango ne bafuluma, amannya gaabwe nga ge gano: Omwami Omuzibe-w’amaaso, Omwami Atalina-bulungi, Omwami Ettima, Omwami Ayagala-Obukaba, Omwami Omwononefu, Omwami Omukalabakalaba, Omwami Ow’amalala, Omwami Obukyayi, Omwami Omulimba, Omwami Obukambwe, Omwami Akyawa-Ekitangaala, n’Omwami Atakkaanyizibwa; buli omu ku bo n’asalawo mu kyama nga bali bokka nti yasobya, oluvannyuma bonna ne bakkiriziganya okumusingisa omusango mu maaso g’omulamuzi. Era okusooka nga bali bokka, Omwami Omuzibe-w’amaaso, omukulu waabwe, n’agamba nti, Ndaba bulungi nti omusajja ono mukyamu mu nzikiriza. Awo Omwami Atalina-bulungi n’agamba nti, Omuntu ow’engeri eyo mumuggye ku nsi. Weewaawo, bw’atyo Omwami Ettima bwe yagamba, kubanga nkyawa n’endabika ye yennyini. Awo Omwami Ayagala-Obukaba n’agamba nti, Saayinza kumugumiikiriza n’akatono. Nange, bw’atyo Omwami Omwononefu bwe yagamba, kubanga yandibadde buli kiseera ng’anenya engeri yange. Mumuwanike, mumuwanike, bw’atyo Omwami Omukalabakalaba bwe yagamba. Kasajja ka bwereere, bw’atyo Omwami Ow’amalala bwe yagamba. Omutima gwange gumukyaye, bw’atyo Omwami Obukyayi bwe yagamba. Mufere, bw’atyo Omwami Omulimba bwe yagamba. Okuwanikibwa kwandibadde kisa kingi gy’ali, bw’atyo Omwami Obukambwe bwe yagamba. Ka tumuggye mu kkubo, bw’atyo Omwami Akyawa-Ekitangaala bwe yagamba. Awo Omwami Atakkaanyizibwa n’agamba nti, Ne bwe nnandiweereddwa ensi yonna, sandisobodde kutabagana naye; kale ka tumusingise amangu ago omusango ogw’okufa.

Era bwe batyo bwe baakola; kyeyava asalirwa omusango amangu ago aggyibwe mu kifo we yali, atwalibwe mu kifo gye yava, era eyo attibwe okufa okusinga obukambwe okwandiyinzizza okuyiiyizibwa.

Kale ne bamufulumya, okumukola nga etteeka lyabwe bwe liragira; era okusooka ne bamukuba embooko, ne bamukuba ebikonde, ne bamusala omubiri gwe n’ebiso; oluvannyuma ne bamukuba amayinja, ne bamufumita n’ebitala byabwe; era ku nkomerero ne bamwokya ku muti n’afuuka evvu. Bw’atyo Omwesigwa bwe yatuuka ku nkomerero ye.

Awo ne ndaba nga emabega w’ekibiina wayimiridde eggaali n’embalaasi bbiri nga zirindiridde Omwesigwa, eyatwalibwa n’agiyingizibwamu (abalabe be olwamala okumutta), amangu ago n’atwalibwa waggulu ng’ayita mu bire n’eddoboozi ly’ekkondeere, mu kkubo erisinga okumpi okutuuka ku Mulyango gw’Eggulu. Naye Omukristaayo ye, n’afuna akaseera ak’okuwummulako, n’azzibwayo mu kkomera: n’abeerayo okumala ebbanga. Naye Oyo afuga ebintu byonna, ng’alina amaanyi g’obusungu bwabwe mu mukono gwe, n’akyusa ebintu bwe bityo, Omukristaayo n’abawona mu kiseera ekyo, n’agenda ekkubo lye.

Era bwe yali agenda, n’ayimba, ng’agamba nti,

“Kale, Omwesigwa, oyatudde n’obwesigwa

Mukama wo, gw’olibeera naye mu mukisa,

Ng’abatakkiriza, n’amasanyu gaabwe ag’obwereere gonna,

Bakaaba nga bali mu nnaku zaabwe ez’omu ggeyeena:

Yimba, Omwesigwa, yimba, erinnya lyo libeerewo;

Kubanga newankubadde baakutta, okyali mulamu.”
fields.body_text: Awo bwe baali banaatera okuva ddala mu ddungu eryo, Omwesigwa n’akyuka okutunula emabega, n’alengera omuntu ng’abagoberera, era n’amutegeera. Ai! Omwesigwa bw’atyo bwe yagamba muganda we, oyo ajja eri ani? Awo Omukristaayo n’atunula, n’agamba nti, Ye mukwano gwange omulungi Omubuulizi. Weewaawo, era ye mukwano gwange omulungi nange, bw’atyo Omwesigwa bwe yagamba, kubanga ‘ye yanteeka ku kkubo erigenda ku mulyango. Awo Omubuulizi n’abatuukako, n’abalamusa bw’ati. Omubuulizi: Emirembe gibe nammwe, abaagalwa ennyo, n’emirembe gibe n’abo ababayamba. Omukristaayo: Tukwaniriza, tukwaniriza, Omubuulizi wange omulungi: okulaba amaaso go kunzijukiza ekisa kyo eky’edda n’okufuba kwo okutakoowa olw’obulungi bwange obutaggwaawo. Omwesigwa: Era tukwaniriza emirundi lukumi, bw’atyo Omwesigwa omulungi bwe yagamba, ggwe Omubuulizi omwagalwa; nga kitwagaza nnyo okubeera naawe, ffe abatambuze abaavu! Omubuulizi: Awo Omubuulizi n’agamba nti, Mikwano gyange, mubadde mutya okuva lwe twasemba okwawukana? Kiki kye musanze, era mweyisizza mutya? Awo Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa ne bamubuulira byonna ebyabatuukako mu kkubo; ne bwe baatuuka mu kifo ekyo, n’obuzibu bwe baayitamu. Nsanyuse nnyo, bw’atyo Omubuulizi bwe yagamba, si lwa kuba nti musanze ebigezo, wabula olw’okuba nti muwangudde, era olw’okuba nti, newankubadde nga mulina obunafu bungi, mugenze mu maaso mu kkubo okutuusa leero. Nzizzaamu nti, nsanyuse nnyo olw’ekyo, ku lwange era ne ku lwammwe: nze nasiga, mmwe ne mukungula; era olunaku lujja, “asiga n’akungula lwe balisanyukira wamu,” Yokaana 4:36; kwe kugamba, bwe munaagumiikiriza: “kubanga oluvannyuma mulikungula emikisa, bwe mutaggwaamu maanyi.” Abaggalatiya 6:9. Engule eri mu maaso gammwe, era nga teyonooneka; “muddukenga bwe mutyo nga mufubirira okuwangula ekirabo.” 1 Abakkolinso 9:24-27. Waliwo abamu abatandika okunoonya engule eno, ne bwe bamala okugitambulira ebbanga ddene, omulala n’ajja n’agibaggyako: kale “nnyweza ky’olina waleme kubaawo akutwalako ngule yo.” Okubikkulirwa 3:11. Temunnava wala okuva awatuuka emmundu ya Setaani; “temunnalwanagana na kibi okutuusa ne kukuyiwa omusaayi.” Obwakabaka bubeerenga bulijjo mu maaso gammwe, era mukkirize ebintu ebitalabika awatali kubuusabuusa. Tewabanga kintu kyonna ekya wano ku ludda luno olw’ensi endala ekiyingira munda mu mmwe. Era okusinga byonna, mwekuume nnyo emitima gyammwe n’okwegomba kwagyo; kubanga omutima “mulimba okusinga ebintu byonna, era gulwadde endwadde etawonyezeka.” Mukakanyaze amaaso gammwe ng’ejjinja; obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi buli ku ludda lwammwe. Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’amwebaza olw’okubabuulirira kwe; naye n’amugamba nti baagala ayongere okwogera nabo okubayamba mu kkubo eribasigaddeko; na kino kubanga baali bamanyi bulungi nti yali nnabbi, era nti yali asobola okubabuulira ebintu ebiyinza okubatuukako, n’engeri gye bayinza okubiziyiza n’okubiwangula. Omwesigwa naye n’akkiriza okusaba okwo. Awo Omubuulizi n’atandika bw’ati. Omubuulizi: Baana bange, muwulidde mu kigambo eky’amazima eky’Enjiri nti kibagwanidde “okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda nga muyita mu bibonoobono ebingi;” era nti “okusibibwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa bibalindiridde mu buli kibuga;” noolwekyo temuyinza kusuubira kutambula bbanga ddene mu lugendo lwammwe nga temubisanze, mu ngeri emu oba endala. Mumaze okulaba ku mazima g’obujulirwa buno, era ebirala bijja kuddirira amangu: kubanga kaakano, nga bwe mulaba, mumaze kumpi okuva mu ddungu lino, era mangu ddala mujja kutuuka mu kibuga kye munaatera okulaba mu maaso gammwe; era mu kibuga ekyo abalabe bajja kubazingiza nnyo, era bajja kufuba nnyo okubatta; era mukakase nti omu ku mmwe oba mwembi muteekwa okuteeka akabonero ku bujulirwa bwe mulina n’omusaayi; naye “mubeere beesigwa okutuusa okufa, era Kabaka alibawa engule ey’obulamu.” Oyo alifiira eyo, newankubadde ng’okufa kwe tekuliba kwa butonde, n’obulumi bwe oboolyawo nga bungi, aliba asinze munne; si lwa kuba nti alisooka okutuuka mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu kyokka, naye olw’okuba nti aliwona ennaku nnyingi munne z’alisanga mu lugendo lwe olusigaddeyo. Naye bwe mulituuka mu kibuga, ne musanga nga bye mbagambye bituukiridde, kale mujjukire mukwano gwammwe, mwebeeyise ng’abasajja, era “muwengayo obulamu bwammwe eri Katonda wammwe omwesigwa, nga mukola obulungi.” Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange, nti bwe baava mu ddungu, amangu ago ne balaba ekibuga mu maaso gaabwe, era erinnya ly’ekibuga ekyo ye Obutaliimu; era mu kibuga ekyo mulimu akatale, akayitibwa Akatale k’Obutaliimu. Kabaawo omwaka gwonna. Kayitibwa Akatale k’Obutaliimu kubanga ekibuga mwe kali kiweweevu okusinga obutaliimu, Zabbuli 62:9; era kubanga byonna ebitundibwayo, oba ebijjayo, butaliimu; ng’abagezi bwe boogera nti, “Ebyo byonna ebijja butaliimu.” Omubuulizi 11:8; laba ne 1:2-14; 2:11-17; Isaaya 40:17. Akatale kano si kintu kyakatandikibwawo jjuuzi, wabula kya dda nnyo. Nja kubalaga entandikwa yaako. Emyaka nga enkumi ttaano emabega, waaliwo abatambuze abaali batambula okugenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu, nga bano abantu ababiri ab’amazima bwe bali: era Beeruzebuli, Apolwoni ne Ligyoni, wamu ne bannaabwe, bwe baalaba okuva ku kkubo abatambuze lye baali bakuba nti ekkubo lyabwe erigenda mu Kibuga liyita mu kibuga kino eky’Obutaliimu, ne bateesa okussaawo akatale wano; akatale omunaatundibwanga buli ngeri ya butaliimu, era nga kabeerawo omwaka gwonna. Noolwekyo mu katale kano mutundibwamu ebyamaguzi ng’amayumba, ettaka, emirimu, ebifo, ebitiibwa, okukuzibwa, ebitiibwa by’amannya, ensi, obwakabaka, okwegomba, amasanyu; n’ebinyumu eby’engeri zonna, ng’abakazi abenzi, abakazi, abaami, abaana, abakama, abaddu, obulamu, omusaayi, emibiri, emmeeme, ffeeza, zaabu, luulu, amayinja ag’omuwendo, n’ebirala ebitabalika. Era n’ekirala, mu katale kano buli kiseera mulabibwamu obufuusa, obukumpanya, emizannyo, ebivvulu, abasiru, enkima, abakuusa, n’abazigu, era ab’engeri zonna. Era wano mulabibwa, ne bwe kitaba kya kusasula, obubbi, obutemu, obwenzi, abalayira eby’obulimba, era nga bya langi emmyufu ng’omusaayi. Era, nga mu butale obulala obutali bukulu nnyo bwe mubaamu enkuubo n’enguudo ez’enjawulo ezirina amannya gaazo, ebyamaguzi ebimu we bitundirwa; bwe kityo ne wano, mulina ebifo byakwo, enkuubo, enguudo, (kwe kugamba ensi n’obwakabaka,) ebyamaguzi by’akatale kano we bisinga okusangibwa. Wano waliwo Oluguudo lwa Bungereza, Oluguudo lwa Bufalansa, Oluguudo lwa Yitale, Oluguudo lwa Sipeyini, Oluguudo lwa Bugirimaani, ebika by’obutaliimu eby’enjawulo we bitundirwa. Naye, nga mu butale obulala, ekyamaguzi kimu bwe kiba nga kye kisinga mu katale kyonna; bwe kityo ebyamaguzi bya Ruumi n’ebintu bye kitunda bisinga okutumbulwa mu katale kano; okuggyako eggwanga lyaffe Abangereza, wamu n’abalala abatonotono, abatabyagala. Kaakano, nga bwe nnagambye, ekkubo erigenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu liyita wakati mu kibuga kino, omukolerwa akatale kano akajjudde okwegomba; era oyo ayagala okugenda mu Kibuga, naye nga tayagala kuyita mu kibuga kino, “kyandimugwanidde okuva mu nsi.” 1 Abakkolinso 4:10. Omulangira w’abalangira yennyini, bwe yali wano, yayita mu kibuga kino ng’agenda mu nsi ye, era ku lunaku olw’akatale; weewaawo, era, nga bwe ndowooza, Beeruzebuli, omukama omukulu ow’akatale kano, ye yamuyita okugula ku butaliimu bwe; weewaawo, yandimufudde mukama w’akatale, singa yamuvuunamira bwe yali ayita mu kibuga. Weewaawo, kubanga yali muntu wa kitiibwa bwe kityo, Beeruzebuli n’amutwala okuva mu luguudo okudda mu luguudo, n’amulaga obwakabaka bwonna obw’omu nsi mu kaseera katono, alyoke, bwe kiba kisoboka, asendesende Omutendereze oyo okulamuza n’okugula ku butaliimu bwe; naye teyafaayo ku byamaguzi, kyeyava ava mu kibuga, nga tasaasaanyizza wadde ssente emu ku butaliimu obwo. Matayo 4:8,9; Lukka 4:5-7. Noolwekyo akatale kano kya dda, kaabaawo okuva edda ennyo, era katale kanene nnyo. Kaakano abatambuze bano, nga bwe nnagambye, kyali kibagwanidde okuyita mu katale kano. Kale ne bakola bwe batyo; naye laba, olwali okuyingira mu katale, abantu bonna mu katale ne basasamala; n’ekibuga kyennyini ne kiba ng’ekiri mu kasasamalo ku lwabwe, era olw’ensonga eziwerako: kubanga, Ekisooka, Abatambuze baali bambadde engoye ez’enjawulo ku ngoye z’abo bonna abaali basuubulira mu katale ako. Abantu ab’omu katale kyebaava babeekaliriza nnyo: abamu ne bagamba nti basirusiru; 1 Abakkolinso 4:9,10; abalala nti balalu; n’abalala nti bagwira. Ekyokubiri, Era nga bwe beewuunya engoye zaabwe, bwe batyo bwe beewuunya n’enjogera yaabwe; kubanga batono abaategeera bye baali boogera. Baali boogera mu butonde olulimi lwa Kanani; naye abaali bakuuma akatale baali bantu ba nsi eno: bwe kityo okuva ku nkomerero y’akatale emu okutuuka ku ndala, baali balabika ng’abannaggwanga eri bannaabwe. 1 Abakkolinso 2:7,8. Ekyokusatu, Naye ekyo ekyewuunyisa ennyo abasuubuzi kye kino, nti abatambuze bano tebaafaayo n’akamu ku byamaguzi byabwe byonna. Tebaali na kwagala wadde okubitunuulira; era bwe baabayitanga okugula, baaziyizanga amatu gaabwe n’engalo zaabwe, ne bakaaba nti, “Kyusa amaaso gange galeme okunneegombesa ebitaliimu,” Zabbuli 119:37, ne batunula waggulu, nga balaga nti obusuubuzi bwabwe n’emirimu gyabwe biri mu ggulu. Abafiripi 3: 20,21. Awo omu, ng’abasekerera, bwe yalaba enneeyisa y’abasajja abo, n’abagamba nti, “Mugula ki?” Naye bo ne bamutunuulira n’obukkakkamu, ne bagamba nti, “Tugula amazima.” Engero 23:23. Ekyo ne kibaviirako okunyoomebwa n’okusingawo; abamu nga babasekerera, abamu nga babaduulira, abamu nga babavuma, era abamu nga bakoowoola abalala babakube. Ku nkomerero, ne wabaawo oluyoogaano n’akasasamalo kanene mu katale, n’entegeka yonna n’etabuka. Amangu ago ne batuusa ebigambo ku mukulu w’akatale, n’ajja mangu, n’alonda mikwano gye abasinga okwesigika okukwata abasajja abo okubabuuliriza, abaali basse akatale kumpi okukyuusibwa. Awo abasajja ne baleetebwa okubuulirizibwa; era abaali babasalira ne babuuza gye baava, gye baali bagenda, ne kye baali bakola eyo nga bambadde engoye ez’engeri eyo eteri ya bulijjo. Abasajja ne babagamba nti baali bagenyi era abatambuze mu nsi, era nti baali bagenda mu nsi yaabwe, ye Yerusaalemi ey’omu ggulu, Abaebbulaniya 11:13-16; era nti tebaali bawadde nsonga yonna eri abantu b’ekibuga, wadde eri abasuubuzi, ebaleetera okubayisa obubi bwe batyo, n’okubaziyiza mu lugendo lwabwe, okuggyako olw’okuba nti omu bwe yababuuza kye bagula, baagamba nti bagula amazima. Naye abaali balondeddwa okubabuuliriza tebaakkiriza nti baali bantu balala okuggyako abalalu abafudde eddalu, oba abazze okutabulatabula ebintu byonna mu katale. Kyebaava babakwata ne babakuba, ne babasiiga ettosi, ne babateeka mu kayumba k’ebyuma, balyoke babeere ekyerolerwa eri abantu bonna ab’omu katale. Eyo ne bamalayo ekiseera, ne bafuuka eky’okusanyusa buli muntu, oba okumalako ettima lye, oba okwesasuza; omukulu w’akatale ng’ayongera okusekerera byonna ebyabatuukako. Naye abasajja abo nga bagumiikiriza, era “nga tebavumanga abavumye, wabula nga babasabira omukisa,” nga bawa ebigambo ebirungi mu kifo ky’ebibi, n’ekisa mu kifo ky’obulabe bwe baakolebwa, abamu ku bantu b’omu katale, abaali basinga abalala okwetegereza era abatalina kyekubiira kingi, ne batandika okunenya n’okukangavvula ab’ekika ekya wansi olw’okuyisa obubi abasajja abo buli kiseera. Abo ne babasunguwalira nnyo, ne babalumba, nga babatwala okuba ababi ng’abasajja abali mu kayumba, era nga babagamba nti balabika nga bakolagana nabo, era nti bajja kugabana nabo ku nnaku zaabwe. Abalala ne baddamu nti, ku ebyo bye baali balaba, abasajja abo baali bakkakkamu era beegendereza, nga tebaagala kukola muntu yenna kabi; era nti waaliwo bangi abaasuubuliranga mu katale kaabwe abaali basaanira okuteekebwa mu kayumba, weewaawo, n’okusibibwa mu nkondo, okusinga abasajja be baali bayisizza obubi. Bwe batyo, nga bamaze okwogera ebigambo bingi ku njuyi zombi, (abasajja abo bbo nga beeyisa n’amagezi n’obukkakkamu mu maaso gaabwe ekiseera kyonna,) ne batandika okukubagana bokka na bokka, ne balumyagana. Awo abasajja bano ababiri abaavu ne baleetebwa nate mu maaso g’ababuuliriza baabwe, ne bavunaanibwa omusango ogw’oluyoogaano olwali lwakabaawo mu katale. Kyebaava babakuba ekisaasizza, ne babateekako ebyuma, ne babatambuliza mu njegere okwetooloola akatale, okubeera eky’okulabirako n’entiisa eri abalala, waleme kubaawo abayimirira ku lwabwe oba abeegatta nabo. Naye Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa ne beeyisa n’amagezi n’okusingawo, ne bagumira ekivume n’ensonyi ebyabateekebwako n’obuwombeefu n’obugumiikiriza bungi, ne kisikiriza ku ludda lwabwe (newankubadde nga batono bw’ogeraageranya n’abalala) abasajja abawerako mu katale. Kino ne kyongera okusunguwaza nnyo ab’oludda olulala, ne basalawo okutta abasajja bano bombi. Kyebaava babakanga nti akayumba wadde ebyuma tebijja kumala, wabula nti bateekwa kufa olw’ekivume kye baakola, n’olw’okulimbalimba abantu b’akatale. Awo ne bazzibwayo mu kayumba, okutuusa nga kulagiddwa ekirala ku bo. Ne babayingizaamu, ne basiba ebigere byabwe mu nvuba. Era wano ne bajjukira nate bye baawulira okuva eri mukwano gwabwe omwesigwa Omubuulizi, ne beeyongera okunywezebwa mu kkubo lyabwe ne mu kubonaabona kwabwe olw’ebyo bye yabagamba nti bijja kubatuukako. Era kaakano ne bazzaamu buli omu munne amaanyi, nti oyo eyandigwiriddwa okubonaabona, ye yandifunye ekisinga obulungi: kyeyava buli omu yeegomba mu kyama ye afune ekitiibwa ekyo. Naye nga beewaayo eri entegeka ey’amagezi gonna ey’Oyo afuga ebintu byonna, ne babeera n’obumativu bungi mu mbeera gye baalimu, okutuusa lwe bandisaliddwawo ekirala. Awo olunaku bwe lwateekebwawo, ne babafulumya okuwozesebwa, basalirwe omusango. Ekiseera bwe kyatuuka, ne baleetebwa mu maaso g’abalabe baabwe ne bavunaanibwa. Erinnya ly’omulamuzi lyali Omwami Akyawa-Obulungi; omusango gwabwe gwali gumu mu makulu, newankubadde nga gwawukanamu katono mu bigambo; era bwe gwali bwe guti: “Nti baali balabe era abataataaganya obusuubuzi; nti baaleeta okusasamala n’enjawukana mu kibuga, era baali bawangudde ekibinja ku ndowooza zaabwe ezisinga obubi, nga banyooma etteeka ly’omulangira waabwe.” Awo Omwesigwa n’atandika okuddamu nti yali alwanyisa bulwanyisa ekyo ekyali kirwanyisa Oyo asinga abasinga bonna obukulu. Era, bw’atyo bwe yagamba, ku by’okutaataaganya, sirina kye ntaataaganya, kubanga ndi muntu wa mirembe: abo abaasikirizibwa ku ludda lwaffe baasikirizibwa olw’okulaba amazima gaffe n’obutaliiko musango bwaffe, era bakyusiddwa bukyusibwa okuva mu bubi okudda mu bulungi. Ate ku kabaka gwe mwogerako, olw’okuba nga ye Beeruzebuli, omulabe wa Mukama waffe, mmunyooma ye ne bamalayika be bonna. Awo ne balangirira nti abo abalina kye boogera ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka nga bawawaabira omusibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga, bajje amangu ago bawe obujulirwa bwabwe. Awo ne wajja abajulirwa basatu, kwe kugamba: Obuggya, Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, ne Anoonya-Ttendo. Ne bababuuza oba nga bamanyi omusibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga; era kiki kye balina okumwogerako ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka. Awo Obuggya n’ayimirira, n’ayogera bw’ati: Ssebo, omusajja ono mmumanyi ebbanga ddene, era nja kukakasa nga ndayidde mu maaso g’embuga eno ey’ekitiibwa, nti ye- Omulamuzi: Linda; sooka mumulayize. Awo ne bamulayiza. N’alyoka agamba nti, Ssebo, omusajja ono, newankubadde ng’erinnya lye liwulikika bulungi, y’omu ku basajja abasinga obubi mu nsi yaffe; tafaayo ku mulangira wadde ku bantu, ku mateeka wadde ku mpisa, wabula akola kyonna ky’asobola okujjuza abantu bonna endowooza ze ezimu ez’obujeemu, z’ayita okutwalira awamu emisingi gy’okukkiriza n’obutukuvu. Era mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, nze kennyini namuwulira omulundi gumu ng’agamba nti Obukristaayo n’empisa z’ekibuga kyaffe eky’Obutaliimu bikontana ddala, era tebiyinza kutabagana. Mu kwogera ekyo, ssebo, tasalira musango bikolwa byaffe byonna ebisiimibwa kyokka, naye naffe abakola ebikolwa ebyo. Awo omulamuzi n’amugamba nti, Olina ekirala ky’oyogera? Obuggya: Ssebo, nnyinza okwogera bingi nnyo, naye saagala kukooya kkooti. Naye bwe kinaaba kyetaagisa, abaami abalala bwe banaamala okuwa obujulirwa bwabwe, mu kifo ky’okubulwa ekintu kyonna ekinaamumalawo, nja kwongera ku bujulirwa bwange ku ye. Awo ne bamugamba ayimirire ebbali. Awo ne bayita Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, ne bamugamba atunuulire omusibe. Era ne bamubuuza ky’ayinza okumwogerako ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka. Awo ne bamulayiza; n’atandika. Enzikiriza-Enkyamu: Ssebo, omusajja ono simumanyi nnyo, era saagala kwongera kumumanya. Naye kino nkimanyi, nti musajja wa kabi nnyo, olw’emboozi gye nnali naye ennaku zino, mu kibuga kino; kubanga olwo, bwe nnali njogera naye, namuwulira ng’agamba nti eddiini yaffe teriimu nsa, era nga si ya ngeri omuntu gy’ayinza okusanyusiza Katonda. Ebigambo bye ebyo, ssebo, omanyi bulungi ekiteekwa okuvaamu, kwe kugamba, nti tukyasinza bwereere, tukyali mu bibi byaffe, era ku nkomerero tulisalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira: era kino kye nnina okwogera. Awo Anoonya-Ttendo n’alayizibwa, ne bamugamba ayogere ky’amanyi ku lwa mukama waabwe kabaka ku musibe ayimiridde mu maaso g’embuga. Anoonya-Ttendo: Ssebo, nammwe abaami mwenna, omusajja ono mmumanyi okuva edda, era mmuwulidde ng’ayogera ebintu ebitasaanidde kwogerwa; kubanga avvodde omulangira waffe ow’ekitiibwa Beeruzebuli, era ayogedde eby’okunyooma ku mikwano gye egy’ekitiibwa, amannya gaabwe nga ge gano: Omwami Omuntu-ow’Edda, Omwami Essanyu-ly’Omubiri, Omwami Ow’ebinyumu, Omwami Ayagala-Ekitiibwa-eky’Obwereere, Omwami Obukaba omukadde, Ssebo Omululu, wamu n’abakungu baffe abalala bonna: era ate yagamba nti, singa abantu bonna baali ba ndowooza ye, bwe kiba kisoboka, tewandibaddewo n’omu ku bakungu bano asigala mu kibuga kino. Ekirala, tatidde kukuvuma ggwe, ssebo, kaakano alondeddwa okumusalira omusango, ng’akuyita omubi atatya Katonda, n’ebigambo ebirala bingi eby’okuvuma ng’ebyo, by’asiize abakungu b’ekibuga kyaffe abasinga obungi. Anoonya-Ttendo bwe yamala okwogera ebibye, omulamuzi n’akyukira omusibe, n’agamba nti, Ggwe omudduse, omukyamu mu nzikiriza, era omulyamaanyi, owulidde abaami bano abeesimbu bye bakulumirizza? Omwesigwa: Nzikirizibwa okwogera ebigambo bitono okwewozaako? Omulamuzi: Ggwe, ggwe, osaanidde obutaddayo kuba mulamu, wabula okuttibwa amangu ago wano wennyini; naye, abantu bonna balyoke balabe obukkakkamu bwaffe gy’oli, ka tuwulire ky’olina okwogera, ggwe omudduse omubi. Omwesigwa: 1. Kale ngamba, okuddamu Omwami Obuggya bye yayogedde, sigambangako kirala okuggyako kino, nti buli kiragiro, oba mateeka, oba mpisa, oba bantu, ebikontana ddala n’ekigambo kya Katonda, bikontana ddala n’Obukristaayo. Bwe mba nga nsobezza mu kino, mundage ensobi yange, era ndi mwetegefu wano mu maaso gammwe okwejjulula. 2. Ku ky’okubiri, kwe kugamba Omwami Enzikiriza-Enkyamu, n’ekyo ky’ampaabira, nagamba kino kyokka, nti mu kusinza Katonda kyetaagisa okukkiriza okuva eri Katonda; naye tewayinza kubaawo kukkiriza okuva eri Katonda awatali kubikkulirwa okuva eri Katonda okw’okwagala kwe. Noolwekyo, kyonna ekiyingizibwa mu kusinza Katonda ekitakwatagana na kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, tekiyinza kukolebwa okuggyako olw’okukkiriza kw’omuntu; era okukkiriza okwo tekugasa ku bulamu obutaggwaawo. 3. Ku ebyo Omwami Anoonya-Ttendo by’ayogedde, ngamba, (nga nneewala ebigambo, ng’okugamba nti nvuma, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo,) nti omulangira w’ekibuga kino, wamu n’ekibinja kyonna eky’abakopi abamuweereza, omwami ono b’ayogeddeko, basaanira okubeera mu ggeyeena okusinga mu kibuga kino n’ensi eno. Kale Mukama ansaasire. Awo omulamuzi n’ayita abasazi b’omusango, (abaali bayimiridde awo ekiseera kyonna nga bawulira era nga beetegereza,) Abaami abasazi b’omusango, mulaba omusajja ono eyaleese oluyoogaano olunene bwe lutyo mu kibuga kino; era muwulidde abaami bano ab’ekitiibwa bye bamulumirizza; era muwulidde n’okuddamu kwe n’okwatula kwe: kaakano kiri mu mitima gyammwe okumuwanika oba okuwonya obulamu bwe; naye ndaba nga kisaanidde mbayigirize ku tteeka lyaffe. Waaliwo etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Falaawo Omukulu, omuweereza w’omulangira waffe, nti, abo ab’eddiini ekontana naye baleme okweyongera obungi n’okumusinza amaanyi, abaana baabwe ab’obulenzi basuulibwenga mu mugga. Okuva 1:22. Waaliwo n’etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Nebukadduneeza Omukulu, omuweereza we omulala, nti buli atalivuunama n’asinza ekifaananyi kye ekya zaabu, alisuulibwa mu kikoomi ekyaka omuliro. Danyeri 3:6. Waaliwo n’etteeka eryateekebwawo mu mirembe gya Daliyo, nti buli anaasabanga katonda omulala yenna okumala ekiseera, okuggyako ye, asuulibwe mu mpuku y’empologoma. Danyeri 6:7. Kaakano, omujeemu ono amenye ensa y’amateeka gano, si mu birowoozo byokka (ekitagumiikirizika), naye ne mu bigambo ne mu bikolwa; kale tekiyinza kugumiikirizibwa n’akatono. Ku by’etteeka lya Falaawo, lyateekebwawo nga balowooza okuziyiza akabi, nga tewannabaawo musango gulabika; naye wano omusango gulabika. Ku ery’okubiri n’ery’okusatu, mulaba nga awakanya eddiini yaffe; era olw’obulyamaanyi bw’amaze okwatula, asaanidde okufa. Awo abasazi b’omusango ne bafuluma, amannya gaabwe nga ge gano: Omwami Omuzibe-w’amaaso, Omwami Atalina-bulungi, Omwami Ettima, Omwami Ayagala-Obukaba, Omwami Omwononefu, Omwami Omukalabakalaba, Omwami Ow’amalala, Omwami Obukyayi, Omwami Omulimba, Omwami Obukambwe, Omwami Akyawa-Ekitangaala, n’Omwami Atakkaanyizibwa; buli omu ku bo n’asalawo mu kyama nga bali bokka nti yasobya, oluvannyuma bonna ne bakkiriziganya okumusingisa omusango mu maaso g’omulamuzi. Era okusooka nga bali bokka, Omwami Omuzibe-w’amaaso, omukulu waabwe, n’agamba nti, Ndaba bulungi nti omusajja ono mukyamu mu nzikiriza. Awo Omwami Atalina-bulungi n’agamba nti, Omuntu ow’engeri eyo mumuggye ku nsi. Weewaawo, bw’atyo Omwami Ettima bwe yagamba, kubanga nkyawa n’endabika ye yennyini. Awo Omwami Ayagala-Obukaba n’agamba nti, Saayinza kumugumiikiriza n’akatono. Nange, bw’atyo Omwami Omwononefu bwe yagamba, kubanga yandibadde buli kiseera ng’anenya engeri yange. Mumuwanike, mumuwanike, bw’atyo Omwami Omukalabakalaba bwe yagamba. Kasajja ka bwereere, bw’atyo Omwami Ow’amalala bwe yagamba. Omutima gwange gumukyaye, bw’atyo Omwami Obukyayi bwe yagamba. Mufere, bw’atyo Omwami Omulimba bwe yagamba. Okuwanikibwa kwandibadde kisa kingi gy’ali, bw’atyo Omwami Obukambwe bwe yagamba. Ka tumuggye mu kkubo, bw’atyo Omwami Akyawa-Ekitangaala bwe yagamba. Awo Omwami Atakkaanyizibwa n’agamba nti, Ne bwe nnandiweereddwa ensi yonna, sandisobodde kutabagana naye; kale ka tumusingise amangu ago omusango ogw’okufa. Era bwe batyo bwe baakola; kyeyava asalirwa omusango amangu ago aggyibwe mu kifo we yali, atwalibwe mu kifo gye yava, era eyo attibwe okufa okusinga obukambwe okwandiyinzizza okuyiiyizibwa. Kale ne bamufulumya, okumukola nga etteeka lyabwe bwe liragira; era okusooka ne bamukuba embooko, ne bamukuba ebikonde, ne bamusala omubiri gwe n’ebiso; oluvannyuma ne bamukuba amayinja, ne bamufumita n’ebitala byabwe; era ku nkomerero ne bamwokya ku muti n’afuuka evvu. Bw’atyo Omwesigwa bwe yatuuka ku nkomerero ye. Awo ne ndaba nga emabega w’ekibiina wayimiridde eggaali n’embalaasi bbiri nga zirindiridde Omwesigwa, eyatwalibwa n’agiyingizibwamu (abalabe be olwamala okumutta), amangu ago n’atwalibwa waggulu ng’ayita mu bire n’eddoboozi ly’ekkondeere, mu kkubo erisinga okumpi okutuuka ku Mulyango gw’Eggulu. Naye Omukristaayo ye, n’afuna akaseera ak’okuwummulako, n’azzibwayo mu kkomera: n’abeerayo okumala ebbanga. Naye Oyo afuga ebintu byonna, ng’alina amaanyi g’obusungu bwabwe mu mukono gwe, n’akyusa ebintu bwe bityo, Omukristaayo n’abawona mu kiseera ekyo, n’agenda ekkubo lye. Era bwe yali agenda, n’ayimba, ng’agamba nti, “Kale, Omwesigwa, oyatudde n’obwesigwa Mukama wo, gw’olibeera naye mu mukisa, Ng’abatakkiriza, n’amasanyu gaabwe ag’obwereere gonna, Bakaaba nga bali mu nnaku zaabwe ez’omu ggeyeena: Yimba, Omwesigwa, yimba, erinnya lyo libeerewo; Kubanga newankubadde baakutta, okyali mulamu.”

fields.title: Omutendera Ogwomusanvu
fields.body_html:
Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga Omukristaayo teyagenda yekka; kubanga waaliwo omu erinnya lye Asuubira (eyafuuka bw’atyo olw’okulaba Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa mu bigambo byabwe ne mu nneeyisa yaabwe, ne mu kubonaabona kwabwe ku katale), eyeegatta ku ye, ne bakola endagaano ey’obooluganda, n’amugamba nti agenda kuba munne. Bw’atyo omu n’afa ng’ajulira amazima, omulala n’asituka mu vvu lye okuba munne w’Omukristaayo mu lugendo lwe. Era Asuubira ono n’agamba Omukristaayo nti ku katale waliwo abasajja bangi nnyo abaali bagenda okulinda ekiseera kyabwe, ne babagoberera.

Awo ne ndaba nga, amangu ddala nga bamaze okuva ku katale, ne batuuka ku omu eyali abakulembedde, erinnya lye Eyeenoonyeza; ne bamugamba nti, Ssebo, oli wa nsi ki? Era mu kkubo lino ogenda wala wa? N’abagamba nti yava mu Kibuga ky’Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu, era nga agenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu; naye n’atababuulira linnya lye.

Ova mu Kibuga ky’Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu? Omukristaayo bwe yagamba; eyo waliyo omuntu omulungi yenna abeerayo? Engero 26:25.

Eyeenoonyeza: Weewaawo, Eyeenoonyeza bwe yagamba, nsuubira nti waliwo.

Omukristaayo: Nkwegayiridde, ssebo, nkuyite ntya? Omukristaayo bwe yagamba.

Eyeenoonyeza: Nze ndi mugenyi gy’oli, naawe oli mugenyi gye ndi: bw’oba ng’ogenda mu kkubo lino, nja kusanyuka okutambula naawe; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nteekwa okumatira.

Omukristaayo: Ekibuga kino eky’Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba, nkiwuliddeko; era nga bwe nzijukira, bagamba nti kifo kya bugagga.

Eyeenoonyeza: Weewaawo, nkukakasa nti bwe kiri; era nnina eyo ab’ekika kyange bangi nnyo abagagga.

Omukristaayo: Nkwegayiridde, ab’ekika kyo eyo be baani, omuntu bw’aba ayinza okwetantala okubuuza?

Eyeenoonyeza: Kumpi ekibuga kyonna; naddala Omwami Eyeekyusa, Omwami Agoberera-Ebiseera, Omwami Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu, abajjajja be be baasooka okuwa ekibuga ekyo erinnya lyakyo; era Omwami Omuweweevu, Omwami Atunula-Njuyi-Zombi, Omwami Kyonna-Kyonna; n’omusumba w’ekkanisa y’ekitundu kyaffe, Omwami Ennimi-Bbiri, yali muganda wa mmange ddala, ku ludda lwa kitaawe; era okukubuulira amazima, nfuuse omwami ow’ekitiibwa; naye kitaawe wa jjajjange yali musaabaze bw’ati w’eryato, eyatunulanga ludda lumu ng’avugira ludda lulala, era obugagga bwange obusinga obungi nabufuna mu mulimu ogwo gwe gumu.

Omukristaayo: Oli mufumbo?

Eyeenoonyeza: Weewaawo, era mukyala wange mukazi wa mpisa nnungi nnyo, muwala w’omukazi ow’empisa ennungi; yali muwala wa Nnyabo Okwefuula; n’olwekyo yava mu nnyumba ey’ekitiibwa ennyo, era yatuuka ku ddaala ery’oku ntikko mu mpisa, n’amanya bw’ayisa buli muntu, okuva ku mulangira okutuuka ku mulimi. ‘Kituufu nti twawukana katono mu ddiini n’abo abakakanyavu, naye mu nsonga bbiri zokka entono: Ekisooka, tetulwanagana na mpewo n’amayengo. Ekyokubiri, bulijjo tusinga okuba abanyiikivu eddiini bw’etambula mu ngatto zaayo eza ffeeza; twagala nnyo okutambula nayo mu luguudo, enjuba bw’eba eyaka n’abantu nga bagikubira mu ngalo.

Awo Omukristaayo n’awugukako katono n’agenda eri munne Asuubira, n’agamba nti, Kinzijidde mu mutima nti ono ye Eyeenoonyeza ow’omu Kibuga ky’Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu; era bw’aba nga ye, tulina mu kibiina kyaffe omukumpanya asinga bonna ababeera mu bitundu bino byonna. Awo Asuubira n’agamba nti, Mubuuze; ndowooza erinnya lye teriyinza kumukwasa nsonyi. Awo Omukristaayo n’addamu n’amutuukako, n’agamba nti, Ssebo, oyogera ng’omuntu amanyi okusinga ensi yonna; era bwe sikyamye, ndowooza nkutegeddeko ekitundu. Si ggwe Omwami Eyeenoonyeza ow’omu Kibuga ky’Ebigambo-Ebiwoomu?

Eyeenoonyeza: Lino si linnya lyange, naye ddala lye linnya ery’okuduula lye bampadde abamu abatanjagala n’akamu, era nteekwa okumatira okulisitula ng’ekivume, ng’abantu abalala abalungi bwe baasitula ebyabwe nga sinnabaawo.

Omukristaayo: Naye tewawa bantu nsonga yonna okukuyita erinnya lino?

Eyeenoonyeza: Nedda, nedda! Ekisinga obubi kye nnakola okubawa ensonga ey’okumpa erinnya lino, kwe kuba nti bulijjo nnali n’omukisa okukwatagana mu ndowooza yange n’enkola y’ebiseera ebiriwo, ne bwe yabanga etya, era nga nfunamu: naye ebintu bwe binjijira bwe bityo, ka mbibale ng’omukisa; naye abakyaawi baleme kunzitika kivume olw’ekyo.

Omukristaayo: Nalowooza ddala nti ggwe muntu gwe nnawulirako; era okukubuulira kye ndowooza, ntya nti erinnya lino likugwanira okusinga bw’oyagala tulowooze.

Eyeenoonyeza: Kale, bwe muba mulowooza bwe mutyo, sirina kye nnyinza kukola; mujja kunsanga nga ndi munnammwe omulungi mu lugendo, bwe munaakkiriza okutambula nange.

Omukristaayo: Bw’oba oyagala okugenda naffe, oteekwa okulwanagana n’empewo n’amayengo; ekyo, nga bwe ndaba, kikontana n’endowooza yo: era oteekwa okukkiriza Eddiini ng’eri mu bikunta byayo, nga bw’ogikkiriza ng’eri mu ngatto zaayo eza ffeeza; era n’oyimirira nayo ng’esibiddwa mu njegere, nga bw’oyimirira nayo ng’etambula mu nguudo n’abantu nga bagikubira mu ngalo.

Eyeenoonyeza: Temunkaka, era temufuga kukkiriza kwange; mundeke mu ddembe lyange, era mundeke ntambule nammwe.

Omukristaayo: Toyongerayo na ddaala limu, okuggyako ng’onookola nga ffe mu kye ndaga.

Awo Eyeenoonyeza n’agamba nti, Sigenda kuleka misingi gyange egy’edda, kubanga tegirina kabi era gya magoba. Bwe kiba nga sisobola kugenda nammwe, nteekwa okukola nga bwe nnakola nga temunnantuukako, kwe kugamba, okutambula nzekka, okutuusa lwe wanaabaawo abanantuukako abanaasanyuka okutambula nange.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga Omukristaayo ne Asuubira bamulese, ne bamukulembera nga bakuuma ebbanga; naye omu ku bo bwe yatunula emabega, n’alaba abasajja basatu nga bagoberera Omwami Eyeenoonyeza; era, laba, bwe baamutuukako, n’abakutamira nnyo; nabo ne bamulamusa n’ekitiibwa. Amannya g’abasajja abo gaali, Omwami Akwata-Ensi, Omwami Ayagala-Ssente, n’Omwami Akuŋŋaanya-Byonna, abasajja Omwami Eyeenoonyeza be yali amanyi edda; kubanga mu buto bwabwe baasomeranga wamu, nga bayigirizibwa Omwami Anyaga, omukulu w’essomero mu Ayagala-Amagoba, ekibuga eky’akatale mu Ssaza ly’Omululu, mu Bukiikakkono. Omukulu w’essomero ono yabayigiriza obukugu bw’okufuna, oba mu maanyi, oba mu bukumpanya, oba mu kuwaanirira, oba mu bulimba, oba mu kwefuula abantu b’eddiini; era abasajja bano abana baali bayize nnyo ku bukugu bw’omusomesa waabwe, ne kiba nti buli omu ku bo yandisobodde okuddukanya essomero ng’eryo ye kennyini.

Kale, bwe baamala, nga bwe nnyogedde, okulamusagana bwe batyo, Omwami Ayagala-Ssente n’agamba Omwami Eyeenoonyeza nti, Bano be baani abali mu maaso gaffe ku kkubo? Kubanga Omukristaayo ne Asuubira baali bakyalabika.

Eyeenoonyeza: Basajja babiri ab’ensi ey’ewala, abagenda ku lugendo lw’obutambuze mu ngeri yaabwe.

Omwami Ayagala-Ssente: Woowe! Lwaki tebaalinda ne tufuna okutambula nabo mu mukwano omulungi? kubanga bo, naffe, naawe, ssebo, nsuubira nti ffenna tuli ku lugendo lw’obutambuze.

Eyeenoonyeza: Ddala bwe tutyo; naye abasajja abatukulembedde bakakanyavu nnyo, era baagala nnyo endowooza zaabwe, era banyooma nnyo endowooza z’abalala, ne kiba nti omuntu ne bw’aba ow’okutya Katonda atya, bw’atakwatagana nabo mu buli kintu, bamugoba ddala mu kibiina kyabwe.

Omwami Akuŋŋaanya-Byonna: Ekyo kibi; naye tusoma ku bamu abeefuula abatuukirivu abayitiridde, era obukakanyavu bw’abantu ng’abo bubasindika okusalira omusango n’okusingisa bonna okuggyako bo bokka. Naye nkwegayiridde, ebintu bye mwayawukanamu byali biki, era byali bimeka?

Eyeenoonyeza: Bo, mu ngeri yaabwe ey’obukakanyavu, basalawo nti kye kibagwanira okwanguyiriza olugendo lwabwe mu buli mbeera y’obudde, so nze ndi wa kulinda mpewo n’amayengo. Bo bawagira okussa byonna mu kabi ku lwa Katonda omulundi gumu; nze ndi wa kukozesa buli kakisa okukuuma obulamu bwange n’ebyobugagga byange. Bo bakwata endowooza zaabwe newankubadde abantu abalala bonna nga babawakanya; naye nze ndi wa ddiini mu kigero ebiseera n’obukuumi bwange kye biyinza okugumira. Bo bawagira eddiini ng’eri mu bikunta ne mu kunyoomebwa; naye nze ngiwagira ng’etambula mu ngatto zaayo eza ffeeza, mu musana, n’abantu nga bagikubira mu ngalo.

Omwami Akwata-Ensi: Weewaawo, era nywerera awo, Omwami Eyeenoonyeza omulungi; kubanga nze ku lwange, omuntu alina eddembe okukuuma by’alina, naye n’aba omusirusiru bw’ati n’abifiirwa, mmutwala okuba omusirusiru. Tubeere bagezigezi ng’emisota. Kisinga okwanika omuddo ng’enjuba ekyayaka. Mulaba enjuki bw’ewummula mu biseera eby’obutiti, n’ezuukuka wekka lw’esobola okufuna amagoba wamu n’essanyu. Katonda oluusi atonnyesa enkuba, oluusi n’awa omusana: bwe baba basirusiru bwe batyo okuyita mu nkuba, ffe ka tumatire okutambula n’obudde obulungi. Nze ku lwange, nsinga okwagala eddiini eyo ekwatagana n’obukuumi bw’emikisa emirungi Katonda gy’atuwa; kubanga ani akulemberwa amagezi ayinza okulowooza, okuva Katonda bwe yatuwa ebirungi eby’obulamu buno, nti tayagala tubikuume ku lulwe? Ibulayimu ne Sulemaani baagaggawala mu ddiini; era Yobu agamba nti omuntu omulungi alitereka zaabu ng’enfuufu; naye tateekwa kuba ng’abasajja abali mu maaso gaffe, bwe baba nga bali nga bw’obannyonnyodde.

Omwami Akuŋŋaanya-Byonna: Ndowooza nti ffenna tukkiriziganya mu nsonga eno; n’olwekyo tekwetaagisa bigambo birala ku yo.

Omwami Ayagala-Ssente: Nedda, ddala tekwetaagisa bigambo birala ku nsonga eno; kubanga oyo atakkiriza Byawandiikibwa wadde amagezi (era mulaba nga byombi biri ku ludda lwaffe), tamanyi ddembe lye, era tanoonya bukuumi bwe.

Eyeenoonyeza: Baganda bange, nga bwe mulaba, ffenna tuli ku lugendo lw’obutambuze; era okutuwugula obulungi okuva ku bintu ebibi, munzikirize mbateereko ekibuuzo kino.

Ka tugambe nti omuntu, omusumba, oba omusuubuzi, n’abalala, afunye akakisa mu maaso ge okufuna emikisa emirungi egy’obulamu buno, naye nga tayinza kugifuna mu ngeri yonna okuggyako nga, waakiri mu kulabika, afuuka munyiikivu nnyo ekitalo mu nsonga ezimu ez’eddiini ze yali tayingiramu edda; tayinza kukozesa ngeri eyo okutuuka ku kigendererwa kye, n’ate n’asigala nga muntu mwesimbu ddala?

Omwami Ayagala-Ssente: Ndaba wansi w’ekibuuzo kyo; era abaami bano bwe banzikiriza, nja kugezaako okukuddamu. Ekisooka, okwogera ku kibuuzo kyo nga bwe kikwata ku musumba yennyini: ka tugambe nti omusumba, omusajja omulungi, alina omulimu gw’obusumba ogw’empeera entono ennyo, ate ng’alengera omulala omunene, ogusinga ennyo obugimu n’obugagga; era kaakano afunye akakisa okugufuna, naye nga kimwetaagisa okwongera okusoma, okubuulira emirundi emingi n’obunyiikivu, era, kubanga embeera y’abantu bw’eyagala, okukyusa egimu ku misingi gye; nze ku lwange, sirabe nsonga lwaki omuntu tayinza kukola kino, kasita aba ayitiddwa, weewaawo, n’ebirala bingi nnyo, n’asigala nga muntu mwesimbu. Kubanga ki?

1. Okwegomba kwe okw’omulimu ogusingako obunene kwa mateeka (kino tekiyinza kuwakanyizibwa), kubanga okulabirira kwa Katonda kwe kwagumuteeka mu maaso ge; kale ayinza okugufuna bw’aba asobola, awatali kwebuuza olw’omuntu we ow’omunda.

2. Ate era, okwegomba kwe okw’omulimu ogwo kumufuula asoma ennyo, omubuulizi omunyiikivu okusingawo, n’ebirala, era bw’atyo kumufuula omuntu omulungi okusingawo, weewaawo, kumufuula okwongera okukulaakulanya ebitone bye, ekyo nga kikwatagana n’endowooza ya Katonda.

3. Kaakano, ku nsonga y’okukwatagana kwe n’embeera y’abantu be, ng’aleka egimu ku misingi gye okubaweereza, kino kiraga, 1. Nti muntu eyeefiiriza. 2. Ow’empisa ennungi ezisikiriza. Era, 3. Bw’atyo asingako okusaanira omulimu gw’obusumba.

4. Kale, mmaliriza nti omusumba awaanyisa omutono n’omunene, tasaanye, olw’okukola bw’atyo, kusalirwa nti wa mululu; wabula, okuva bwe yeeyongedde mu bitone bye ne mu bunyiikivu olw’ekyo, abalibwe ng’omuntu agoberera omulanga gwe, n’akakisa akamuteereddwa mu ngalo okukola ebirungi.

Kaakano ku kitundu ekyokubiri eky’ekibuuzo, ekikwata ku musuubuzi gw’oyogeddeko. Ka tugambe nti omuntu ng’oyo alina omulimu gwa kinaku mu nsi, naye bw’afuuka ow’eddiini ayinza okulongoosa obusuubuzi bwe, oboolyawo n’awasa omukazi omugagga, oba n’afuna abaguzi bangi era abasingako ennyo mu dduuka lye; nze ku lwange, sirabe nsonga lwaki kino tekiyinza kukolebwa mu ngeri ya mateeka. Kubanga ki?

1. Okufuuka ow’eddiini mpisa nnungi, omuntu ne bw’akufuuka mu ngeri yonna.

2. So era si kibi okuwasa omukazi omugagga, oba okufuna abaguzi abangi mu dduuka lyange.

3. Ate era, omuntu afuna ebyo olw’okufuuka ow’eddiini, afuna ekirungi okuva mu balungi, ng’afuuka omulungi ye kennyini; kale wano waliwo omukazi omulungi, n’abaguzi abalungi, n’amagoba amalungi, era bino byonna olw’okufuuka ow’eddiini, ekintu ekirungi: n’olwekyo, okufuuka ow’eddiini okufuna bino byonna kigendererwa kirungi era kya magoba.

Okuddamu kuno, Omwami Ayagala-Ssente kwe yawa ku kibuuzo ky’Omwami Eyeenoonyeza, bonna ne bakuwaana nnyo; n’olwekyo ne basalawo, okutwaliza awamu, nti kwali kwa mugaso nnyo era kwa magoba. Era kubanga, nga bwe baalowooza, tewaali muntu yali ayinza kukuwakanya; era kubanga Omukristaayo ne Asuubira baali bakyali we bayinza okukoowoolwa, ne bakkiriziganya wamu okubalumba n’ekibuuzo ekyo amangu ddala nga babatuuseeko; n’okusingira ddala, kubanga baali bawakanyizza Omwami Eyeenoonyeza edda. Awo ne babakoowoola, nabo ne bayimirira ne balinda okutuusa lwe baabatuukako; naye ne basalawo, nga batambula, nti si Omwami Eyeenoonyeza, wabula Omwami Akwata-Ensi omukadde y’aba abateerako ekibuuzo, kubanga, nga bwe baalowooza, okuddamu kwabwe gy’ali kwandibadde kutaliimu bbugumu ery’obusungu eryali likyasigaddewo, eryakoleezebwa wakati w’Omwami Eyeenoonyeza nabo bwe baayawukana akaseera katono emabega.

Awo ne basisinkana, era oluvannyuma lw’okulamusagana okumpi, Omwami Akwata-Ensi n’ateeka ekibuuzo eri Omukristaayo ne munne, n’oluvannyuma n’abagamba baddemu bwe baba basobola.

Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba nti, Omwana omuwere mu ddiini ayinza okuddamu ebibuuzo ng’ebyo omutwalo gumu. Kubanga bwe kiba nga kibi okugoberera Kristo olw’emigaati, nga bwe kiri, Yokaana 6:26; kale tekisinga nnyo okuba eky’omuzizo okumufuula, ye n’eddiini, ekyekwaso okufuna ensi n’okugyeyagaliramu! So tetusanga balala balina ndowooza eno okuggyako abakaafiiri, bannanfuusi, baddayimooni, n’abafumu.

1. Abakaafiiri: kubanga Kamoli ne Sekemu bwe baayagala muwala wa Yakobo n’ente ze, ne balaba nga tewali kkubo lyonna lye bayinza kubifuniramu okuggyako okukomolebwa, ne bagamba bannaabwe nti, Buli musajja mu ffe bw’anaakomolebwa, nga bo bwe bakola, olwo ente zaabwe, ebintu byabwe n’ensolo zaabwe zonna tebiibe byaffe? Muwala waabwe n’ente zaabwe bye baali baagala okufuna, era eddiini yaabwe kye kyali ekyekwaso kye baakozesa okubifuna. Soma olugero lwonna, Olubereberye 34:20-24.

2. Abafalisaayo bannanfuusi nabo baali ba ddiini eno: essaala empanvu ze zaali ekyekwaso kyabwe, naye okunyaga amayumba ga bannamwandu kye kyali ekigendererwa kyabwe; era ekibonerezo ekisingira ddala obunene kye kyali omusango gwabwe okuva eri Katonda. Lukka 20:46,47.

3. Yuda Isukalyoti, eyali Setaani, naye yali wa ddiini eno: yali wa ddiini olw’ensawo, alyoke abeere nannyini ebyateekebwangamu; naye yabula, n’asuulibwa, era n’aba omwana ow’okubula ddala.

4. Simooni omufumu naye yali wa ddiini eno; kubanga yali ayagala okufuna Mwoyo Mutukuvu, alyoke amufunemu ensimbi: era omusango gwe ogwava mu kamwa ka Peetero gwali gumusaanira. Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:19-22.

5. Era tekivaamu mu birowoozo byange nti omuntu akwata eddiini olw’ensi, alisuula eddiini olw’ensi; kubanga nga Yuda bwe yateeka omwoyo ku nsi bwe yafuuka ow’eddiini, bw’atyo ddala bwe yatunda eddiini n’Omusomesa we olw’ensi y’emu. N’olwekyo, okuddamu ekibuuzo nti weewaawo, nga bwe ndaba nti mukoze, n’okukkiriza okuddamu okwo nga kwa mazima, kya bukaafiiri, kya bunnanfuusi, era kya kisetaani; era empeera yammwe eriba ng’ebikolwa byammwe bwe biri.

Awo ne bayimirira nga batunuuliragana, naye nga tebalina kya kuddamu Omukristaayo. Ne Asuubira n’akkiriza nti okuddamu kw’Omukristaayo kwali kwa mazima; awo ne wabaawo akasiriikiriro kanene mu bo. Omwami Eyeenoonyeza ne banne ne bakankana era ne basigala emabega, Omukristaayo ne Asuubira balyoke babakulembere. Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Abasajja bano bwe baba tebasobola kuyimirira mu maaso g’omusango gw’abantu, banaakola batya mu maaso g’omusango gwa Katonda? Era bwe baba basirise nga bakwatibwa n’ebibya eby’ebbumba, banaakola ki bwe balinenyezebwa ennimi z’omuliro ogusaanyaawo?

Awo Omukristaayo ne Asuubira ne babakulembera nate, ne batambula okutuusa lwe baatuuka ku lusenyi olulungi ennyo, oluyitibwa Olusenyi lw’Okuwummula, gye baatambulira n’essanyu lingi; naye olusenyi olwo lwali lufunda, bwe batyo ne baluyitamu mangu. Awo ku ludda olulala olw’olusenyi olwo waaliwo akasozi akatono, akayitibwa Olusozi lw’Amagoba, era mu kasozi ako mwalimu ekirombe kya ffeeza, abamu ku bo abaali bayiseeko mu kkubo eryo edda, kye baawugukirako okulaba kubanga kyali kya kyewuunyo; naye bwe baasemberera ennyo omugo gw’obunnya, ettaka eryali libalimba wansi waabwe ne limenyeka, ne battibwa: era abamu baali balemadde eyo, era ne batasobola, okutuusa ku lunaku lwe baafa, okuddamu okuba nga bwe baali.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange, nga katono okuva ku kkubo, mu maaso g’ekirombe kya ffeeza, Dema yali ayimiridde (ng’omwami ow’ekitiibwa) ng’ayita abayita mu kkubo okujja okulaba; n’agamba Omukristaayo ne munne nti, Mmwe! Mukyame wano, mbalage ekintu.

Omukristaayo: Kintu ki ekisaanira bw’ati okutuggya mu kkubo okukiraba?

Dema: Wano waliwo ekirombe kya ffeeza, era abamu basimamu nga banoonya eby’obugagga; bwe munajja, olw’okufuba okutono muyinza okwefunira obugagga bungi.

Asuubira: Awo Asuubira n’agamba nti, Tugende tulabe.

Omukristaayo: Si nze, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba: Nawulira dda ku kifo kino, ne ku bangi abattibwa eyo; era ate obugagga obwo mutego eri abo ababunoonya, kubanga bubalemesa mu lugendo lwabwe.

Awo Omukristaayo n’akoowoola Dema, ng’agamba nti, Ekifo kino si kya kabi? Tekiremesezza bangi mu lugendo lwabwe? Koseya 9:6.

Dema: Si kya kabi nnyo, okuggyako eri abo abatafaayo; naye bwe yali ayogera ne bimukwasa ensonyi.

Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba Asuubira nti, Tuleme kuvaawo na ddaala limu, naye tweyongere mu kkubo lyaffe.

Asuubira: Nkukakasa, Eyeenoonyeza bw’anaatuuka wano, bw’anaayitibwa nga ffe, ajja kukyamirayo okulaba.

Omukristaayo: Tekibuusibwabuusibwa, kubanga emisingi gye gimutwala mu kkubo eryo, era kya kikumi ku kimu nti ajja kufiira eyo.

Dema: Awo Dema n’akoowoola nate, ng’agamba nti, Naye temujja wano okulaba?

Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’amuddamu mu bukakafu, ng’agamba nti, Dema, oli mulabe w’amakubo amatuufu aga Mukama w’ekkubo lino, era wasalirwa dda omusango omu ku balamuzi ba Kabaka olw’okukyama kwo ggwe kennyini, 2 Timoseewo 4:10; era lwaki onoonya okututwala mu musango gwe gumu? Ate era, bwe tunaakyama n’akatono, Mukama waffe Kabaka ddala ajja kukiwulira, era ajja kutukwasa ensonyi eyo, gye twandiyimiridde n’obuvumu mu maaso ge.

Dema n’ayogerera waggulu nate nti naye yali omu ku booluganda lwabwe; era nti bwe banaalindako katono, naye yennyini yanditambudde nabo.

Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba nti, Erinnya lyo ani? Si lye lye nkuyise?

Dema: Weewaawo, erinnya lyange nze Dema; ndi mwana wa Ibulayimu.

Omukristaayo: Nkumanyi; Gekazi yali kitaawe wa jjajjaawo, ne Yuda yali kitaawo, era otambulidde mu bigere byabwe; kino ky’okola kikolwa kya kisetaani kyokka: kitaawo yawanikibwa ng’omulyamaanyi, naawe tosaanira mpeera esinga eyo. 2 Bassekabaka 5:20-27; Matayo 26:14,15; 27:3-5. Kakasa nti bwe tunaatuuka eri Kabaka, tujja kumubuulira ku nneeyisa yo eno. Bwe batyo ne beeyongerayo mu kkubo lyabwe.

Mu kiseera kino Eyeenoonyeza ne banne baali bazze nate we bayinza okulabika, era ku kuyitibwa okusooka ne bagenda eri Dema. Kaakano, oba baagwa mu bunnya nga balingiza ku mugo gwabwo, oba baagenda wansi okusima, oba baafiira mu ntobo nga bazibiddwa omukka omubi ogutera okuvaayo, ebyo sibikakasa; naye kino nakyetegereza, nti tebaddamu kulabika nate mu kkubo. Awo Omukristaayo n’ayimba nti,

“Eyeenoonyeza ne Dema ow’effeeza bakkiriziganya;

Omu ayita, omulala adduka, alyoke abeere

Omugabana ku magoba ge: bwe batyo bano bombi

Basigala mu nsi eno, so tebeeyongerayo.”

Awo ne ndaba nga, ku ludda olulala olw’olusenyi luno, abatambuze ne batuuka mu kifo awaali ekijjukizo eky’edda, kumpi ddala n’oluguudo, era bwe baakiraba bombi ne beeraliikirira, olw’enkula yaakyo ey’ekyewuunyo; kubanga baakiraba ng’omukazi eyafuulibwa mu kifaananyi ky’empagi. Wano, n’olwekyo, ne bayimirira nga bakitunuulira bukitunuulizi, naye okumala akaseera ne batamanya kye bandikitegeddemu. Ku nkomerero Asuubira n’alaba, waggulu ku mutwe gwakyo, ekiwandiiko mu mpandiika etali ya bulijjo; naye olw’okuba nga teyali muyivu, n’ayita Omukristaayo (kubanga ye yali muyivu) alabe oba ng’ayinza okuzuula amakulu gaakyo: n’ajja, era oluvannyuma lw’okugatta ennukuta katono, n’asanga nga kigamba bwe kiti, “Mujjukire mukazi wa Lutti!” N’akisomera munne; oluvannyuma bombi ne bakkiriziganya nti eyo ye mpagi ey’omunnyo mukazi wa Lutti gye yafuulibwamu, olw’okutunula emabega n’omutima ogw’omululu bwe yali ava mu Sodomu okudduka okuwona. Olubereberye 19:26. Okulaba kuno okw’amangu era okwewuunyisa ne kubawa ensonga ey’okunyumya bino.

Omukristaayo: Ayi muganda wange, kino kye tulabye kijjidde mu kiseera kyakyo: kitutuuseeko bulungi oluvannyuma lw’okutuyita Dema kwe yatuyita okusala tugende tulabe Olusozi lw’Amagoba; era singa twasala, nga bwe yayagala, era nga naawe bwe wali oyagala, muganda wange, nga bwe ndowooza twandifuuliddwa, ng’omukazi ono, ekyerolerwa eri abo abalijja oluvannyuma.

Asuubira: Nnejjusa olw’obusirusiru bwange obwo, era nneewuunya nti kaakano siri nga mukazi wa Lutti; kubanga ekibi kye n’ekyange byawukana mu ki? Ye yatunula butunuzi emabega, nange nnalina okwegomba okugenda okulaba. Ekisa kitenderezebwe; era nkwatibwe ensonyi nti ekintu ng’ekyo kyali kiyingidde mu mutima gwange.

Omukristaayo: Ka tukwate ebyo bye tulaba wano, bituyambe mu biseera ebijja. Omukazi ono yawona ekibonerezo kimu, kubanga teyazikirira mu kuzikirizibwa kwa Sodomu; naye yazikirizibwa mu kirala, nga bwe tulaba: afuuse empagi ey’omunnyo.

Asuubira: Kituufu, era ayinza okutubeerera ffembi okulabula n’eky’okulabirako; okulabula, tulyoke twewale ekibi kye; oba akabonero k’ekibonerezo ekirituuka ku abo abatagenda kuziyizibwa kulabula kuno: bwe batyo Koola, Dasani ne Abiraamu, awamu n’abasajja ebikumi bibiri mu ataano abaazikirira mu kibi kyabwe, nabo baafuuka akabonero oba eky’okulabirako eri abalala, beegendereze. Okubala 16:31,32; 26:9,10. Naye okusinga byonna, nneewuunya ekintu kimu, kwe kugamba: Dema ne banne bwe basobola okuyimirira awo n’obwesige bwe butyo nga banoonya eby’obugagga ebyo, omukazi ono bye yatunula obutunuzi emabega okubiraba (kubanga tetusoma nti yava mu kkubo wadde ekigere kimu), n’afuuka empagi ey’omunnyo; naddala nga ekibonerezo ekyamutuukako kyamufuula eky’okulabirako awo we bayinza okumulabira; kubanga tebayinza butamulaba, singa bayimusa buyimusa amaaso gaabwe.

Omukristaayo: Kino kintu kya kwewuunya, era kiraga nti emitima gyabwe gyaggwaamu essuubi mu nsonga eno; era simanyi gwe nnyinza kubageraageranya naye okusinga abo abanyaga mu nsawo z’abantu mu maaso g’omulamuzi, oba abasala ensawo wansi w’omuti abazzi b’emisango kwe bawanikibwa. Kyogerwa ku basajja b’e Sodomu nti baali “boonoonyi nnyo,” kubanga baali boonoonyi “eri Mukama,” kwe kugamba, mu maaso ge, newakubadde nga yali abalaze ekisa; kubanga ensi ya Sodomu mu biseera ebyo yali ng’ennimiro ya Adeni nga bwe yali edda. Olubereberye 13:10-13. Kino, n’olwekyo, kyeyongera okumukwasa obuggya, ne kifuula ekibonerezo kyabwe okwokya ng’omuliro gwa Mukama okuva mu ggulu bwe gwayinza okukyokya. Era kya magezi ddala okusalawo nti abo, abali nga bano bwe bali, abanaayonoona mu maaso ge, weewaawo, era nga banyooma eby’okulabirako ng’ebyo ebiteekebwa buli kiseera mu maaso gaabwe okubalabula, bateekwa okugabana ku bibonerezo ebisinga obukambwe.

Asuubira: Tewali kubuusabuusa, oyogedde mazima; naye nga kusaasira kunene nnyo, nti si ggwe, era naddala si nze, eyafuulibwa eky’okulabirako kino! Kino kituwa omukisa okwebaza Katonda, okumutya, n’okujjukiranga bulijjo mukazi wa Lutti.

Awo ne ndaba nga bagenda mu kkubo lyabwe okutuuka ku mugga omulungi, Kabaka Dawudi gwe yayita “omugga gwa Katonda;” naye Yokaana n’aguyita “omugga ogw’amazzi ag’obulamu.” Zabbuli 65:9; Okubikkulirwa 22:1; Ezeekyeri 47:1-9. Kale ekkubo lyabwe lyayitanga ku lubalama lw’omugga ogwo: n’olwekyo, Omukristaayo ne munne ne batambula n’essanyu lingi; ne banywa ne ku mazzi g’omugga, agaali amalungi era agazzaamu amaanyi emyoyo gyabwe egyali gikooye. Ate era, ku mbalama z’omugga ogwo, ku njuyi zombi, kwaliko emiti emibisi egy’ebibala ebya buli ngeri; n’amakoola gaagyo baagalyanga okuziyiza endwadde z’okulya ennyo, n’endwadde endala ezikwata abo abeeyokya omusaayi olw’olugendo. Ku njuyi zombi ez’omugga waaliwo n’ettale, eryayooyooteddwa obulungi n’amalanga; era nga kiragala omwaka gwonna. Mu ttale eryo ne bagalamira ne beebaka, kubanga eyo baali basobola okugalamira mirembe. Zabbuli 23:2; Isaaya 14:30. Bwe baazuukuka ne banoga nate ku bibala by’emiti, ne banywa nate ku mazzi g’omugga, ate ne bagalamira okwebaka. Bwe batyo bwe baakola okumala ennaku n’ebiro ebiwerako. Awo ne bayimba;

“Laba, emigga gino egy’endabirwamu bwe gikulukuta,

Okubudaabuda abatambuze ku mabbali g’oluguudo.

Amalundiro amabisi, ng’oggyeeko akawoowo kaago akalungi,

Gabawa ebyokulya ebiwoomu; Era oyo ayinza okutegeeza

Ebibala ebiwoomu, weewaawo, n’amakoola, emiti gino bye gibala,

Alitunda mangu byonna, alyoke agule ennimiro eno.”

Awo bwe baali beetegese okweyongerayo (kubanga baali tebannatuuka ku nkomerero y’olugendo lwabwe), ne balya, ne banywa, ne basitula.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga tebannatambula wala, omugga n’ekkubo ne byawukana okumala akaseera, ne kibanakuwaza nnyo; naye tebaayaŋŋanga kuva mu kkubo. Kale ekkubo okuva ku mugga lyali lya mayinja mayinja, ate ebigere byabwe nga binafu olw’olugendo; emmeeme z’abatambuze ne ziggwaamu nnyo amaanyi olw’ekkubo. Okubala 21:4. Noolwekyo, nga bwe beeyongerayo, ne beegomba ekkubo eddungi okusingako. Kale katono mu maaso gaabwe, ku mukono ogwa kkono ogw’oluguudo, waaliwo ettale, n’eddaala ery’okulinnyirako okusala okuyingira omwo, era ettale eryo liyitibwa Ettale ly’Ekkubo ery’oku Mabbali. Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Singa ettale lino ligendera ku mabbali g’ekkubo lyaffe, ka tusale tuyingire omwo. Awo n’agenda ku ddaala okulaba, era laba, akakubo nga kagendera ku mabbali g’ekkubo emitala w’olukomera. Kino kye nnali njagala, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba; wano we wasinga obwangu okutambula; jjangu, Asuubira omulungi, tusale.

Asuubira: Naye singa akakubo kano katuggya mu kkubo?

Omukristaayo: Ekyo tekisoboka, bw’atyo munne bwe yagamba. Laba, tekagendera ku mabbali g’ekkubo? Awo Asuubira, bwe yamatizibwa munne, n’amugoberera okusala eddaala. Bwe baamala okusala, ne bayingira mu kakubo, ne bakasanga nga kangu nnyo eri ebigere byabwe; era ate, bwe baatunula mu maaso gaabwe, ne balengera omusajja ng’atambula nga bo, era erinnya lye yali Obwesige-Obw’obwereere: ne bamukoowoola, ne bamubuuza ekkubo eryo gye lyalaga. N’agamba nti, Ku Mulyango gw’Eggulu. Laba, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba, saabagambye bwe ntyo? Kino kibalaga nti tuli mu kkubo ettuufu. Awo ne bamugoberera, ye n’abakulembera. Naye laba ekiro ne kituuka, ne kiba kizikiza nnyo; abo abaali emabega ne batamulaba nate eyali mu maaso.

Kale oyo eyali akulembedde (Obwesige-Obw’obwereere lye linnya lye), bwe yali talaba kkubo mu maaso ge, n’agwa mu kinnya ekiwanvu, ekyasimibwa awo mu bugenderevu omulangira w’ensi eyo okukwasizanga abasirusiru abeenoonyeza ekitiibwa eky’obwereere, ne yeetentebuka olw’okugwa kwe. Isaaya 9:16.

Kale Omukristaayo ne munne ne bawulira ng’agwa. Ne bakoowoola okumanya ekibaddewo, naye nga tewali addamu, wabula ne bawulira okusinda. Awo Asuubira n’agamba nti, Kaakano tuli wa? Awo munne n’asirika, ng’atya nti yali amuwabizza okuva mu kkubo; era kaakano enkuba n’etandika okutonnya, n’okubwatuka, n’okumyansa mu ngeri ey’entiisa ennyo, era amazzi ne geeyongera mangu nnyo.

Awo Asuubira n’asindira munda nga bw’agamba nti, Woowe, singa nnasigala mu kkubo lyange!

Omukristaayo: Ani yandirowoozezza nti akakubo kano kandituggye mu kkubo?

Asuubira: Nnakyekengera okuva ddala ku ntandikwa, era kyennava nkuwa okulabula okwo okw’obukkakkamu. Nnandyogedde mu lwatu okusingawo, naye ggwe ompitako obukulu.

Omukristaayo: Muganda wange omulungi, tonnyiigira; nnejjusa okukuggya mu kkubo, n’okukuteeka mu kabi ak’amaanyi bwe kati. Nkwegayiridde, muganda wange, onsonyiwe; saakikoze mu kigendererwa kibi.

Asuubira: Gumya omwoyo, muganda wange, kubanga nkusonyiye; era kkiriza nti kino kirituviiramu obulungi.

Omukristaayo: Nsanyuse okuba ne muganda ow’ekisa; naye tetuteekwa kuyimirira wano; ka tugezeeko okuddayo.

Asuubira: Naye, muganda wange omulungi, ka nkulembere.

Omukristaayo: Nedda, bw’oba oyagala, leka nze nkulembere, bwe wabaawo akabi kasooke ku nze, kubanga ku lwange ffembi kwe twaviira mu kkubo.

Asuubira: Nedda, Asuubira bwe yagamba, togenda kukulembera, kubanga omwoyo gwo nga gutabuddwa guyinza okukuggya nate mu kkubo. Awo okubazzaamu amaanyi ne bawulira eddoboozi ly’omuntu ng’agamba nti, “Mwetegereze ekkubo eddene, ekkubo mwe muyita. Komawo.” Yeremiya 31:21. Naye mu kiseera kino amazzi gaali gamaze okwanjaala nnyo, ekyafuula okuddayo emabega akabi kangi. (Awo ne ndowooza nti kyangu okuva mu kkubo nga tulimu, okusinga okuliyingiramu nga tuvuddemu.) Naye ne beewaayo okuddayo; naye ekizikiza kyali kingi, n’amataba nga gali waggulu nnyo, ne kiba nti bwe baali baddayo baali banaatera okubbira emirundi mwenda oba kkumi.

Era tebaasobola, n’obukugu bwonna bwe baalina, okuddayo ku ddaala ekiro ekyo. Noolwekyo ku nkomerero, bwe baatuuka wansi w’akasiisira akatono, ne batuula awo okutuusa obudde okukya; naye olw’okukoowa, ne beebaka. Kale waaliwo, okumpi n’ekifo we baali bagalamidde, ekigo, ekiyitibwa Ekigo ky’Okubuusabuusa, nannyini kyo nga ye Omuwagguufu Okuggwaamu-Essuubi, era mu ttaka lye mwe baali beebase: kale ye, bwe yagolokoka ku makya ennyo, n’atambulatambula mu nnimiro ze, n’asanga Omukristaayo ne Asuubira nga beebase mu ttaka lye. Awo n’eddoboozi ery’entiisa era ery’ekkayu, n’abalagira okuzuukuka, n’ababuuza gye baava, n’ekyo kye baali bakola mu ttaka lye. Ne bamugamba nti bali batambuze, era nti baali babuze ekkubo lyabwe. Awo omuwagguufu n’agamba nti, Ekiro kino munsobezza nga mulinnyirira era nga mugalamira mu ttaka lyange, n’olwekyo muteekwa okugenda nange. Awo ne bawalirizibwa okugenda, kubanga yali abasinga amaanyi. Era nabo baalina bitono eby’okwogera, kubanga baali bamanyi nti bali mu nsobi. Kale omuwagguufu n’abagoba mu maaso ge, n’abateeka mu kigo kye, mu kkomera eryali ekizikiza ekikutte, ekkyafu era eriwunya obubi ennyo eri emyoyo gy’abasajja bano ababiri. Awo, kale, ne bagalamira omwo okuva ku Lwokusatu ku makya okutuusa ku Lwomukaaga ekiro, nga tebalina wadde akatole k’omugaati, oba ettondo ly’eky’okunywa, oba ekitangaala, wadde omuntu yenna okubabuuza bwe bali; baali, n’olwekyo, mu mbeera mbi, era nga bali wala n’emikwano n’abaabamanyi. Zabbuli 88:18. Kale mu kifo kino Omukristaayo yalina ennaku emirundi ebiri, kubanga olw’amagezi ge agataali ga kwegendereza baali batuuse mu buzibu buno.

Kale Omuwagguufu Okuggwaamu-Essuubi yalina mukazi we, erinnya lye nga ye Nnyabo Entiisa: bwe yagenda okwebaka n’abuulira mukazi we bye yali akoze, kwe kugamba, nti yali akutte abasibe babiri, n’abasuula mu kkomera lye olw’okusobya ku ttaka lye. Awo n’amubuuza n’ekyo ky’asaanidde okweyongera okubakola. N’amubuuza abo be baali, gye baava, ne gye baali bagenda, n’amubuulira. Awo n’amuwa amagezi nti bw’anaagolokoka ku makya abakube awatali kusaasira. Kale bwe yagolokoka, n’afuna omuggo omunene ogw’omuti omukakanyavu, n’aserengeta mu kkomera gye bali, n’asooka okubavuma ng’abavuma embwa, newakubadde nga tebaamugambako kigambo kya kumunyiiza. Awo n’abagwira, n’abakuba mu ngeri ey’entiisa, n’okuba nti tebaasobola kwekuuma, wadde okwekyusa wansi. Bwe yamala ekyo, n’avaawo n’abaleka awo bakaabire ennaku yaabwe, era bakungubagire mu buzibu bwabwe: bwe batyo olunaku olwo lwonna ne baluyitamu nga tebakola kirala okuggyako okusinda n’okukaaba okw’obulumi. Ekiro ekyaddako, mukazi we, bwe yali ayogera ne bba ate ku bo, n’ategeera nti baali bakyali balamu, n’amuwa amagezi abagambe beetta bokka. Bwe bwakya enkya, n’agenda gye bali n’ekkayu, nga bwe yasooka, era bwe yalaba nga balumwa nnyo olw’emiggo gye yabakuba olunaku olwasooka, n’abagamba nti, okuva bwe kiri nti tebagenda kuva mu kifo ekyo, ekkubo lyabwe lyokka kwe kwetta mangu ddala, oba n’akambe, oba n’omuguwa, oba n’obutwa; kubanga lwaki, bwe yagamba, mwagala okuba abalamu, ng’obulamu bujjudde obulumi bwe butyo? Naye ne bamwegayirira abaleke bagende. Awo n’abatunuulira n’obukambwe, n’abafubutukira, era yandibadde abamazeewo yekka, singa teyakwatibwa nsimbu ze (kubanga oluusi mu budde obw’omusana ensimbu zaamukwatanga), n’amala akaseera nga talina maanyi mu mikono gye; n’olwekyo n’avaawo, n’abaleka nga bwe baali okulowooza kye banaakola. Awo abasibe ne beebuuzaganya bokka obanga kyali kirungi okukkiriza amagezi ge oba nedda; era bwe batyo ne batandika okwogera:

Omukristaayo: Muganda wange, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba, tunaakola tutya? Obulamu bwe tulimu kaakano bwa nnaku nnyo. Nze ku lwange, simanyi obanga kirungi okubeera abalamu bwe tuti, oba okufa amangu ddala. Emmeeme yange yeegomba okwetuga okusinga okuba omulamu, n’entaana empanguyira okusinga ekkomera lino. Yobu 7:15. Tunaagondera omuwagguufu?
