Omukristaayo: Ffembi twawulira, era tukkiriza, nti ekifo ng’ekyo kiriwo era kiyinza okuzuulibwa.

Atakkiriza-Katonda: Singa saakikkiriza nga ndi eka, sandizze wano wala bw’ati okunoonya; naye bwe ssaakizuula (so nga nnandikizudde, singa ekifo ng’ekyo kyaliwo okuzuulibwa, kubanga nnoonyezza wala okubasinga), nzirayo, era nja kunoonya okwewummuza mu bintu bye nnasuula olw’okusuubira ekyo kye ndaba kaakano nti tekiriiwo.

Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba Asuubira munne nti, Kituufu omusajja ono ky’ayogedde?

Asuubira: Weegendereze, oyo omu ku Bawaanirizi. Jjukira ekyo kye kyatufiiriza omulundi gumu olw’okuwuliriza abantu ng’abo. Kiki! Olusozi Sayuuni terubaawo? Tetwalaba ku Nsozi Ennungi Ennyo omulyango gw’ekibuga? Ate era, kaakano tetuteekwa kutambula lwa kukkiriza? 2 Abakkolinso 5:7.

Tweyongereyo, omusajja alina kibooko aleme okututuukako nate. Ggwe wandinjigirizza essomo eryo, lye nja kukuyimbira mu matu: “Mwana wange konoolekayo okuyigirizibwa, onoowaba okuva ku bigambo by’okumanya.” Engero 19:27. Nkugamba, muganda wange, lekera awo okumuwuliriza, tubeere n’okukkiriza okulokola emmeeme.

Omukristaayo: Muganda wange, sakubuuzizza kibuuzo ekyo lwa kubanga nze kennyini nnali mbuusabuusa amazima g’okukkiriza kwaffe, wabula okukugezesa, n’okuggya mu ggwe ekibala ky’obwesimbu bw’omutima gwo. Ku musajja ono, mmanyi nti yazibikirwa katonda w’emirembe gino. Ggwe nange tweyongereyo, nga tumanyi nti tulina okukkiriza mu mazima; era tewali bulimba buva mu mazima. 1 Yokaana, 5:21.

Asuubira: Kaakano nsanyuka nga nsuubira ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Awo ne bava ku musajja oyo; naye ye n’abasekerera, n’akwata ekkubo lye.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga batambula okutuusa lwe baatuuka mu nsi emu, empewo yaayo gye yali ereeta otulo ku buli mugenyi agiyingiramu. Era wano Asuubira n’atandika okuzitoowererwa ennyo, ng’otulo tumuyinze; kyeyava agamba Omukristaayo nti, Kaakano ntandise okubongoota nnyo, nnemereddwa n’okuzibula amaaso gange; ka tugalamire wano tuwugulemu otulo katono.

Omukristaayo: Nedda n’akatono, bw’atyo munne bwe yagamba; sikulwa nga twebaka ne tutazuukuka nate.

Asuubira: Lwaki, muganda wange? Otulo tuwoomera omupakasi; tuyinza okuwummulamu bwe tunaawugulamu otulo.

Omukristaayo: Tojjukira nti omu ku basumba yatulabula okwegendereza Ettaka Eddogo? Yali ategeeza nti twegendereze okwebaka; noolwekyo “tuleme kwebaka ng’abalala naye tutunulenga okwegomba kuleme okutufuga.” 1 Basessaloniika 5:6.

Asuubira: Nzikirizza nti nsobye; singa nnali wano nzekka, okwebaka kwandinteeka mu kabi k’okufa. Ndaba nga kituufu omugezi ky’agamba nti, “Ababiri basinga omu.” Omubuulizi 4:9. Okutuusa kaakano okubeera naawe kubadde kisa gye ndi; era ojja kufuna empeera ennungi olw’okufuba kwo.

Omukristaayo: Kale nno, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba, okuziyiza otulo mu kifo kino, ka tunyumye emboozi ennungi.

Asuubira: N’omutima gwange gwonna, munne bwe yagamba.

Omukristaayo: Tutandike wa?

Asuubira: Katonda gye yatandikira naffe. Naye ggwe tandika, bw’oba oyagala.

Omukristaayo: Ka nsooke nkuyimbire oluyimba luno:

“Abatukuvu bwe batandika okubongoota, bajje wano,

Bawulire abatambuze bano ababiri bwe banyumya;

Weewaawo, bayigire ku bo mu ngeri yonna

Okukuuma amaaso gaabwe agajjudde otulo nga gazibuse.

Okussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu, bwe kukwatibwa obulungi,

Kubakuuma nga batunula, ne geyena ne bw’eba nga teyagala.”

Awo Omukristaayo n’atandika, n’agamba nti, Ka nkubuuze ekibuuzo. Wasooka otya okulowooza okukola kino ky’okola kaakano?

Asuubira: Otegeeza nti nnasooka ntya okufaayo ku bulungi bw’emmeeme yange?

Omukristaayo: Ye, ekyo kye ntegeeza.

Asuubira: Nnamala ebbanga ddene nga nsanyukira ebintu ebyalabikanga era ebyatundibwanga mu katale kaffe; ebintu bye nzikiriza kaakano nti, singa nneeyongera okubibeeramu, byandinnyikizza mu kubula ne mu kuzikirira.

Omukristaayo: Byali bintu ki?

Asuubira: Obugagga n’eby’omuwendo byonna eby’ensi. Era nnasanyukiranga nnyo ekivuluvulu, embaga ez’obutamiivu, okunywa omwenge, okulayira, okulimba, obugwagwa, okumenya Ssabbiiti, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo ebyali bizikiriza emmeeme. Naye ku nkomerero nnakizuula, bwe nnawulira era ne nfumiitiriza ku bintu bya Katonda, bye nnawulira okuva gy’oli, era n’okuva eri Omwesigwa omwagalwa, eyattibwa olw’okukkiriza kwe n’obulamu bwe obulungi mu Katale k’Obutaliimu, nti enkomerero y’ebintu ebyo kufa, Abaruumi 6:21-23; era nti olw’ebintu ebyo, obusungu bwa Katonda bujja ku baana abajeemu. Abaefeso 5:6.

Omukristaayo: Era amangu ago wakkiriza okulumirizibwa kuno okukufuga?

Asuubira: Nedda, saayagala mangu kumanya bubi bwa kibi, wadde okusalirwa omusango okugoberera abo abakikola; naye nnafubanga, ebirowoozo byange bwe byasooka okukankanyizibwa ekigambo, okuziba amaaso gange obutalaba kitangaala kyakyo.

Omukristaayo: Naye kiki ekyakuleetera okweyisa bw’otyo eri emirimu egyasooka egy’Omwoyo wa Katonda omutendereze ku ggwe?

Asuubira: Ensonga zaali bwe ziti: 1. Saamanya nti guno gwali mulimu gwa Katonda mu nze. Sirowoozangako nti Katonda atandika okukyusa omwonoonyi ng’amuzuukusa okulaba ekibi kye. 2. Ekibi kyali kikyawoomera nnyo omubiri gwange, era saayagala kukireka. 3. Saamanya ngeri gye nnyinza kwawukana na banange ab’edda, kubanga okubeera nabo n’ebikolwa byabwe byansanyusanga nnyo. 4. Ebiseera okulumirizibwa mwe kwanzijiranga byali bya kutawaanya era bya kutiisa omutima nnyo, ne kiba nti sisobola kubigumiikiriza, nedda, wadde okubijjukira obujjukizi mu mutima gwange.

Omukristaayo: Kale, nga bwe kirabika, oluusi wawonanga obuzibu bwo?

Asuubira: Ye, ddala, naye bwakomangawo nate mu birowoozo byange; era awo nga mbeera mubi nga bwe nnali, nedda, nga nsinga n’edda obubi.

Omukristaayo: Kiki ekyakuzzangamu okujjukira ebibi byo?

Asuubira: Ebintu bingi; nga,

1. Bwe nnasisinkananga obusisinkanyi omuntu omulungi mu nguudo; oba,

2. Bwe nnawuliranga omuntu ng’asoma mu Bayibuli; oba,

3. Omutwe gwange bwe gwatandikanga okunnuma; oba,

4. Bwe nnabuulirwanga nti abamu ku baliraanwa bange balwadde; oba,

5. Bwe nnawuliranga ekide nga kivuga olw’abo abaafudde; oba,

6. Bwe nnalowoozanga ku kufa kwange nze; oba,

7. Bwe nnawuliranga nti abalala bafudde kibwatukira.

8. Naye okusingira ddala bwe nnalowoozanga ku nze kennyini nti nnina okutuuka amangu mu musango.

Omukristaayo: Era wasobolanga, buli lwe wayagalanga, okwejjako omusango gw’ekibi, bwe gwakujjiranga mu ngeri yonna ku ngeri ezo?

Asuubira: Nedda, si nze; kubanga awo byeyongeranga okunyweza omuntu wange ow’omunda; era awo, bwe nnalowoozanga obulowooza okudda mu kibi, (newaakubadde ng’ebirowoozo byange byali bikikyaye,) kyabanga kubonaabona kwa mirundi ebiri gye ndi.

Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola otya?

Asuubira: Nnalowooza nti nnina okufuba okutereeza obulamu bwange; kubanga bwe kitaba ekyo, bwe nnalowooza, ddala nja kusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira.

Omukristaayo: Era wafuba okwetereeza?

Asuubira: Ye, era nnadduka, si ku bibi byange byokka, naye ne ku banywanyi aboonoonyi, ne nneewaayo ku mirimu gy’eddiini, ng’okusaba, okusoma, okukaaba olw’ekibi, okwogera amazima eri baliraanwa bange, n’ebirala. Ebyo nnabikola, wamu n’ebirala bingi, bingi nnyo okubinyumya wano.

Omukristaayo: Era awo walowooza nti oli bulungi?

Asuubira: Ye, okumala akaseera; naye ku nkomerero obuzibu bwange ne bunzirira nate nga bunkulukuntira, ne busukka ne ku kwetereeza kwange kwonna.

Omukristaayo: Ekyo kyajja kitya, ng’ate wali weetereezezza?

Asuubira: Waaliwo ebintu bingi ebyakundeetera, naddala ebigambo nga bino: “obutuukirivu bwaffe buli nga nziina ezijjudde obukyafu.” Isaaya 64:6. “tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa eby’amateeka.” Abaggalatiya 2:16. “bwe mumalanga okutuukiriza ebyo ebyabagambibwa okukola, mugambenga nti, Ffe abaddu bo abatasaanira,” Lukka 17:10; n’ebirala bingi ebiringa ebyo. Awo ne ntandika okwekubaganya ebirowoozo bwe nti: Bwe kiba nga obutuukirivu bwange bwonna buli nga nziina ezijjudde obukyafu; bwe kiba nga olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka tewali muntu ayinza kuweebwa butuukirivu; era bwe kiba nga, bwe tumala okukola byonna, tukyali abatasaanira, kale busirusiru bwereere okulowooza okutuuka mu ggulu olw’amateeka. Ate ne nneeyongera okulowooza bwe nti: Omuntu bw’abeera n’ebbanja lya pawundi kikumi mu dduuka, oluvannyuma n’asasulira buli ky’aggyayo; naye ng’ebbanja lye ery’edda likyali mu kitabo nga terisaziddwamu, nnannyini dduuka ayinza okumuwawabira, n’amusuula mu kkomera, okutuusa lw’alisasula ebbanja eryo.

Omukristaayo: Kale, ekyo wakikwasaganya otya ku ggwe kennyini?

Asuubira: Nnalowooza bwe nti mu mutima gwange: Olw’ebibi byange nneewandiisizza ebbanja ddene mu kitabo kya Katonda, era okwetereeza kwange okwa kaakano tekuyinza kusasula bbanja eryo; noolwekyo nnina okweyongera okwebuuza, wakati mu kwetereeza kwange kwonna okwa kaakano, nti, Naye nnaawona ntya okusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira, gwe nneereetera olw’ebyonoono byange eby’edda?

Omukristaayo: Okukwasaganya okulungi ennyo: naye nkwegayiridde weeyongere.

Asuubira: Ekintu ekirala ekintawaanyizza okuva lwe nnetereeza, kiri nti bwe neetegereza obulungi ebisinga obulungi bye nkola kaakano, nkyalaba ekibi, ekibi ekiggya, nga kyetabula n’ebisinga obulungi bye nkola; ne kiba nti kaakano mpaliriziddwa okusalawo nti, newaakubadde nga edda nneerowoozangako nnyo mu busirusiru, nze n’emirimu gyange, nkola ekibi ekimala mu lunaku lumu okunsindika mu geyena, ne bwe kiba nti obulamu bwange obw’edda tebwalina kamogo.

Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola ki?

Asuubira: Okukola! Saamanya kya kukola, okutuusa lwe nnabuulira Omwesigwa ebyali ku mutima gwange; kubanga ye nange twali tumanyaganye bulungi. N’aŋŋamba nti okuggyako nga nfunye obutuukirivu bw’omuntu atayonoonangako n’akatono, obutuukirivu bwange, wadde obutuukirivu bwonna obw’ensi, tebuyinza kundokola.

Omukristaayo: Era walowooza nti yayogera mazima?

Asuubira: Singa yali aŋŋambye bw’atyo nga nkyali musanyufu era nga nneemalidde mu kwetereeza kwange, nnandimuyise musirusiru olw’obuzibu bwe; naye kaakano, bwe ndaba obunafu bwange, n’ekibi ekyekwata ku bisinga obulungi bye nkola, mpaliriziddwa okukkiriziganya naye.

Omukristaayo: Naye walowooza, bwe yasooka okukikubuulira, nti waliwo omuntu ng’oyo ayinza okuzuulwa, ayinza okwogerwako mu butuufu nti tayonoonangako?

Asuubira: Nzikiriza nti ebigambo ebyo byasooka okumpulikika ng’ebyewuunyisa; naye oluvannyuma lw’okwogera naye akatono n’okubeera naye, nnakakasa ddala.

Omukristaayo: Era wamubuuza omuntu oyo y’ani, n’engeri gy’olina okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bubwe?

Asuubira: Ye, era n’aŋŋamba nti ye Mukama waffe Yesu, abeera ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogw’Ali Waggulu Ennyo. Abaebbulaniya 10:12-21. Era bw’atyo, bwe yagamba, olina okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bubwe, nga weesiga bye yakola ye kennyini mu nnaku ez’omubiri gwe, n’ebyo bye yabonyaabonyezebwa bwe yawanikibwa ku muti. Abaruumi 4:5; Abakkolosaayi 1:14; 1 Peetero 1:19. Ne nneeyongera okumubuuza, obutuukirivu bw’omuntu oyo buyinza butya okuba n’amaanyi ago, okuweesa omulala obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda. N’aŋŋamba nti ye yali Katonda ow’amaanyi, era bye yakola yabikola, era n’afa n’okufa, si ku lulwe, wabula ku lwange; era nti bye yakola, n’obulungi bwabyo, byandimbaliddwa nze, singa mmukkiriza.

Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola ki?

Asuubira: Nnaleeta ensonga ezinziyiza okukkiriza, kubanga nnalowooza nti teyali mwetegefu kundokola.

Omukristaayo: Kale Omwesigwa yakugamba ki awo?

Asuubira: Yaŋŋamba ŋŋende gy’ali ndabe. Ne mmugamba nti okwo kwandibadde kwemanya. N’agamba nti, Nedda; kubanga nnali mpitiddwa okujja. Matayo 11:28. Awo n’ampa ekitabo ekyawandiikibwa Yesu, okunzizaamu amaanyi okujja n’obuteefiirayo; era n’agamba ku kitabo ekyo, nti buli nnukuta na buli kabonero kaakyo binywevu okusinga eggulu n’ensi. Matayo 24:35. Awo ne mmubuuza kye nnina okukola bwe nnaatuuka; n’aŋŋamba nti nnina okwegayirira nga nfukamidde, Zabbuli 95:6; Danyeri 6:10, n’omutima gwange gwonna n’emmeeme yange yonna, Yeremiya 29:12,13, Kitaffe ambikkulire ye. Awo ne nneeyongera okumubuuza, engeri gye nnina okumwegayiriramu; n’agamba nti, Genda, ojja kumusanga ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, gy’atuula omwaka gwonna okusonyiwa n’okuggyako emisango abo abajja. Okuva 25:22; Ebyabaleevi 16:2; Okubala 7:89; Abaebbulaniya 4:16. Ne mmugamba nti saamanyi kya kwogera bwe nnaatuuka; n’aŋŋamba njogere bwe nti: Katonda, onsaasire, nze omwonoonyi, era onsobozese okumanya Yesu Kristo n’okumukkiriza; kubanga ndaba nti singa obutuukirivu bwe tebwaliwo, oba singa siba na kukkiriza mu butuukirivu obwo, nsuuliddwa ddala. Mukama, mpulidde nti oli Katonda omusaasizi, era nti walagira Omwana wo Yesu Kristo abeere Omulokozi w’ensi; era n’okusingawo, nti oyagala okumuwa omwonoonyi omwavu nga nze—era ddala ndi mwonoonyi. Mukama, kale kozesa omukisa guno, ogulumize ekisa kyo mu kulokola emmeeme yange, ku bw’Omwana wo Yesu Kristo. Amiina.

Omukristaayo: Era wakola nga bwe wagambibwa?

Asuubira: Ye, emirundi n’emirundi, n’emirundi.

Omukristaayo: Era Kitaffe yakubikkulira Omwana?

Asuubira: Si mu mulundi ogusooka, wadde ogwokubiri, wadde ogwokusatu, wadde ogwokuna, wadde ogwokutaano, nedda, wadde ogwomukaaga.

Omukristaayo: Awo wakola ki?

Asuubira: Ki? Saamanya kya kukola.

Omukristaayo: Tewalowooza kulekera awo kusaba?

Asuubira: Ye; emirundi kikumi emirundi ebiri.

Omukristaayo: Kale lwaki tewalekera awo?

Asuubira: Nnakkiriza nti kyali kituufu kye nnali mbuuliddwa, kwe kugamba nti awatali butuukirivu bwa Kristo ono, ensi yonna teyinza kundokola; noolwekyo, ne ndowooza mu mutima gwange, bwe ndekera awo, nfa, ate bwe nfa, nfiire ku ntebe ey’ekisa. Era wamu n’ekyo ne kinzijira mu birowoozo, “Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa.” Kaabakuuku 2:3. Bwe ntyo ne nneeyongera okusaba okutuusa Kitaffe lwe yandaga Omwana we.

Omukristaayo: Era yakubikkulirwa atya?

Asuubira: Saamulaba na maaso gange ag’omubiri, wabula n’amaaso g’okutegeera kwange, Abaefeso 1:18,19; era bwe kyali bwe kiti. Lumu nnali nnakuwadde nnyo, ndowooza okusinga ekiseera ekirala kyonna mu bulamu bwange; era ennaku eno yava ku kulaba buggya obunene n’obugwagwa bw’ebibi byange. Era bwe nnali sirina kye nsuubira okuggyako geyena, n’okuzikirira okutaggwaawo okw’emmeeme yange, amangwago, nga bwe nnalowooza, ne ndaba Mukama waffe Yesu ng’antunuulira okuva mu ggulu, ng’agamba nti, “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.” Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:31.

Naye ne muddamu nti, Mukama, ndi mwonoonyi munene, mwonoonyi munene nnyo: n’anziramu nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala.” 2 Abakkolinso 12:9. Awo ne ŋŋamba nti, Naye, Mukama, okukkiriza kye ki? Awo ne ntegeera okuva mu kigambo ekyo, “Ajja gye ndi enjala teriddayo kumuluma, era abo abanzikiriza tebaliddayo kulumwa nnyonta,” Yokaana 6:35, nti okukkiriza n’okujja kintu kimu; era nti oyo eyajja, kwe kugamba, eyadduka n’omutima gwe n’okwagala kwe okunoonya obulokozi mu Kristo, ddala yakkiriza Kristo. Awo amaziga ne gajjula mu maaso gange, ne nneeyongera okubuuza nti, Naye, Mukama, omwonoonyi omunene nga nze ddala ayinza okukkirizibwa gy’oli, n’alokolebwa ggwe? Ne mmuwulira ng’agamba nti, “era buli ajja gye ndi sirimugobera bweru.” Yokaana 6:37. Awo ne ŋŋamba nti, Naye, Mukama, nnina kukulowoozaako ntya nga nzija gy’oli, okukkiriza kwange kulyoke kukussibweko bulungi? Awo n’agamba nti, “Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi.” 1 Timoseewo 1:15. Ye nkomerero y’amateeka olw’obutuukirivu eri buli akkiriza. Abaruumi 10:4, n’essuula 4. Yaweebwayo okuttibwa olw’ebibi byaffe, n’azuukizibwa tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu. Abaruumi 4:25. Yatwagala, n’atuggya mu bibi byaffe n’omusaayi gwe. Okubikkulirwa 1:5. Ye mutabaganya wa Katonda naffe. 1 Timoseewo 2:5. Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okutuwolereza. Abaebbulaniya 7:25. Okuva mu byonna ebyo ne nzuula nti nnina okunoonya obutuukirivu mu ye kennyini, n’okutangirira ebibi byange mu musaayi gwe; nti bye yakola mu kugondera amateeka ga Kitaawe, n’okugonda ku kibonerezo kyago, teyabikola ku lulwe, wabula ku lw’oyo anaabikkiriza olw’obulokozi bwe, n’asiima. Era kaakano omutima gwange ne gujjula essanyu, amaaso gange ne gajjula amaziga, n’okwagala kwange ne kukulukuta eri erinnya, abantu, n’amakubo ga Yesu Kristo.

Omukristaayo: Ddala okwo kwali kubikkulirwa kwa Kristo mu mmeeme yo. Naye mbuulira mu bujjuvu ekyo kyakola ki ku mwoyo gwo.

Asuubira: Kyandaga nti ensi yonna, newaakubadde n’obutuukirivu bwayo bwonna, eri mu mbeera ey’okusalirwa omusango. Kyandaga nti Katonda Kitaffe, newaakubadde nga mutuukirivu, ayinza mu butuukirivu okuwa omwonoonyi ajja obutuukirivu. Kyankwasa ensonyi nnyo olw’obugwagwa bw’obulamu bwange obw’edda, ne kinswaza olw’okutegeera obutamanya bwange; kubanga tewali kirowoozo kyali kizze mu mutima gwange okutuusa kaakano ekyandaga bwe kityo obulungi bwa Yesu Kristo. Kyanjagaza obulamu obutukuvu, ne neegomba okukola ekintu ku lw’ekitiibwa n’ettendo ly’erinnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu. Weewaawo, nnalowooza nti singa kaakano nnina ebidomola by’omusaayi lukumi mu mubiri gwange, nnandibuyiye gwonna ku lwa Mukama waffe Yesu.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange, Asuubira ng’atunula emabega, n’alaba Obutamanya, gwe baali balese emabega, ng’ajja ng’abagoberera. Laba, bwe yagamba Omukristaayo, omuvubuka oli bw’asigadde emabega ewala.

Omukristaayo: Ye, ye, mmulaba: tafaayo ku kubeera naffe.

Asuubira: Naye ndowooza tekyandimukoze kabi, singa abadde atambula naffe okutuusa kaakano.

Omukristaayo: Ekyo kituufu; naye nkukakasa nti ye alowooza bulala.

Asuubira: Ekyo ndowooza bw’akirowooza; naye, ka tumulindeko. (Bwe batyo ne bakola.)

Awo Omukristaayo n’amugamba nti, Jjangu, ssebo; lwaki osigala emabega bw’otyo?

Obutamanya: Nze nsanyukira okutambula nzekka, okusinga ennyo okutambula n’abalala, okuggyako nga be ntambula nabo bannyumira.

Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba Asuubira, (naye mpola,) Saakugambye nti tafaayo ku kubeera naffe? Naye, bwe yagamba, jjangu, tunyumye tuyiseewo ebiseera mu kifo kino ekyesudde. Awo, n’akyuka n’ayogera n’Obutamanya, n’agamba nti, Kale, oli otya? Wakati wa Katonda n’emmeeme yo kaakano kiri kitya?

Obutamanya: Nsuubira nti bulungi; kubanga buli kiseera nzijudde ebirowoozo ebirungi, ebinzijira okunzizaamu amaanyi nga ntambula.

Omukristaayo: Birowoozo ki ebirungi? Tubuulire.

Obutamanya: Nze ndowooza ku Katonda ne ku ggulu.

Omukristaayo: Ne baddayimooni n’emmeeme ezazikirira bwe bakola.

Obutamanya: Naye nze mbirowoozaako, era mbyegomba.

Omukristaayo: Bwe batyo bwe bakola bangi abatagenda kutuukayo n’akatono. “Omuntu omugayaavu yeegomba kyokka n’atabaako ky’afuna.” Engero 13:4.

Obutamanya: Naye mbirowoozaako, era ndeka byonna ku lwabyo.

Omukristaayo: Ekyo nkibuusabuusa: kubanga okuleka byonna kintu kizibu nnyo; weewaawo, kizibu okusinga bangi bwe bamanyi. Naye lwaki, oba kiki ekikukakasa nti walekera ddala byonna ku lwa Katonda n’eggulu?

Obutamanya: Omutima gwange gwe gumbuulira bwe gutyo.

Omukristaayo: Omugezi agamba nti, “Eyeesiga omutima gwe, musirusiru.” Engero 28:26.

Obutamanya: Ekyo kyogerwa ku mutima omubi; naye ogwange mulungi.

Omukristaayo: Naye ekyo okikakasa otya?

Obutamanya: Gunzizaamu amaanyi nga nsuubira eggulu.

Omukristaayo: Ekyo kiyinza okuva mu bulimba bwagwo; kubanga omutima gw’omuntu guyinza okumugumya ng’asuubira ekintu ky’atalinamu musingi gwonna ogw’okusuubira.

Obutamanya: Naye omutima gwange n’obulamu bwange bikwatagana; noolwekyo essuubi lyange lirina omusingi omunywevu.

Omukristaayo: Ani yakugamba nti omutima gwo n’obulamu bwo bikwatagana?

Obutamanya: Omutima gwange gwe gumbuulira bwe gutyo.

Omukristaayo: “Buuza munnange obanga ndi mubbi.” Omutima gwo gwe gukubuulira bwe gutyo! Okuggyako ng’ekigambo kya Katonda kye kiwa obujulirwa ku nsonga eno, obujulirwa obulala tebulina mugaso.

Obutamanya: Naye omutima ogulina ebirowoozo ebirungi si mutima mulungi? era obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda si bulamu bulungi?

Omukristaayo: Ye, omutima ogulina ebirowoozo ebirungi mutima mulungi, n’obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda bulamu bulungi; naye ddala kirala okuba nabyo, era kirala okulowooza obulowooza nti obirina.

Obutamanya: Nkwegayiridde, ggwe ebirowoozo ebirungi obitwala kuba ki, n’obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda?

Omukristaayo: Waliwo ebirowoozo ebirungi eby’engeri nnyingi; ebimu bikwata ku ffe, ebimu ku Katonda, ebimu ku Kristo, n’ebimu ku bintu ebirala.

Obutamanya: Birowoozo ki ebirungi ebikwata ku ffe?

Omukristaayo: Ebyo ebikwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda.

Obutamanya: Ebirowoozo byaffe ku ffe bikwatagana ddi n’ekigambo kya Katonda?

Omukristaayo: Bwe twesalira omusango gwe gumu ekigambo gwe kitusalira. Okunnyonnyola: ekigambo kya Katonda kigamba ku bantu abali mu mbeera yaabwe ey’obuzaaliranwa nti, “Tewali mutuukirivu n’omu, tewali n’omu akola obulungi.” Era kigamba nti, “buli ndowooza y’omutima gw’omuntu mbi njereere ebbanga lyonna.” Olubereberye 6:5; Abaruumi 3. Era nate, “endowooza y’omutima gw’omuntu mbi okuva mu buto bwe.” Olubereberye 8:21. Kale nno, bwe tulowooza bwe tutyo ku ffe, nga tukitegedde, awo ebirowoozo byaffe biba birungi, kubanga bikwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda.

Obutamanya: Sirikkiriza n’akatono nti omutima gwange mubi bwe gutyo.

Omukristaayo: Noolwekyo tewabangako na kirowoozo kirungi kimu ku ggwe kennyini mu bulamu bwo bwonna. Naye ka nneeyongereyo. Ng’ekigambo bwe kisalira emitima gyaffe omusango, bwe kityo bwe kisalira n’amakubo gaffe omusango; era ebirowoozo by’emitima gyaffe n’amakubo gaffe bwe bikwatagana n’omusango ekigambo gwe kisala ku byombi, awo byombi biba birungi, kubanga bikwatagana nagwo.

Obutamanya: Nnyonnyola by’otegeeza.

Omukristaayo: Ekigambo kya Katonda kigamba nti amakubo g’omuntu makubo makyamu, si malungi wabula ga bujeemu; kigamba nti mu buzaaliranwa bwabwe bakyama okuva mu kkubo eddungi, nti tebalimanyangako. Zabbuli 125:5; Engero 2:15; Abaruumi 3:12. Kaakano, omuntu bw’alowooza bw’atyo ku makubo ge, nze ŋŋamba, bw’alowooza bw’atyo ng’akitegedde ddala, era n’omutima ogwetoowazizza, awo aba n’ebirowoozo ebirungi ku makubo ge, kubanga ebirowoozo bye kaakano bikwatagana n’omusango gw’ekigambo kya Katonda.

Obutamanya: Birowoozo ki ebirungi ebikwata ku Katonda?

Omukristaayo: Nga bwe nnyogedde ku ffe, bwe biba bwe bityo: ebirowoozo byaffe ku Katonda bwe bikwatagana n’ekigambo kye kyogera ku ye; era ekyo kiba bwe tulowooza ku bubeerawo bwe n’engeri ze nga ekigambo bwe kyayigiriza, ebyo bye siyinza kwogerako mu bujjuvu kaakano. Naye okwogera ku ye nga bw’akwatagana naffe: awo tuba n’ebirowoozo ebituufu ku Katonda bwe tulowooza nti atumanyi okusinga ffe bwe tumanyi ffe kennyini, era nti ayinza okulaba ekibi mu ffe ddi na wa we tutayinza kulaba na kimu mu ffe; bwe tulowooza nti amanyi ebirowoozo byaffe eby’omunda ennyo, era nti omutima gwaffe, n’obuziba bwagwo bwonna, buli kiseera gubikkuse mu maaso ge; era bwe tulowooza nti obutuukirivu bwaffe bwonna buwunya mu nnyindo ze, era nti noolwekyo tayinza kugumiikiriza kutulaba nga tuyimiridde mu maaso ge nga twekakasa, wadde mu mirimu gyaffe gyonna egisinga obulungi.

Obutamanya: Olowooza nti ndi musirusiru nnyo okulowooza nti Katonda tayinza kulaba wala okusinga nze; oba nti nnandizze eri Katonda nga nneesigama ku mirimu gyange egisinga obulungi?

Omukristaayo: Kale ggwe olowooza otya ku nsonga eno?

Obutamanya: Okumala mangu, ndowooza nti nnina okukkiriza Kristo okuweebwa obutuukirivu.

Omukristaayo: Ki! Olowooza nti olina okukkiriza Kristo, ate nga tolaba bwetaavu bwo gy’ali! Tolaba bunafu bwo obw’obuzaaliranwa wadde obw’ebikolwa byo; naye weerowoozaako nnyo, n’ebyo by’okola, mu ngeri eraga lwatu nti oli muntu atalabangako bwetaavu bwa butuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini okukuweesa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda. Kale oyinza otya okugamba nti, Nzikiriza Kristo?

Obutamanya: Nzikiriza bulungi ddala, newaakubadde ng’ebyo biri bityo.

Omukristaayo: Okkiriza otya?

Obutamanya: Nzikiriza nti Kristo yafiirira aboonoonyi; era nti nja kuweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda, ne nnunulibwa mu kikolimo, olw’ekisa kye ng’akkiriza obuwulize bwange eri amateeka ge. Oba bwe kiti: Kristo afuula emirimu gyange egy’eddiini okukkirizibwa Kitaawe olw’obulungi bwe, era bwe ntyo nja kuweebwa obutuukirivu.

Omukristaayo: Ka nziremu okwatula kuno okw’okukkiriza kwo.

1. Okkiriza n’okukkiriza kwe weegunjira; kubanga okukkiriza kuno tekunnyonnyolwa wonna mu kigambo.

2. Okkiriza n’okukkiriza okw’obulimba; kubanga kuggya okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku butuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini, ne kukuteeka ku bubwo.

3. Okukkiriza kuno tekufuula Kristo oyo akuweesa obutuukirivu ggwe kennyini, wabula aweesa ebikolwa byo; era akuweesa ggwe olw’ebikolwa byo, ekyo nga si kituufu.

4. Noolwekyo okukkiriza kuno kwa bulimba, kwe kuli okunaakuleka wansi w’obusungu ku lunaku lwa Katonda Ayinzabyonna: kubanga okukkiriza okw’amazima okuweesa obutuukirivu kusindiikiriza emmeeme, eyategedde okubula kwayo olw’amateeka, okuddukira mu butuukirivu bwa Kristo; (obutuukirivu bwe obwo si kikolwa kya kisa ky’akola, okuweebwa obutuukirivu, n’afuula obuwulize bwo okukkirizibwa Katonda, wabula buwulize bwe ye kennyini eri amateeka, mu kukola n’okubonyaabonyezebwa ku lwaffe ebyo amateeka bye gaali gatusaba;) obutuukirivu buno, nze ŋŋamba, okukkiriza okw’amazima kwe kubukkiriza; era emmeeme bw’ebikkibwa wansi w’ekyambalo kyabwo, n’eyanjulwa nabwo nga terina bbala mu maaso ga Katonda, ekkirizibwa, era n’esumululwa okuva mu kusalirwa omusango.

Obutamanya: Ki! Oyagala twesige ebyo Kristo bye yakola ye kennyini awatali ffe? Endowooza eyo yandisumuludde enkoba z’okwegomba kwaffe, n’etukkiriza okubeera nga bwe twagala: kubanga kigasa ki engeri gye tubeeramu, bwe tuba nga tuyinza okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’obutuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini okuva mu byonna, bwe tubukkiriza?

Omukristaayo: Obutamanya lye linnya lyo, era nga erinnya lyo bwe liri, bw’oli bw’otyo: n’okuddamu kwo kuno kulaga kye njogera. Tomanyi butuukirivu obuweesa obutuukirivu kye buli, era tomanyi bw’otyo engeri y’okuwonya emmeeme yo, olw’okukkiriza mu bwo, okuva mu busungu bwa Katonda obuzito. Weewaawo, era tomanyi bibala bya mazima eby’okukkiriza okulokola mu butuukirivu buno obwa Kristo, kwe kufukamiza omutima n’okugukyusa eri Katonda mu Kristo, okwagala erinnya lye, ekigambo kye, amakubo ge, n’abantu be, so si nga ggwe bw’olowooza mu butamanya bwo.

Asuubira: Mubuuze obanga yali abikkuliddwa Kristo okuva mu ggulu.

Obutamanya: Ki! Ggwe oli muntu wa bubikkulirwa! Nzikiriza nti ebyo byonna ggwe n’abalala bonna bye mwogera ku nsonga eyo, bibala bya bwongo obutabuse.

Asuubira: Ssebo, Kristo akwekeddwa nnyo mu Katonda okuva ku kutegeera okw’obuzaaliranwa okw’omubiri, n’aba nga tayinza kumanyibwa muntu yenna mu ngeri ey’okulokola, okuggyako nga Katonda Kitaffe amumubikkulidde.

Obutamanya: Okwo kwe kukkiriza kwo, naye si kwange; kyokka okwange, sikibuusabuusa, kulungi nga okwo, newaakubadde nga sirina mu mutwe gwange birooto bingi ng’ebibyo.

Omukristaayo: Ka nyingizeemu ekigambo. Tosaanye kwogera ku nsonga eno mu ngeri ey’okunyooma bw’otyo: kubanga kino nkikakasa n’obuvumu, nga munnange omulungi bw’akoze, nti tewali muntu ayinza kumanya Yesu Kristo wabula olw’okubikkulirwa kwa Kitaffe: weewaawo, n’okukkiriza nakwo, emmeeme kwe yeekwatira Kristo, (bwe kuba nga kutuufu,) kulina okukolebwa amaanyi ge agasukkiridde obukulu, Matayo 11:27; 1 Abakkolinso 12:3; Abaefeso 1:17-19; era okukola kw’okukkiriza okwo, ndaba, ggwe Obutamanya omwavu, tokumanyi. Kale, zuukuka, laba obunaku bwo, oddukire eri Mukama waffe Yesu; era olw’obutuukirivu bwe, obwo bwe butuukirivu bwa Katonda, (kubanga ye kennyini Katonda,) ojja kuwonyezebwa okusalirwa omusango.

Obutamanya: Mutambula mangu nnyo, sisobola kutambula nammwe; mwe mukulembere: nze nnina okusigala emabega akaseera.

Awo ne bagamba nti,

“Ggwe Obutamanya, onoosigala ng’oli musirusiru,

Okunyooma okubuulirira okulungi, kw’oweereddwa emirundi kkumi?

Era bw’onookugaana, ojja kumanya,

Mu bbanga ttono, obubi bw’ekyo ky’okola.

Jjukira, ssebo, nga bukyali: kkakkana, totya:

Okubuulirira okulungi, bwe kukkirizibwa, kulokola; kale wuliriza.

Naye bw’onookyeyongera okukunyooma, ojja kuba

Gwe afiiriddwa, Obutamanya, nkukakasa.”
fields.body_text: Awo ne nneebaka, ne nziramu okuloota, ne ndaba abatambuze bali bombi nga baserengeta ensozi nga bayita mu luguudo olunene nga boolekera ekibuga. Awo, wansi katono w’ensozi zino, ku mukono ogwa kkono, we wali ensi y’Amalala; okuva mu nsi eyo, waliwo akakubo akatono akakyamakyama akayingira mu kkubo abatambuze mwe baali batambulira. Wano ne basisinkana omuvubuka omujjumbizi ennyo eyali ava mu nsi eyo, erinnya lye nga ye Obutamanya. Omukristaayo n’amubuuza ebitundu gy’ava ne gy’agenda. Obutamanya: Ssebo, nnazaalibwa mu nsi eri eri, katono ku mukono ogwa kkono, era ŋŋenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu. Omukristaayo: Naye olowooza onooyingira otya mu mulyango, kubanga oyinza okusangayo obuzibu? Obutamanya: Nga abantu abalala abalungi bwe bayingira, bwe yagamba. Omukristaayo: Naye kiki ky’olina okulaga ku mulyango ogwo, omulyango ogwo gukuggulirwe? Obutamanya: Mmanyi Mukama wange by’ayagala, era mbadde n’obulamu obulungi; buli muntu mmusasula ekikye; nsaba, nsiiba, mpaayo ekimu eky’ekkumi, era ngaba ebirabo eri abaavu; era ndese ensi yange ne ŋŋenda eyo gye ndaga. Omukristaayo: Naye toyingirira mu Mulyango Omufunda oguli ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo lino; wayingirira wano ng’oyita mu kakubo kali akakyamakyama; n’olwekyo ntya nti, ne bw’oneerowoozaako otya, olunaku olw’okubalirirwa bwe lulituuka, olivunaanibwa nti oli mubbi era munyazi, mu kifo ky’okukkirizibwa okuyingira mu kibuga. Obutamanya: Bassebo, muli bannaggwanga ddala gye ndi; sibamanyi: mumatire okugoberera eddiini y’ensi yammwe, nange nja kugoberera ey’ensi yange. Nsuubira nti byonna binaaba bulungi. Ate ku mulyango gwe mwogerako, ensi yonna emanyi nti guli wala nnyo okuva mu nsi yaffe. Sirowooza nti waliwo omuntu yenna mu bitundu byaffe byonna amanyi wadde ekkubo erigutuukako; era tekibeetaagisa kufaayo oba balimanyi oba nedda, kubanga tulina, nga bwe mulaba, akakubo akalungi, akanyuma, akaliko omuddo omubisi, akava mu nsi yaffe ne kayingira butereevu mu kkubo. Omukristaayo bwe yalaba ng’omusajja oyo yeerowooza okuba omugezi, n’agamba Asuubira mu kaama nti, “Omusirusiru alina essuubi okumusinga.” Engero 26:12. N’ayongera n’agamba nti, “Ne bw’aba ng’atambula, amanyibwa nga talina magezi, era buli amulaba agamba nti musirusiru. Omubuulizi 10:3. Kale, twongere okwogera naye, oba tumuleke emabega kaakano, tumuleke afumiitirize ku bye yawulidde, oluvannyuma tumulindeko nate, tulabe oba mpolampola tuyinza okumuyamba? Awo Asuubira n’agamba nti, “Obutamanya k’afumiitirize akaseera Ku bigambo ebyogeddwa, era aleme kugaana Okukwata amagezi amalungi, aleme kusigala Nga tamanyi ekisinga byonna omugaso. Katonda agamba nti abo abatalina kutegeera, (Newaakubadde nga ye yabatonda,) tagenda kubalokola.” Asuubira: N’ayongera n’agamba nti, Ndowooza si kirungi okumugambira byonna omulundi gumu; tumuyiteko, bw’oba oyagala, twogere naye oluvannyuma, nga bw’anaasobola okubigumira. Awo bombi ne beeyongerayo, Obutamanya n’abavaako emabega. Awo bwe baali bamaze okumuyitako katono, ne bayingira mu kakubo akaddugavu ennyo, ne basanga omusajja baddayimooni musanvu gwe baali basibye n’emiguwa musanvu emigumu, nga bamuzzaayo ku luggi lwe baalaba ku mabbali g’olusozi. Matayo 12:45; Engero 5:22. Awo Omukristaayo omulungi n’atandika okukankana, era ne Asuubira munne bw’atyo; naye baddayimooni bwe baali batwala omusajja, Omukristaayo n’atunula alabe oba amumanyi; n’alowooza nti ayinza okuba omusajja ayitibwa Adda-Emabega, eyabeeranga mu Kibuga ky’Okuvaamu-Okukkiriza. Naye teyalaba bulungi maaso ge, kubanga yali akutamye omutwe ng’omubbi akwatiddwa; naye bwe yamala okubayitako, Asuubira n’amutunuulira ng’agenda, n’alaba ku mugongo gwe olupapula oluwandiikiddwako nti, “Eyeeyita omukkiriza omukaba, era eyavaamu okukkiriza agwanidde okuzikirira.” Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Kaakano nzijukira kye nnagambibwa ku kintu ekyatuuka ku musajja omulungi okumpi wano. Erinnya ly’omusajja oyo yali Akkiriza-Kitono, naye nga musajja mulungi, era yabeeranga mu Kibuga ky’Obwesimbu. Ekyatuuka kye kino. Awayingirirwa mu kkubo lino, waliwo akakubo akaserengeta okuva ku Mulyango gw’Oluguudo Olugazi, akayitibwa Akakubo k’Omufu; kaatuumibwa bwe kityo olw’obutemu obutera okukolerwa eyo; era Akkiriza-Kitono ono, bwe yali ng’atambula olugendo ng’omutambuze, nga ffe bwe tukola kaakano, n’agwa n’atuula awo ne yeebaka. Awo mu kiseera ekyo ne wabaawo abazigu basatu abagumu abaserengeta akakubo okuva ku Mulyango gw’Oluguudo Olugazi; amannya gaabwe nga ge Omutima-Omunafu, Atalina-Bwesige, ne Omusango, ab’oluganda basatu; era bwe baalaba Akkiriza-Kitono we yali, ne bajja nga badduka embiro. Omusajja omulungi yali yaakazuukuka mu tulo, ng’agolokoka okweyongerayo n’olugendo lwe. Awo bonna ne bamutuukako, ne bamulagira n’ebigambo eby’okutiisa ayimirire. Awo Akkiriza-Kitono n’atukula ng’olugoye olweru, n’atasobola kulwana wadde okudduka. Awo Omutima-Omunafu n’agamba nti, Leeta ensawo yo ey’ensimbi; naye bwe yalwawo okugiwaayo (kubanga yali tayagala kufiirwa ssente ze), Atalina-Bwesige n’amuddukira, n’ayingiza omukono mu nsawo ye, n’aggyamu akasawo k’effeeza. Awo n’akaaba nti, Babbi, babbi! Amangu ago Omusango, n’omuggo omunene gwe yali akutte mu ngalo, n’akuba Akkiriza-Kitono ku mutwe, n’ekikonde ekyo ne kimusuula wansi ku ttaka, n’agalamira awo ng’avaamu omusaayi ng’omuntu agenda okufa olw’omusaayi. Ebbanga eryo lyonna ababbi baali bayimiridde awo. Naye ku nkomerero, bwe baawulira ng’abantu abamu bajja mu kkubo, ne batya nti ayinza okuba omusajja ayitibwa Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi, abeera mu Kibuga ky’Obwesige-Obulungi, ne bakwata kkubo ne badduka, ne baleka omusajja omulungi ono yeerwaneko yekka. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera, Akkiriza-Kitono n’addamu amagezi, n’asituka, ne yeewalula okweyongerayo mu kkubo lye. Olwo lwe lugero. Asuubira: Naye baamuggyako byonna bye yalina? Omukristaayo: Nedda; ekifo amayinja ge ag’omuwendo we gaali tebaakisaka; n’olwekyo ago yasigala nago. Naye, nga bwe nnagambibwa, omusajja omulungi yanakuwala nnyo olw’ebyo bye yafiirwa; kubanga ababbi baatwala ssente ze ezisinga obungi ze yali akozesa mu lugendo. Bye bataatwala, nga bwe nnyogedde, gaali amayinja ag’omuwendo; era yasigazaako ne ssente ntono, naye nga kumpi tezimala kumutuusa ku nkomerero y’olugendo lwe. Weewaawo, (bwe kiba nga saalimbibwa,) yawalirizibwa okusabiriza nga bw’agenda, alyoke abeere omulamu, kubanga amayinja ge ag’omuwendo yali takkirizibwa kugatunda; naye ne bwe yasabiriza era n’akola kyonna kye yasobola, yatambula, nga bwe twogera, ng’enjala emuluma emirundi mingi okumala ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’ekkubo eryasigalawo. 1 Peetero 4:18. Asuubira: Naye si kyewuunyo nti tebaamuggyako kiwandiiko kye, kye yali agenda okukozesa okukkirizibwa okuyingira ku Mulyango gw’Eggulu? Omukristaayo: Kyewuunyo ddala; naye ekyo tebaakitwala, newaakubadde nga tebaakisubwa lwa magezi ge; kubanga ye, bwe yatya olw’okumugwako kwabwe, teyalina maanyi wadde amagezi okukweka ekintu kyonna; n’olwekyo ekyabaleetera okusubwa ekirungi ekyo kyali kikolwa kya Katonda okumulabirira okusinga okufuba kwe. 2 Timoseewo 1:12-14; 2 Peetero 2:9. Asuubira: Naye kiteekwa okuba nga kyamugumya nti tebaamuggyako jjinja eryo ery’omuwendo. Omukristaayo: Kyandimugumizza nnyo, singa yalikozesa nga bwe yasaanidde; naye abo abaŋŋamba olugero baagamba nti yalikozesanga kitono nnyo mu kkubo lyonna eryasigalawo, olw’entiisa gye yafuna bwe baamuggyako ssente ze. Mazima, yalyerabira okumala ekitundu kinene eky’olugendo lwe olwasigalawo; era n’ekirala, buli lwe lyamujjiranga mu birowoozo n’atandika okubudaabudibwa nalyo, ebirowoozo ebiggya ku kufiirwa kwe byamukomangako, ne bimira byonna. Asuubira: Woowe, omusajja omwavu, kino tekyalema kumunakuwaza nnyo. Omukristaayo: Ennaku? Yee, ennaku ddala! Tekyandibadde bwe kityo eri buli omu ku ffe, singa twayisibwa nga ye, okubbibwa era n’okulumizibwa, era ng’ekyo kibeera mu kifo ekitamanyiddwa, nga bwe kyali gy’ali? Kyewuunyo nti teyafa lwa nnaku, omwavu oyo. Nnagambibwa nti kumpi mu kkubo lyonna eryasigalawo yasaasaanyanga okwemulugunya kwokka okw’ennaku n’obukaawu; ng’abuulira buli eyamutuukako, oba gwe yatuukako mu kkubo nga bw’agenda, we yabbirwa ne bwe yabbibwa; abaakikola be baani, ne bye yafiirwa; bwe yalumizibwa, era nti yawona okufa kitono. Asuubira: Naye kyewuunyo nti obwetaavu bwe tebwamuwaliriza kutunda oba kusingayo agamu ku mayinja ge ag’omuwendo, afune kye yandyeyambisizza mu lugendo lwe. Omukristaayo: Oyogera ng’omuntu akyalina ekisusunku ku mutwe gwe n’okutuusa leero. Kiki kye yandigasingiddeko? Oba yandigatunze ani? Mu nsi eyo yonna gye yabbirwa, amayinja ge ag’omuwendo tegaalina mugaso; era teyeetaaga buyambi obwo obwandimuvudde eyo. Ate era, singa amayinja ge gaabula ku mulyango gw’Ekibuga eky’Eggulu, yandigaaniddwa (era ekyo yali akimanyi bulungi) obusika obw’omu kibuga omwo, era ekyo kyandimubeeredde kibi okusinga okulabika n’obukozi bubi bw’ababbi omutwalo gumu. Asuubira: Lwaki oli mukambwe bw’otyo, muganda wange? Esawu yatunda obukulu bwe, era ekyo olw’olulya olumu, Abaebbulaniya 12:16; era obukulu obwo bwe bwali ejjinja lye erisinga omuwendo: kale bw’aba nga ye yakikola, lwaki Akkiriza-Kitono naye teyandikikoze? Omukristaayo: Esawu yatunda ddala obukulu bwe, era n’abalala bangi bwe bakola, era bwe bakola batyo beggalira ebweru w’omukisa omukulu, nga n’omunaku oyo bwe yakola; naye oteekwa okwawula wakati wa Esawu ne Akkiriza-Kitono, era ne wakati w’embeera zaabwe. Obukulu bwa Esawu bwali kifaananyi ky’ebyo ebyali bigenda okujja; naye amayinja g’Akkiriza-Kitono tegaali bwe gatyo. Olubuto lwa Esawu lwe lwali katonda we; naye olubuto lw’Akkiriza-Kitono terwali bwe lutyo. Obwetaavu bwa Esawu bwali mu kwegomba kw’omubiri; obw’Akkiriza-Kitono tebwali bwe butyo. Ate era, Esawu teyasobola kulaba wala okusukka okutuukiriza okwegomba kwe: Laba Ndikumpi n’okufa, bwe yagamba; obukulu bungasa ki? Olubereberye 25:32. Naye Akkiriza-Kitono, newaakubadde nga kyali kye yaweebwa okuba n’okukkiriza okutono kwokka, okukkiriza kwe okutono kwamuziyiza obusirusiru ng’obwo, ne kumuyamba okulaba n’okuwa amayinja ge ekitiibwa okusinga okugatunda, nga Esawu bwe yatunda obukulu bwe. Tosoma wonna nti Esawu yalina okukkiriza, nedda, wadde akatono; n’olwekyo si kyewuunyo, omubiri gwokka we gufugira (nga bwe gufuga mu muntu atalina kukkiriza kugulwanyisa), bw’atunda obukulu bwe, n’emmeeme ye ne byonna, era ng’abiguza Setaani ow’omu ggeyeena; kubanga abali ng’abo bafaanana endogoyi, nga mu kwaka kwayo tewali ayinza kugiziyiza, Yeremiya 2:24: emitima gyabwe bwe giteekebwa ku kwegomba kwabwe, bateekwa okubifuna, ne bwe biba bya bbeeyi ki. Naye Akkiriza-Kitono yali wa mbala ndala; omutima gwe gwali ku bintu bya Katonda; obulamu bwe bwali ku bintu eby’omwoyo, era ebiva waggulu: kale olw’ensonga ki omuntu ow’embala eyo yanditunze amayinja ge ag’omuwendo (singa waaliwo ayagala okugagula) okujjuza omutima gwe ebintu ebitaliimu? Omuntu ayinza okuwaayo ekinusu okujjuza olubuto lwe essubi? Oba oyinza okusendasenda kaamukuukulu okulya emirambo nga nnamuŋŋoona? Newaakubadde ng’abatalina kukkiriza bayinza, olw’okwegomba kw’omubiri, okusingayo, oba okuwaayo ng’omusingo, oba okutunda bye balina, era ne beetunda bennyini ku bwongerwako; naye abo abalina okukkiriza, okukkiriza okulokola, ne bwe kuba kutono, tebayinza kukola batyo. Kale wano, muganda wange, w’osobezza. Asuubira: Nkikkiriza; naye okunenya kwo okukakali kubadde kumpi kunnyiiza. Omukristaayo: Kale, nkugeraageranyizza bugeraageranya ku binyonyi ebimu eby’ekika ekijjumbizi, ebiddukaddukira eno n’eri mu makubo agatalinnyiddwangamu nga bikyalina ebisusunku ku mitwe gyabyo: naye ekyo kireke, olowooze ku nsonga gye tukubaganyaako ebirowoozo, era byonna binaaba bulungi wakati wange naawe. Asuubira: Naye, Omukristaayo, abasajja bano abasatu, nkakasa mu mutima gwange, kibinja bubinja kya batiitiizi: singa si bwe kityo, olowooza bandidduse nga bwe baddukidde, olw’eddoboozi ly’omuntu eyali ajja mu kkubo? Lwaki Akkiriza-Kitono teyaguma mutima? Ndowooza yandibadde abalwanyisaako omulundi gumu, n’alyoka yeewaayo nga tewakyali kya kukola. Omukristaayo: Nti batiitiizi, bangi bakyogedde, naye batono abakirabye bwe kityo mu kiseera eky’okugezesebwa. Ku by’omutima omugumu, Akkiriza-Kitono teyalina; era nkutegedde, muganda wange, nti singa ggwe wali omusajja oyo, wandirwanyeko omulundi gumu, n’oluvannyuma weewaayo. Era ddala, okuva obuvumu bwo bwe buli waggulu bwe butyo kaakano nga bali wala naffe, singa bakulabikira nga bwe baamulabikira, bayinza okukuleetera okulowooza obulala. Naye era lowooza nti bano babbi bapakasi bubeezi; baweereza wansi wa kabaka w’obunnya obutakoma, oyo, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ajja yennyini okubadduukirira, era eddoboozi lye liri ng’okuwuluguma kw’empologoma. 1 Peetero 5:8. Nze kennyini nnalumbibwako nga Akkiriza-Kitono ono, ne nkisanga nga kintu kya ntiisa. Abazigu bano abasatu bannumba, era bwe nnatandika okubeewozaako ng’omukkiriza bw’asaanidde, ne bakoowoola bukoowoozi, mukama waabwe n’ajja. Nnandiwaddeyo obulamu bwange olw’ekinusu, nga bwe bagamba, singa Katonda teyakiraga nti nnali nnyambadde ebyokulwanyisa ebigezeseddwa. Yee, era newaakubadde nga nnali nneesibye bwe ntyo, nnakisanga nga kizibu okwerwanako ng’omusajja: tewali muntu ayinza kumanya bituuka ku ffe mu lutalo olwo, wabula oyo eyali mu lutalo yennyini. Asuubira: Kale, naye baadduka, olaba, bwe baalowooza obulowooza nti omusajja ayitibwa Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi yali mu kkubo. Omukristaayo: Kituufu, badduse emirundi mingi, bo ne mukama waabwe, Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi bw’alabika obulabisi; era si kyewuunyo, kubanga ye muzira wa Kabaka. Naye ndowooza ojja kwawulamu wakati wa Akkiriza-Kitono n’omuzira wa Kabaka. Abantu ba Kabaka bonna si bazira be; era bwe bageezesebwa, tebayinza kukola bya buzira mu lutalo nga ye. Kisaanidde okulowooza nti omwana omuto yandisobodde Goliyaasi nga Dawudi bwe yamusobola? Oba nti amaanyi g’ente gandibadde mu kanyonyi akatono ennyo? Abamu ba maanyi, abalala banafu; abamu balina okukkiriza kungi, abalala kutono: omusajja ono yali omu ku banafu, n’olwekyo yawangulwa. Asuubira: Nnandyagadde singa yali Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi, olw’abo. Omukristaayo: Singa yali ye, yandibadde n’omulimu munene: kubanga nkugamba nti, newaakubadde ng’Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi mukugu nnyo mu byokulwanyisa bye, era abakoze bulungi, era asobola, kasita abakuumira ku nsonda y’ekitala, okubawangula; naye bwe bamusemberera ddala, ne bw’aba Omutima-Omunafu, oba Atalina-Bwesige, oba omulala, kizibu nti tebajja kumusuula wansi. Era omuntu bw’agwa wansi, omanyi, ayinza kukola ki? Buli atunuulira obulungi amaaso g’Omwami Ekisa-Ekingi, ajja kulaba enkovu n’ebiwundu ebiyinza okukakasa bye njogera. Yee, lumu nnawulira nti yagamba (era nga yali mu lutalo) nti, Essuubi ery’okuba abalamu lyatuggwaamu. Abazigu bano abagumu ne bannaabwe baakaabya batya Dawudi, n’okusinda, n’okuwowoggana! Yee, ne Kemani, Zabbuli 88, ne Keezeekiya naye, newaakubadde nga baali bazira mu mirembe gyabwe, baawalirizibwa okufuba ennyo bwe baalumbibwa bano; era wadde kyali bwe kityo, baabakubako bubi nnyo. Peetero, lumu, yayagala okugezaako ky’ayinza okukola; naye newaakubadde ng’abamu bagamba nti ye mulangira w’abatume, baamukola bubi okutuusa lwe baamutiisa omuwala omuweereza atalina makulu. Ate era, kabaka waabwe abawulira bwe bafuuwa akafirimbi; tabeera wala nga tabawulira; era bwe kiba nti lumu bawangulwa, ajja okubayamba bwe kiba kisoboka; era ku ye kyogerwa nti, “Ekitala bwe kigituukako tekirina kye kiyinza kumukolako, oba ffumu, oba omuwunda wadde akasaale akasongovu. Emenya ebyuma gy’obeera nti ekutulakutula bisasiro, ebyo ebikomo ebimenyaamenya ng’emiti emivundu. Akasaale tekayinza kugiddusa, amayinja ag’envumuulo gaba nga biti gy’eri. Embukuuli nayo eri ng’ebisusunku gy’eri. Esekerera amafumu agakasukibwa.” Yobu 41:26-29. Omuntu ayinza kukola ki mu mbeera eno? Kituufu, singa omuntu yalina buli kiseera embalaasi ya Yobu, era ng’alina obukugu n’obuvumu okugyebagala, yandikoze ebikulu. “Embalaasi ggwe ogiwa amaanyi, oba ggwe oyambaza ensingo yaayo obwoya obwewumba? Ggwe ogisobozesa okubuuka ng’enzige n’ekanga n’okukaaba kwayo okw’entiisa? Etakula ettaka mu kiwonvu, nga yeeyagala olw’amaanyi gaayo, n’eryoka efuluma okusisinkana abalwanyi abakutte ebyokulwanyisa. Esekerera okutya, n’eteba na kigitiisa. Ekitala tekigitiisa kugizza mabega. Omufuko ogujjudde obusaale gwesuukundira ku lubuto lwayo, awamu n’effumu erimasamasa, n’akasaale. Mu busungu obungi emira ettaka, tesobola kusigala mu kifo kimu ng’ekkondeere livuze. Ekkondeere bwe livuga n’egamba nti, Awo! N’ewunyiriza olutalo olukyali ewala, n’ewulira n’okuleekaana kwa baduumizi b’amaggye.” Yobu 39:19-25. Naye ffe abaserikale abatambuza ebigere nga ggwe nange, tuleme okwegomba okusisinkana omulabe, newaakubadde okwewaana nti twandikoze obulungi, bwe tuwulira ku balala abaawangulwa, era tuleme kusanyuka nga tulowooza ku buzira bwaffe; kubanga abali bwe batyo batera okuwangulwa bwe bageezesebwa. Laba Peetero, gwe nnayogeddeko: yeewaananga, yee, yeewaananga; yandikoze obulungi, nga omutima gwe ogw’amalala bwe gwamusindiikiriza okwogera, era n’ayimirira ku lwa Mukama we okusinga abantu bonna: naye ani eyawangulwa n’amenyebwa abazigu abo nga ye? N’olwekyo, bwe tuwulira nti obubbi ng’obwo bukolerwa ku luguudo lwa Kabaka, ebintu bibiri bitusaanira okukola. 1. Okufuluma nga twesibye ebyokulwanyisa, era tukakase nti tutwala engabo: kubanga olw’obutaba nayo, oyo eyalwanyisa Lukwata n’amaanyi bw’atyo teyasobola kumuwangula; kubanga ddala, bwe tuba nga tetulina ngabo, tatutya n’akatono. N’olwekyo oyo eyali omukugu yagamba nti, “Era ku ebyo byonna okukkiriza kwammwe kubeerenga engabo eneebasobozesanga okuzikiza obusaale bwonna obw’omuliro obulasibwa omubi.” Abaefeso 6:16. 2. Kirungi era okusaba Kabaka atuwe abatuwerekera, yee, ye kennyini agende naffe. Kino kye kyasanyusa Dawudi bwe yali mu Kiwonvu ky’Ekisiikirize ky’Okufa; era Musa yasinga kwagala kufiira w’ayimiridde okusinga okutambula ekigere kimu nga Katonda we tali naye. Okuva 33:15. Ayi, muganda wange, singa ye agenda naffe, lwaki twanditidde emitwalo egyetegeka okutulwanyisa? Zabbuli 3:5-8; 27:1-3. Naye awatali ye, abayambi ab’amalala bagwa wansi w’abattiddwa. Isaaya 10:4. Nze ku lwange nnabaddeko mu lutalo; era newaakubadde nga (olw’obulungi bw’Oyo asinga byonna) ndi mulamu, nga bw’olaba, sisobola kwenyumiriza mu buzira bwonna. Nnaasanyuka nnyo bwe sirisisinkana nate ntalo ng’ezo; newaakubadde nga ntya nti tetunnayita mu kabi konna. Kyokka, okuva empologoma n’eddubu bwe bitannandya, nsuubira nti Katonda alitulokola ne ku Mufirisuuti atali mukomole addako. Awo Omukristaayo n’ayimba nti, “Akkiriza-Kitono omwavu! obadde mu babbi? Wabbiddwa? Kino kijjukire, buli akkiriza, Ofune okukkiriza okusingawo; olwo mulibeera bawanguzi Ku mitwalo—bwe kitaba kityo, ne ku basatu kizibu.” Awo ne beeyongerayo, Obutamanya n’abagoberera. Ne batambula okutuusa lwe baatuuka mu kifo we baalaba ekkubo eddala nga lyegatta ku kkubo lyabwe, era nga lirabika okuba eggolokofu nga ekkubo lye baali bateekwa okukwata; era wano tebaamanya ku ago abiri lye bandikutte, kubanga gombi gaalabika nga magolokofu mu maaso gaabwe: n’olwekyo ne bayimirira wano okulowooza. Era bwe baali nga balowooza ku kkubo, laba, omusajja ow’omubiri omuddugavu, naye ng’ayambadde olugoye olweru ennyo, n’ajja gye bali, n’ababuuza lwaki bayimiridde awo. Ne bamuddamu nti baali bagenda mu Kibuga eky’Eggulu, naye nga tebamanyi ku makubo gano lye bandikutte. “Mungoberere,” omusajja bwe yagamba, “eyo gye ŋŋenda.” Awo ne bamugoberera mu kkubo eryali lyakayingira mu luguudo, eryakyuka mpolampola, ne libakyusa okubaggya ennyo ku kibuga kye baali baagala okugendamu, mu kaseera katono amaaso gaabwe ne gaba nga gakikubye amabega; naye ne beeyongera okumugoberera. Naye mangu ago, nga tebannakitegeera, n’abatwala bombi munda mu kitimba, mwe beezingiriza bombi ne batamanya kya kukola; era amangu ago olugoye olweru ne luva ku mugongo gw’omusajja omuddugavu. Awo ne balaba we baali. N’olwekyo ne bagalamira awo nga bakaaba okumala akaseera, kubanga tebaasobola kwegyamu. Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Kaakano ndaba nga nsobezza. Abasumba tebaatugamba kwekuuma Omuwaanirizi? Nga omugezi bw’agamba, bwe tutyo bwe tukisanze leero: “Omuntu awaanawaana munne, aba yeetega yekka ekitimba.” Engero 29:5. Asuubira: Era baatuwa n’akawandiiko akalagirira ekkubo, tulyoke tulizuule n’obukakafu; naye ne twerabira okukasoma, ne tuleme okwekuuma okuva mu makubo g’omuzikiriza. Wano Dawudi yali mugezi okutusinga; kubanga agamba nti, “ngoberedde ebigambo by’akamwa ko, ne neewala ebikolwa by’abantu abakambwe.” Zabbuli 17:4. Bwe batyo ne bagalamira mu kitimba nga beekubagiza. Ku nkomerero ne balaba Omumasamasa ng’ajja gye bali ng’akutte mu ngalo ze kibooko ey’obuguwa obutono. Bwe yatuuka we baali, n’ababuuza gye baava, ne kye baali bakola awo. Ne bamugamba nti baali batambuze baavu abagenda e Sayuuni, naye baakyamizibwa omusajja omuddugavu ayambadde olweru, eyatugamba, bwe baagamba, tumugoberere, kubanga naye eyo gye yali agenda. Awo oyo eyalina kibooko n’agamba nti, Oyo ye Omuwaanirizi, omutume ow’obulimba, eyeefuula nga malayika ow’omusana. Danyeri 11:32; 2 Abakkolinso 11:13,14. Awo n’ayuza ekitimba, n’abasajja n’abata. N’abagamba nti, Mungoberere, mbazzeeyo mu kkubo lyammwe. Bw’atyo n’abazzaayo mu kkubo lye baali bavuddemu okugoberera Omuwaanirizi. Awo n’ababuuza nti, Ekiro ekyayise mwasula wa? Ne bagamba nti, Ewa basumba ku Nsozi Ennungi Ennyo. Awo n’ababuuza oba nga tebaafuna ku basumba kawandiiko akalagirira ekkubo. Ne baddamu nti, Yee. Naye, bwe yagamba, bwe mwayimirira nga temumanyi kya kukola, temwakaggyayo ne mukasoma? Ne baddamu nti, Nedda. N’ababuuza nti, Lwaki? Ne bagamba nti baakyerabira. Era n’ababuuza oba abasumba tebaabagamba kwekuuma Omuwaanirizi. Ne baddamu nti, Yee; naye tetwalowooza, bwe baagamba, nti omusajja ono ayogera ebigambo ebiwoomu ye yali oyo. Abaruumi 16:17,18. Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange ng’abalagira okugalamira; bwe baagalamira, n’abakuba nnyo, okubayigiriza ekkubo eddungi lye basaanidde okutambuliramu, Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 25:2; 2 Ebyomumirembe 6:27; era bwe yali abakuba, n’agamba nti, “Buli gwe njagala mmunenya era mmukangavvula; kale nyiikira okwenenya.” Okubikkulirwa 3:19. Ekyo bwe kyaggwa, n’abagamba beeyongereyo mu kkubo lyabwe, era bassengayo nnyo omwoyo ku biragiro ebirala eby’abasumba. Awo ne bamwebaza olw’ekisa kye kyonna, ne batambula mpola mu kkubo ettuufu, nga bayimba nti, “Mujje wano, mmwe abatambulira mu kkubo, Mulabe abatambuze abakyama bwe bayisibwa: Bakwatibwa mu kitimba ekizingiriza, Kubanga amagezi amalungi baagerabira mangu: Kituufu, baawonyezebwa; naye, mulaba, Baakubibwa n’embooko ku bwongerwako; kino kibabeere okulabula.” Awo, oluvannyuma lw’akaseera, ne balengera wala omuntu ng’ajja mpola, yekka, ng’atambulira ku luguudo olunene okubasisinkana. Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Laba omusajja eri akubye Sayuuni amabega, era ajja okutusisinkana. Asuubira: Mmulaba; kaakano twegendereze, aleme okuba nga naye Muwaanirizi. Bw’atyo n’asembera, n’asembera, okutuusa lwe yabatuukako. Erinnya lye yali Atakkiriza-Katonda, n’ababuuza gye baali bagenda. Omukristaayo: Tugenda ku Lusozi Sayuuni. Awo Atakkiriza-Katonda n’aseka nnyo ddala. Omukristaayo: Okuseka kwo kutegeeza ki? Atakkiriza-Katonda: Nseka okulaba nga bwe muli abantu abatamanyi, okwetikka olugendo oluzibu bwe lutyo, so nga tewali kye mujja kufuna wabula okutegana kwokka olw’okufuba kwammwe. Omukristaayo: Ssebo, olowooza tetujja kwanirizibwa? Atakkiriza-Katonda: Kwanirizibwa! Tewali kifo ng’ekyo kye muloota mu nsi eno yonna. Omukristaayo: Naye kiriwo mu nsi egenda okujja. Atakkiriza-Katonda: Bwe nnali eka mu nsi yange, nnawulira nga bwe mwogera kaakano, era olw’okuwulira okwo ne ngenda okulaba, era nnoonyezza ekibuga kino okumala emyaka gino amakumi abiri, naye sikirabangako okusinga bwe nnakiraba ku lunaku olwasooka lwe nnasimbula. Omubuulizi 10:15; Yeremiya 17:15. Omukristaayo: Ffembi twawulira, era tukkiriza, nti ekifo ng’ekyo kiriwo era kiyinza okuzuulibwa. Atakkiriza-Katonda: Singa saakikkiriza nga ndi eka, sandizze wano wala bw’ati okunoonya; naye bwe ssaakizuula (so nga nnandikizudde, singa ekifo ng’ekyo kyaliwo okuzuulibwa, kubanga nnoonyezza wala okubasinga), nzirayo, era nja kunoonya okwewummuza mu bintu bye nnasuula olw’okusuubira ekyo kye ndaba kaakano nti tekiriiwo. Omukristaayo: Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba Asuubira munne nti, Kituufu omusajja ono ky’ayogedde? Asuubira: Weegendereze, oyo omu ku Bawaanirizi. Jjukira ekyo kye kyatufiiriza omulundi gumu olw’okuwuliriza abantu ng’abo. Kiki! Olusozi Sayuuni terubaawo? Tetwalaba ku Nsozi Ennungi Ennyo omulyango gw’ekibuga? Ate era, kaakano tetuteekwa kutambula lwa kukkiriza? 2 Abakkolinso 5:7. Tweyongereyo, omusajja alina kibooko aleme okututuukako nate. Ggwe wandinjigirizza essomo eryo, lye nja kukuyimbira mu matu: “Mwana wange konoolekayo okuyigirizibwa, onoowaba okuva ku bigambo by’okumanya.” Engero 19:27. Nkugamba, muganda wange, lekera awo okumuwuliriza, tubeere n’okukkiriza okulokola emmeeme. Omukristaayo: Muganda wange, sakubuuzizza kibuuzo ekyo lwa kubanga nze kennyini nnali mbuusabuusa amazima g’okukkiriza kwaffe, wabula okukugezesa, n’okuggya mu ggwe ekibala ky’obwesimbu bw’omutima gwo. Ku musajja ono, mmanyi nti yazibikirwa katonda w’emirembe gino. Ggwe nange tweyongereyo, nga tumanyi nti tulina okukkiriza mu mazima; era tewali bulimba buva mu mazima. 1 Yokaana, 5:21. Asuubira: Kaakano nsanyuka nga nsuubira ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Awo ne bava ku musajja oyo; naye ye n’abasekerera, n’akwata ekkubo lye. Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga batambula okutuusa lwe baatuuka mu nsi emu, empewo yaayo gye yali ereeta otulo ku buli mugenyi agiyingiramu. Era wano Asuubira n’atandika okuzitoowererwa ennyo, ng’otulo tumuyinze; kyeyava agamba Omukristaayo nti, Kaakano ntandise okubongoota nnyo, nnemereddwa n’okuzibula amaaso gange; ka tugalamire wano tuwugulemu otulo katono. Omukristaayo: Nedda n’akatono, bw’atyo munne bwe yagamba; sikulwa nga twebaka ne tutazuukuka nate. Asuubira: Lwaki, muganda wange? Otulo tuwoomera omupakasi; tuyinza okuwummulamu bwe tunaawugulamu otulo. Omukristaayo: Tojjukira nti omu ku basumba yatulabula okwegendereza Ettaka Eddogo? Yali ategeeza nti twegendereze okwebaka; noolwekyo “tuleme kwebaka ng’abalala naye tutunulenga okwegomba kuleme okutufuga.” 1 Basessaloniika 5:6. Asuubira: Nzikirizza nti nsobye; singa nnali wano nzekka, okwebaka kwandinteeka mu kabi k’okufa. Ndaba nga kituufu omugezi ky’agamba nti, “Ababiri basinga omu.” Omubuulizi 4:9. Okutuusa kaakano okubeera naawe kubadde kisa gye ndi; era ojja kufuna empeera ennungi olw’okufuba kwo. Omukristaayo: Kale nno, Omukristaayo bwe yagamba, okuziyiza otulo mu kifo kino, ka tunyumye emboozi ennungi. Asuubira: N’omutima gwange gwonna, munne bwe yagamba. Omukristaayo: Tutandike wa? Asuubira: Katonda gye yatandikira naffe. Naye ggwe tandika, bw’oba oyagala. Omukristaayo: Ka nsooke nkuyimbire oluyimba luno: “Abatukuvu bwe batandika okubongoota, bajje wano, Bawulire abatambuze bano ababiri bwe banyumya; Weewaawo, bayigire ku bo mu ngeri yonna Okukuuma amaaso gaabwe agajjudde otulo nga gazibuse. Okussa ekimu kw’abatukuvu, bwe kukwatibwa obulungi, Kubakuuma nga batunula, ne geyena ne bw’eba nga teyagala.” Awo Omukristaayo n’atandika, n’agamba nti, Ka nkubuuze ekibuuzo. Wasooka otya okulowooza okukola kino ky’okola kaakano? Asuubira: Otegeeza nti nnasooka ntya okufaayo ku bulungi bw’emmeeme yange? Omukristaayo: Ye, ekyo kye ntegeeza. Asuubira: Nnamala ebbanga ddene nga nsanyukira ebintu ebyalabikanga era ebyatundibwanga mu katale kaffe; ebintu bye nzikiriza kaakano nti, singa nneeyongera okubibeeramu, byandinnyikizza mu kubula ne mu kuzikirira. Omukristaayo: Byali bintu ki? Asuubira: Obugagga n’eby’omuwendo byonna eby’ensi. Era nnasanyukiranga nnyo ekivuluvulu, embaga ez’obutamiivu, okunywa omwenge, okulayira, okulimba, obugwagwa, okumenya Ssabbiiti, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo ebyali bizikiriza emmeeme. Naye ku nkomerero nnakizuula, bwe nnawulira era ne nfumiitiriza ku bintu bya Katonda, bye nnawulira okuva gy’oli, era n’okuva eri Omwesigwa omwagalwa, eyattibwa olw’okukkiriza kwe n’obulamu bwe obulungi mu Katale k’Obutaliimu, nti enkomerero y’ebintu ebyo kufa, Abaruumi 6:21-23; era nti olw’ebintu ebyo, obusungu bwa Katonda bujja ku baana abajeemu. Abaefeso 5:6. Omukristaayo: Era amangu ago wakkiriza okulumirizibwa kuno okukufuga? Asuubira: Nedda, saayagala mangu kumanya bubi bwa kibi, wadde okusalirwa omusango okugoberera abo abakikola; naye nnafubanga, ebirowoozo byange bwe byasooka okukankanyizibwa ekigambo, okuziba amaaso gange obutalaba kitangaala kyakyo. Omukristaayo: Naye kiki ekyakuleetera okweyisa bw’otyo eri emirimu egyasooka egy’Omwoyo wa Katonda omutendereze ku ggwe? Asuubira: Ensonga zaali bwe ziti: 1. Saamanya nti guno gwali mulimu gwa Katonda mu nze. Sirowoozangako nti Katonda atandika okukyusa omwonoonyi ng’amuzuukusa okulaba ekibi kye. 2. Ekibi kyali kikyawoomera nnyo omubiri gwange, era saayagala kukireka. 3. Saamanya ngeri gye nnyinza kwawukana na banange ab’edda, kubanga okubeera nabo n’ebikolwa byabwe byansanyusanga nnyo. 4. Ebiseera okulumirizibwa mwe kwanzijiranga byali bya kutawaanya era bya kutiisa omutima nnyo, ne kiba nti sisobola kubigumiikiriza, nedda, wadde okubijjukira obujjukizi mu mutima gwange. Omukristaayo: Kale, nga bwe kirabika, oluusi wawonanga obuzibu bwo? Asuubira: Ye, ddala, naye bwakomangawo nate mu birowoozo byange; era awo nga mbeera mubi nga bwe nnali, nedda, nga nsinga n’edda obubi. Omukristaayo: Kiki ekyakuzzangamu okujjukira ebibi byo? Asuubira: Ebintu bingi; nga, 1. Bwe nnasisinkananga obusisinkanyi omuntu omulungi mu nguudo; oba, 2. Bwe nnawuliranga omuntu ng’asoma mu Bayibuli; oba, 3. Omutwe gwange bwe gwatandikanga okunnuma; oba, 4. Bwe nnabuulirwanga nti abamu ku baliraanwa bange balwadde; oba, 5. Bwe nnawuliranga ekide nga kivuga olw’abo abaafudde; oba, 6. Bwe nnalowoozanga ku kufa kwange nze; oba, 7. Bwe nnawuliranga nti abalala bafudde kibwatukira. 8. Naye okusingira ddala bwe nnalowoozanga ku nze kennyini nti nnina okutuuka amangu mu musango. Omukristaayo: Era wasobolanga, buli lwe wayagalanga, okwejjako omusango gw’ekibi, bwe gwakujjiranga mu ngeri yonna ku ngeri ezo? Asuubira: Nedda, si nze; kubanga awo byeyongeranga okunyweza omuntu wange ow’omunda; era awo, bwe nnalowoozanga obulowooza okudda mu kibi, (newaakubadde ng’ebirowoozo byange byali bikikyaye,) kyabanga kubonaabona kwa mirundi ebiri gye ndi. Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola otya? Asuubira: Nnalowooza nti nnina okufuba okutereeza obulamu bwange; kubanga bwe kitaba ekyo, bwe nnalowooza, ddala nja kusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira. Omukristaayo: Era wafuba okwetereeza? Asuubira: Ye, era nnadduka, si ku bibi byange byokka, naye ne ku banywanyi aboonoonyi, ne nneewaayo ku mirimu gy’eddiini, ng’okusaba, okusoma, okukaaba olw’ekibi, okwogera amazima eri baliraanwa bange, n’ebirala. Ebyo nnabikola, wamu n’ebirala bingi, bingi nnyo okubinyumya wano. Omukristaayo: Era awo walowooza nti oli bulungi? Asuubira: Ye, okumala akaseera; naye ku nkomerero obuzibu bwange ne bunzirira nate nga bunkulukuntira, ne busukka ne ku kwetereeza kwange kwonna. Omukristaayo: Ekyo kyajja kitya, ng’ate wali weetereezezza? Asuubira: Waaliwo ebintu bingi ebyakundeetera, naddala ebigambo nga bino: “obutuukirivu bwaffe buli nga nziina ezijjudde obukyafu.” Isaaya 64:6. “tewali n’omu aliweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa eby’amateeka.” Abaggalatiya 2:16. “bwe mumalanga okutuukiriza ebyo ebyabagambibwa okukola, mugambenga nti, Ffe abaddu bo abatasaanira,” Lukka 17:10; n’ebirala bingi ebiringa ebyo. Awo ne ntandika okwekubaganya ebirowoozo bwe nti: Bwe kiba nga obutuukirivu bwange bwonna buli nga nziina ezijjudde obukyafu; bwe kiba nga olw’ebikolwa by’amateeka tewali muntu ayinza kuweebwa butuukirivu; era bwe kiba nga, bwe tumala okukola byonna, tukyali abatasaanira, kale busirusiru bwereere okulowooza okutuuka mu ggulu olw’amateeka. Ate ne nneeyongera okulowooza bwe nti: Omuntu bw’abeera n’ebbanja lya pawundi kikumi mu dduuka, oluvannyuma n’asasulira buli ky’aggyayo; naye ng’ebbanja lye ery’edda likyali mu kitabo nga terisaziddwamu, nnannyini dduuka ayinza okumuwawabira, n’amusuula mu kkomera, okutuusa lw’alisasula ebbanja eryo. Omukristaayo: Kale, ekyo wakikwasaganya otya ku ggwe kennyini? Asuubira: Nnalowooza bwe nti mu mutima gwange: Olw’ebibi byange nneewandiisizza ebbanja ddene mu kitabo kya Katonda, era okwetereeza kwange okwa kaakano tekuyinza kusasula bbanja eryo; noolwekyo nnina okweyongera okwebuuza, wakati mu kwetereeza kwange kwonna okwa kaakano, nti, Naye nnaawona ntya okusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira, gwe nneereetera olw’ebyonoono byange eby’edda? Omukristaayo: Okukwasaganya okulungi ennyo: naye nkwegayiridde weeyongere. Asuubira: Ekintu ekirala ekintawaanyizza okuva lwe nnetereeza, kiri nti bwe neetegereza obulungi ebisinga obulungi bye nkola kaakano, nkyalaba ekibi, ekibi ekiggya, nga kyetabula n’ebisinga obulungi bye nkola; ne kiba nti kaakano mpaliriziddwa okusalawo nti, newaakubadde nga edda nneerowoozangako nnyo mu busirusiru, nze n’emirimu gyange, nkola ekibi ekimala mu lunaku lumu okunsindika mu geyena, ne bwe kiba nti obulamu bwange obw’edda tebwalina kamogo. Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola ki? Asuubira: Okukola! Saamanya kya kukola, okutuusa lwe nnabuulira Omwesigwa ebyali ku mutima gwange; kubanga ye nange twali tumanyaganye bulungi. N’aŋŋamba nti okuggyako nga nfunye obutuukirivu bw’omuntu atayonoonangako n’akatono, obutuukirivu bwange, wadde obutuukirivu bwonna obw’ensi, tebuyinza kundokola. Omukristaayo: Era walowooza nti yayogera mazima? Asuubira: Singa yali aŋŋambye bw’atyo nga nkyali musanyufu era nga nneemalidde mu kwetereeza kwange, nnandimuyise musirusiru olw’obuzibu bwe; naye kaakano, bwe ndaba obunafu bwange, n’ekibi ekyekwata ku bisinga obulungi bye nkola, mpaliriziddwa okukkiriziganya naye. Omukristaayo: Naye walowooza, bwe yasooka okukikubuulira, nti waliwo omuntu ng’oyo ayinza okuzuulwa, ayinza okwogerwako mu butuufu nti tayonoonangako? Asuubira: Nzikiriza nti ebigambo ebyo byasooka okumpulikika ng’ebyewuunyisa; naye oluvannyuma lw’okwogera naye akatono n’okubeera naye, nnakakasa ddala. Omukristaayo: Era wamubuuza omuntu oyo y’ani, n’engeri gy’olina okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bubwe? Asuubira: Ye, era n’aŋŋamba nti ye Mukama waffe Yesu, abeera ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogw’Ali Waggulu Ennyo. Abaebbulaniya 10:12-21. Era bw’atyo, bwe yagamba, olina okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bubwe, nga weesiga bye yakola ye kennyini mu nnaku ez’omubiri gwe, n’ebyo bye yabonyaabonyezebwa bwe yawanikibwa ku muti. Abaruumi 4:5; Abakkolosaayi 1:14; 1 Peetero 1:19. Ne nneeyongera okumubuuza, obutuukirivu bw’omuntu oyo buyinza butya okuba n’amaanyi ago, okuweesa omulala obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda. N’aŋŋamba nti ye yali Katonda ow’amaanyi, era bye yakola yabikola, era n’afa n’okufa, si ku lulwe, wabula ku lwange; era nti bye yakola, n’obulungi bwabyo, byandimbaliddwa nze, singa mmukkiriza. Omukristaayo: Kale awo wakola ki? Asuubira: Nnaleeta ensonga ezinziyiza okukkiriza, kubanga nnalowooza nti teyali mwetegefu kundokola. Omukristaayo: Kale Omwesigwa yakugamba ki awo? Asuubira: Yaŋŋamba ŋŋende gy’ali ndabe. Ne mmugamba nti okwo kwandibadde kwemanya. N’agamba nti, Nedda; kubanga nnali mpitiddwa okujja. Matayo 11:28. Awo n’ampa ekitabo ekyawandiikibwa Yesu, okunzizaamu amaanyi okujja n’obuteefiirayo; era n’agamba ku kitabo ekyo, nti buli nnukuta na buli kabonero kaakyo binywevu okusinga eggulu n’ensi. Matayo 24:35. Awo ne mmubuuza kye nnina okukola bwe nnaatuuka; n’aŋŋamba nti nnina okwegayirira nga nfukamidde, Zabbuli 95:6; Danyeri 6:10, n’omutima gwange gwonna n’emmeeme yange yonna, Yeremiya 29:12,13, Kitaffe ambikkulire ye. Awo ne nneeyongera okumubuuza, engeri gye nnina okumwegayiriramu; n’agamba nti, Genda, ojja kumusanga ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, gy’atuula omwaka gwonna okusonyiwa n’okuggyako emisango abo abajja. Okuva 25:22; Ebyabaleevi 16:2; Okubala 7:89; Abaebbulaniya 4:16. Ne mmugamba nti saamanyi kya kwogera bwe nnaatuuka; n’aŋŋamba njogere bwe nti: Katonda, onsaasire, nze omwonoonyi, era onsobozese okumanya Yesu Kristo n’okumukkiriza; kubanga ndaba nti singa obutuukirivu bwe tebwaliwo, oba singa siba na kukkiriza mu butuukirivu obwo, nsuuliddwa ddala. Mukama, mpulidde nti oli Katonda omusaasizi, era nti walagira Omwana wo Yesu Kristo abeere Omulokozi w’ensi; era n’okusingawo, nti oyagala okumuwa omwonoonyi omwavu nga nze—era ddala ndi mwonoonyi. Mukama, kale kozesa omukisa guno, ogulumize ekisa kyo mu kulokola emmeeme yange, ku bw’Omwana wo Yesu Kristo. Amiina. Omukristaayo: Era wakola nga bwe wagambibwa? Asuubira: Ye, emirundi n’emirundi, n’emirundi. Omukristaayo: Era Kitaffe yakubikkulira Omwana? Asuubira: Si mu mulundi ogusooka, wadde ogwokubiri, wadde ogwokusatu, wadde ogwokuna, wadde ogwokutaano, nedda, wadde ogwomukaaga. Omukristaayo: Awo wakola ki? Asuubira: Ki? Saamanya kya kukola. Omukristaayo: Tewalowooza kulekera awo kusaba? Asuubira: Ye; emirundi kikumi emirundi ebiri. Omukristaayo: Kale lwaki tewalekera awo? Asuubira: Nnakkiriza nti kyali kituufu kye nnali mbuuliddwa, kwe kugamba nti awatali butuukirivu bwa Kristo ono, ensi yonna teyinza kundokola; noolwekyo, ne ndowooza mu mutima gwange, bwe ndekera awo, nfa, ate bwe nfa, nfiire ku ntebe ey’ekisa. Era wamu n’ekyo ne kinzijira mu birowoozo, “Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa.” Kaabakuuku 2:3. Bwe ntyo ne nneeyongera okusaba okutuusa Kitaffe lwe yandaga Omwana we. Omukristaayo: Era yakubikkulirwa atya? Asuubira: Saamulaba na maaso gange ag’omubiri, wabula n’amaaso g’okutegeera kwange, Abaefeso 1:18,19; era bwe kyali bwe kiti. Lumu nnali nnakuwadde nnyo, ndowooza okusinga ekiseera ekirala kyonna mu bulamu bwange; era ennaku eno yava ku kulaba buggya obunene n’obugwagwa bw’ebibi byange. Era bwe nnali sirina kye nsuubira okuggyako geyena, n’okuzikirira okutaggwaawo okw’emmeeme yange, amangwago, nga bwe nnalowooza, ne ndaba Mukama waffe Yesu ng’antunuulira okuva mu ggulu, ng’agamba nti, “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.” Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:31. Naye ne muddamu nti, Mukama, ndi mwonoonyi munene, mwonoonyi munene nnyo: n’anziramu nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala.” 2 Abakkolinso 12:9. Awo ne ŋŋamba nti, Naye, Mukama, okukkiriza kye ki? Awo ne ntegeera okuva mu kigambo ekyo, “Ajja gye ndi enjala teriddayo kumuluma, era abo abanzikiriza tebaliddayo kulumwa nnyonta,” Yokaana 6:35, nti okukkiriza n’okujja kintu kimu; era nti oyo eyajja, kwe kugamba, eyadduka n’omutima gwe n’okwagala kwe okunoonya obulokozi mu Kristo, ddala yakkiriza Kristo. Awo amaziga ne gajjula mu maaso gange, ne nneeyongera okubuuza nti, Naye, Mukama, omwonoonyi omunene nga nze ddala ayinza okukkirizibwa gy’oli, n’alokolebwa ggwe? Ne mmuwulira ng’agamba nti, “era buli ajja gye ndi sirimugobera bweru.” Yokaana 6:37. Awo ne ŋŋamba nti, Naye, Mukama, nnina kukulowoozaako ntya nga nzija gy’oli, okukkiriza kwange kulyoke kukussibweko bulungi? Awo n’agamba nti, “Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi.” 1 Timoseewo 1:15. Ye nkomerero y’amateeka olw’obutuukirivu eri buli akkiriza. Abaruumi 10:4, n’essuula 4. Yaweebwayo okuttibwa olw’ebibi byaffe, n’azuukizibwa tulyoke tuweebwe obutuukirivu. Abaruumi 4:25. Yatwagala, n’atuggya mu bibi byaffe n’omusaayi gwe. Okubikkulirwa 1:5. Ye mutabaganya wa Katonda naffe. 1 Timoseewo 2:5. Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okutuwolereza. Abaebbulaniya 7:25. Okuva mu byonna ebyo ne nzuula nti nnina okunoonya obutuukirivu mu ye kennyini, n’okutangirira ebibi byange mu musaayi gwe; nti bye yakola mu kugondera amateeka ga Kitaawe, n’okugonda ku kibonerezo kyago, teyabikola ku lulwe, wabula ku lw’oyo anaabikkiriza olw’obulokozi bwe, n’asiima. Era kaakano omutima gwange ne gujjula essanyu, amaaso gange ne gajjula amaziga, n’okwagala kwange ne kukulukuta eri erinnya, abantu, n’amakubo ga Yesu Kristo. Omukristaayo: Ddala okwo kwali kubikkulirwa kwa Kristo mu mmeeme yo. Naye mbuulira mu bujjuvu ekyo kyakola ki ku mwoyo gwo. Asuubira: Kyandaga nti ensi yonna, newaakubadde n’obutuukirivu bwayo bwonna, eri mu mbeera ey’okusalirwa omusango. Kyandaga nti Katonda Kitaffe, newaakubadde nga mutuukirivu, ayinza mu butuukirivu okuwa omwonoonyi ajja obutuukirivu. Kyankwasa ensonyi nnyo olw’obugwagwa bw’obulamu bwange obw’edda, ne kinswaza olw’okutegeera obutamanya bwange; kubanga tewali kirowoozo kyali kizze mu mutima gwange okutuusa kaakano ekyandaga bwe kityo obulungi bwa Yesu Kristo. Kyanjagaza obulamu obutukuvu, ne neegomba okukola ekintu ku lw’ekitiibwa n’ettendo ly’erinnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu. Weewaawo, nnalowooza nti singa kaakano nnina ebidomola by’omusaayi lukumi mu mubiri gwange, nnandibuyiye gwonna ku lwa Mukama waffe Yesu. Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange, Asuubira ng’atunula emabega, n’alaba Obutamanya, gwe baali balese emabega, ng’ajja ng’abagoberera. Laba, bwe yagamba Omukristaayo, omuvubuka oli bw’asigadde emabega ewala. Omukristaayo: Ye, ye, mmulaba: tafaayo ku kubeera naffe. Asuubira: Naye ndowooza tekyandimukoze kabi, singa abadde atambula naffe okutuusa kaakano. Omukristaayo: Ekyo kituufu; naye nkukakasa nti ye alowooza bulala. Asuubira: Ekyo ndowooza bw’akirowooza; naye, ka tumulindeko. (Bwe batyo ne bakola.) Awo Omukristaayo n’amugamba nti, Jjangu, ssebo; lwaki osigala emabega bw’otyo? Obutamanya: Nze nsanyukira okutambula nzekka, okusinga ennyo okutambula n’abalala, okuggyako nga be ntambula nabo bannyumira. Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba Asuubira, (naye mpola,) Saakugambye nti tafaayo ku kubeera naffe? Naye, bwe yagamba, jjangu, tunyumye tuyiseewo ebiseera mu kifo kino ekyesudde. Awo, n’akyuka n’ayogera n’Obutamanya, n’agamba nti, Kale, oli otya? Wakati wa Katonda n’emmeeme yo kaakano kiri kitya? Obutamanya: Nsuubira nti bulungi; kubanga buli kiseera nzijudde ebirowoozo ebirungi, ebinzijira okunzizaamu amaanyi nga ntambula. Omukristaayo: Birowoozo ki ebirungi? Tubuulire. Obutamanya: Nze ndowooza ku Katonda ne ku ggulu. Omukristaayo: Ne baddayimooni n’emmeeme ezazikirira bwe bakola. Obutamanya: Naye nze mbirowoozaako, era mbyegomba. Omukristaayo: Bwe batyo bwe bakola bangi abatagenda kutuukayo n’akatono. “Omuntu omugayaavu yeegomba kyokka n’atabaako ky’afuna.” Engero 13:4. Obutamanya: Naye mbirowoozaako, era ndeka byonna ku lwabyo. Omukristaayo: Ekyo nkibuusabuusa: kubanga okuleka byonna kintu kizibu nnyo; weewaawo, kizibu okusinga bangi bwe bamanyi. Naye lwaki, oba kiki ekikukakasa nti walekera ddala byonna ku lwa Katonda n’eggulu? Obutamanya: Omutima gwange gwe gumbuulira bwe gutyo. Omukristaayo: Omugezi agamba nti, “Eyeesiga omutima gwe, musirusiru.” Engero 28:26. Obutamanya: Ekyo kyogerwa ku mutima omubi; naye ogwange mulungi. Omukristaayo: Naye ekyo okikakasa otya? Obutamanya: Gunzizaamu amaanyi nga nsuubira eggulu. Omukristaayo: Ekyo kiyinza okuva mu bulimba bwagwo; kubanga omutima gw’omuntu guyinza okumugumya ng’asuubira ekintu ky’atalinamu musingi gwonna ogw’okusuubira. Obutamanya: Naye omutima gwange n’obulamu bwange bikwatagana; noolwekyo essuubi lyange lirina omusingi omunywevu. Omukristaayo: Ani yakugamba nti omutima gwo n’obulamu bwo bikwatagana? Obutamanya: Omutima gwange gwe gumbuulira bwe gutyo. Omukristaayo: “Buuza munnange obanga ndi mubbi.” Omutima gwo gwe gukubuulira bwe gutyo! Okuggyako ng’ekigambo kya Katonda kye kiwa obujulirwa ku nsonga eno, obujulirwa obulala tebulina mugaso. Obutamanya: Naye omutima ogulina ebirowoozo ebirungi si mutima mulungi? era obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda si bulamu bulungi? Omukristaayo: Ye, omutima ogulina ebirowoozo ebirungi mutima mulungi, n’obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda bulamu bulungi; naye ddala kirala okuba nabyo, era kirala okulowooza obulowooza nti obirina. Obutamanya: Nkwegayiridde, ggwe ebirowoozo ebirungi obitwala kuba ki, n’obulamu obukwatagana n’ebiragiro bya Katonda? Omukristaayo: Waliwo ebirowoozo ebirungi eby’engeri nnyingi; ebimu bikwata ku ffe, ebimu ku Katonda, ebimu ku Kristo, n’ebimu ku bintu ebirala. Obutamanya: Birowoozo ki ebirungi ebikwata ku ffe? Omukristaayo: Ebyo ebikwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda. Obutamanya: Ebirowoozo byaffe ku ffe bikwatagana ddi n’ekigambo kya Katonda? Omukristaayo: Bwe twesalira omusango gwe gumu ekigambo gwe kitusalira. Okunnyonnyola: ekigambo kya Katonda kigamba ku bantu abali mu mbeera yaabwe ey’obuzaaliranwa nti, “Tewali mutuukirivu n’omu, tewali n’omu akola obulungi.” Era kigamba nti, “buli ndowooza y’omutima gw’omuntu mbi njereere ebbanga lyonna.” Olubereberye 6:5; Abaruumi 3. Era nate, “endowooza y’omutima gw’omuntu mbi okuva mu buto bwe.” Olubereberye 8:21. Kale nno, bwe tulowooza bwe tutyo ku ffe, nga tukitegedde, awo ebirowoozo byaffe biba birungi, kubanga bikwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda. Obutamanya: Sirikkiriza n’akatono nti omutima gwange mubi bwe gutyo. Omukristaayo: Noolwekyo tewabangako na kirowoozo kirungi kimu ku ggwe kennyini mu bulamu bwo bwonna. Naye ka nneeyongereyo. Ng’ekigambo bwe kisalira emitima gyaffe omusango, bwe kityo bwe kisalira n’amakubo gaffe omusango; era ebirowoozo by’emitima gyaffe n’amakubo gaffe bwe bikwatagana n’omusango ekigambo gwe kisala ku byombi, awo byombi biba birungi, kubanga bikwatagana nagwo. Obutamanya: Nnyonnyola by’otegeeza. Omukristaayo: Ekigambo kya Katonda kigamba nti amakubo g’omuntu makubo makyamu, si malungi wabula ga bujeemu; kigamba nti mu buzaaliranwa bwabwe bakyama okuva mu kkubo eddungi, nti tebalimanyangako. Zabbuli 125:5; Engero 2:15; Abaruumi 3:12. Kaakano, omuntu bw’alowooza bw’atyo ku makubo ge, nze ŋŋamba, bw’alowooza bw’atyo ng’akitegedde ddala, era n’omutima ogwetoowazizza, awo aba n’ebirowoozo ebirungi ku makubo ge, kubanga ebirowoozo bye kaakano bikwatagana n’omusango gw’ekigambo kya Katonda. Obutamanya: Birowoozo ki ebirungi ebikwata ku Katonda? Omukristaayo: Nga bwe nnyogedde ku ffe, bwe biba bwe bityo: ebirowoozo byaffe ku Katonda bwe bikwatagana n’ekigambo kye kyogera ku ye; era ekyo kiba bwe tulowooza ku bubeerawo bwe n’engeri ze nga ekigambo bwe kyayigiriza, ebyo bye siyinza kwogerako mu bujjuvu kaakano. Naye okwogera ku ye nga bw’akwatagana naffe: awo tuba n’ebirowoozo ebituufu ku Katonda bwe tulowooza nti atumanyi okusinga ffe bwe tumanyi ffe kennyini, era nti ayinza okulaba ekibi mu ffe ddi na wa we tutayinza kulaba na kimu mu ffe; bwe tulowooza nti amanyi ebirowoozo byaffe eby’omunda ennyo, era nti omutima gwaffe, n’obuziba bwagwo bwonna, buli kiseera gubikkuse mu maaso ge; era bwe tulowooza nti obutuukirivu bwaffe bwonna buwunya mu nnyindo ze, era nti noolwekyo tayinza kugumiikiriza kutulaba nga tuyimiridde mu maaso ge nga twekakasa, wadde mu mirimu gyaffe gyonna egisinga obulungi. Obutamanya: Olowooza nti ndi musirusiru nnyo okulowooza nti Katonda tayinza kulaba wala okusinga nze; oba nti nnandizze eri Katonda nga nneesigama ku mirimu gyange egisinga obulungi? Omukristaayo: Kale ggwe olowooza otya ku nsonga eno? Obutamanya: Okumala mangu, ndowooza nti nnina okukkiriza Kristo okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Omukristaayo: Ki! Olowooza nti olina okukkiriza Kristo, ate nga tolaba bwetaavu bwo gy’ali! Tolaba bunafu bwo obw’obuzaaliranwa wadde obw’ebikolwa byo; naye weerowoozaako nnyo, n’ebyo by’okola, mu ngeri eraga lwatu nti oli muntu atalabangako bwetaavu bwa butuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini okukuweesa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda. Kale oyinza otya okugamba nti, Nzikiriza Kristo? Obutamanya: Nzikiriza bulungi ddala, newaakubadde ng’ebyo biri bityo. Omukristaayo: Okkiriza otya? Obutamanya: Nzikiriza nti Kristo yafiirira aboonoonyi; era nti nja kuweebwa obutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda, ne nnunulibwa mu kikolimo, olw’ekisa kye ng’akkiriza obuwulize bwange eri amateeka ge. Oba bwe kiti: Kristo afuula emirimu gyange egy’eddiini okukkirizibwa Kitaawe olw’obulungi bwe, era bwe ntyo nja kuweebwa obutuukirivu. Omukristaayo: Ka nziremu okwatula kuno okw’okukkiriza kwo. 1. Okkiriza n’okukkiriza kwe weegunjira; kubanga okukkiriza kuno tekunnyonnyolwa wonna mu kigambo. 2. Okkiriza n’okukkiriza okw’obulimba; kubanga kuggya okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku butuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini, ne kukuteeka ku bubwo. 3. Okukkiriza kuno tekufuula Kristo oyo akuweesa obutuukirivu ggwe kennyini, wabula aweesa ebikolwa byo; era akuweesa ggwe olw’ebikolwa byo, ekyo nga si kituufu. 4. Noolwekyo okukkiriza kuno kwa bulimba, kwe kuli okunaakuleka wansi w’obusungu ku lunaku lwa Katonda Ayinzabyonna: kubanga okukkiriza okw’amazima okuweesa obutuukirivu kusindiikiriza emmeeme, eyategedde okubula kwayo olw’amateeka, okuddukira mu butuukirivu bwa Kristo; (obutuukirivu bwe obwo si kikolwa kya kisa ky’akola, okuweebwa obutuukirivu, n’afuula obuwulize bwo okukkirizibwa Katonda, wabula buwulize bwe ye kennyini eri amateeka, mu kukola n’okubonyaabonyezebwa ku lwaffe ebyo amateeka bye gaali gatusaba;) obutuukirivu buno, nze ŋŋamba, okukkiriza okw’amazima kwe kubukkiriza; era emmeeme bw’ebikkibwa wansi w’ekyambalo kyabwo, n’eyanjulwa nabwo nga terina bbala mu maaso ga Katonda, ekkirizibwa, era n’esumululwa okuva mu kusalirwa omusango. Obutamanya: Ki! Oyagala twesige ebyo Kristo bye yakola ye kennyini awatali ffe? Endowooza eyo yandisumuludde enkoba z’okwegomba kwaffe, n’etukkiriza okubeera nga bwe twagala: kubanga kigasa ki engeri gye tubeeramu, bwe tuba nga tuyinza okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’obutuukirivu bwa Kristo ye kennyini okuva mu byonna, bwe tubukkiriza? Omukristaayo: Obutamanya lye linnya lyo, era nga erinnya lyo bwe liri, bw’oli bw’otyo: n’okuddamu kwo kuno kulaga kye njogera. Tomanyi butuukirivu obuweesa obutuukirivu kye buli, era tomanyi bw’otyo engeri y’okuwonya emmeeme yo, olw’okukkiriza mu bwo, okuva mu busungu bwa Katonda obuzito. Weewaawo, era tomanyi bibala bya mazima eby’okukkiriza okulokola mu butuukirivu buno obwa Kristo, kwe kufukamiza omutima n’okugukyusa eri Katonda mu Kristo, okwagala erinnya lye, ekigambo kye, amakubo ge, n’abantu be, so si nga ggwe bw’olowooza mu butamanya bwo. Asuubira: Mubuuze obanga yali abikkuliddwa Kristo okuva mu ggulu. Obutamanya: Ki! Ggwe oli muntu wa bubikkulirwa! Nzikiriza nti ebyo byonna ggwe n’abalala bonna bye mwogera ku nsonga eyo, bibala bya bwongo obutabuse. Asuubira: Ssebo, Kristo akwekeddwa nnyo mu Katonda okuva ku kutegeera okw’obuzaaliranwa okw’omubiri, n’aba nga tayinza kumanyibwa muntu yenna mu ngeri ey’okulokola, okuggyako nga Katonda Kitaffe amumubikkulidde. Obutamanya: Okwo kwe kukkiriza kwo, naye si kwange; kyokka okwange, sikibuusabuusa, kulungi nga okwo, newaakubadde nga sirina mu mutwe gwange birooto bingi ng’ebibyo. Omukristaayo: Ka nyingizeemu ekigambo. Tosaanye kwogera ku nsonga eno mu ngeri ey’okunyooma bw’otyo: kubanga kino nkikakasa n’obuvumu, nga munnange omulungi bw’akoze, nti tewali muntu ayinza kumanya Yesu Kristo wabula olw’okubikkulirwa kwa Kitaffe: weewaawo, n’okukkiriza nakwo, emmeeme kwe yeekwatira Kristo, (bwe kuba nga kutuufu,) kulina okukolebwa amaanyi ge agasukkiridde obukulu, Matayo 11:27; 1 Abakkolinso 12:3; Abaefeso 1:17-19; era okukola kw’okukkiriza okwo, ndaba, ggwe Obutamanya omwavu, tokumanyi. Kale, zuukuka, laba obunaku bwo, oddukire eri Mukama waffe Yesu; era olw’obutuukirivu bwe, obwo bwe butuukirivu bwa Katonda, (kubanga ye kennyini Katonda,) ojja kuwonyezebwa okusalirwa omusango. Obutamanya: Mutambula mangu nnyo, sisobola kutambula nammwe; mwe mukulembere: nze nnina okusigala emabega akaseera. Awo ne bagamba nti, “Ggwe Obutamanya, onoosigala ng’oli musirusiru, Okunyooma okubuulirira okulungi, kw’oweereddwa emirundi kkumi? Era bw’onookugaana, ojja kumanya, Mu bbanga ttono, obubi bw’ekyo ky’okola. Jjukira, ssebo, nga bukyali: kkakkana, totya: Okubuulirira okulungi, bwe kukkirizibwa, kulokola; kale wuliriza. Naye bw’onookyeyongera okukunyooma, ojja kuba Gwe afiiriddwa, Obutamanya, nkukakasa.”

fields.title: Omutendera Ogwekkumi
fields.body_html:
Awo Omukristaayo n’ayogera bw’ati eri munne:

Omukristaayo: Kale, jjangu, Asuubira wange omulungi, ndaba nga ggwe nange tuteekwa okutambula ffekka nate.

Awo ne ndaba mu kirooto kyange nga bo beeyongerayo mu maaso mangu, ate Obutamanya n’ajja ng’awenyera emabega. Awo Omukristaayo n’agamba munne nti, Omusajja ono omwavu mmusaasira nnyo: ddala ku nkomerero kirimubeerera kibi.
