Omwami Ow’amazima: By’omuvubuka, tewali kubuusabuusa. Kubanga ekyo ekiwakanya okuziyizibwa okusinga obunene, kye kisinga okulaga nti kye kisinga amaanyi; naddala bwe kitambula kyenkanyi n’ekyo ekitasanga wadde ekitundu ky’okuziyizibwa okwo, ng’obukadde bwe butakisanga. Ate era, ndabye nti abakadde beesiima olw’ensobi eno; kwe kugamba, nga balowooza nti okuggwaamu amaanyi g’omubiri kwe kuwangula obwonoonefu olw’ekisa, bwe batyo ne beerimbalimba. Ddala abakadde abalina ekisa be basinga okusobola okuwa abavubuka amagezi, kubanga be basinze okulaba obwereere bw’ebintu: naye, omukadde n’omuvubuka bwe batandikira wamu, omuvubuka y’asinga okufuna omukisa okulabisa obulungi omulimu gw’ekisa mu ye, newaakubadde obwonoonefu bw’omukadde mu butonde bwe businga obunafu. Bwe batyo ne batuula nga boogera okutuusa obudde lwe bwakya.

Awo ab’omu nnyumba bwe baagolokoka, Christiana n’alagira mutabani we Yakobo asome essuula; n’asoma essuula 53 eya Isaaya. Bwe yamala, Omwami Ow’amazima n’abuuza lwaki kyagambibwa nti Omulokozi yali wa kuva “mu ttaka ekkalu;” era nti “teyalina kitiibwa wadde obulungi.”

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Ku kibuuzo ekisooka nziramu nti, kubanga ekkanisa y’Abayudaaya, Kristo mwe yava, mu kiseera ekyo yali eweddemu kumpi obulamu bwonna n’omwoyo gw’eddiini. Ku kyokubiri ngamba nti, ebigambo ebyo byogerwa mu kamwa k’abatakkiriza, abo, olw’okuba tebalina liiso lisobola kulaba mu mutima gw’Omulangira waffe, kyebava bamusalira omusango nga basinziira ku bunaku bw’endabika ye ey’ebweru; nga bali abo abatamanyi nti amayinja ag’omuwendo omungi gabikkiddwako ekikuta ekitali kirungi, bwe bazuula erimu, olw’obutamanya kye bazudde, ne balisuula nate, ng’abantu bwe basuula ejjinja eryabulijjo.

Kale, Gaayo bwe yagamba, kaakano nga muli wano, era nga bwe mmanyi nti Omwami Omutima-Omuzira mukugu mu by’okulwanyisa bye, bwe kinaabasanyusa, bwe tunaamala okuwummula, tujja kutambulako mu nnimiro, tulabe obanga tuyinza okukola ekirungi. Mayiro nga emu okuva wano waliwo omuwagguufu ayitibwa Atta-Abalungi, atawaanya nnyo oluguudo lwa Kabaka mu bitundu bino; era mmanyi awo w’abeera. Ye mukulu w’ababbi bangi: ‘kyandibadde kirungi’ singa tumugoba mu bitundu bino. Awo ne bakkiriza ne bagenda: Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’ekitala kye, n’enkoofiira ey’ekyuma, n’engabo; n’abalala n’amafumu n’emiggo.

Bwe baatuuka mu kifo we yali, ne bamusanga ng’akutte omusajja ayitibwa Omwoyo-Omunafu mu ngalo ze, abaddu be gwe baali bamuleetedde, nga bamukwatidde mu kkubo. Omuwagguufu yali amunyaga, ng’agenderera oluvannyuma okumukomba amagumba; kubanga yali wa kika ky’abalya ennyama y’abantu.

Kale, olwalaba Omwami Omutima-Omuzira ne mikwano gye ku mulyango gw’empuku ye, nga balina eby’okulwanyisa byabwe, n’ababuuza kye baagala.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Twagala ggwe; kubanga tuzze okuwoolera eggwanga ku lw’abatambuze bangi be wattira, bwe wabawalula okubaggya ku luguudo lwa Kabaka: kale fuluma mu mpuku yo. Awo ne yeesiba eby’okulwanyisa n’afuluma, ne beesogga olutalo, ne balwana okusukka essaawa emu, ne balyoka bayimirira okussa omukka.

Atta-Abalungi: Awo omuwagguufu n’agamba nti, Lwaki muli wano ku ttaka lyange?

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Okuwoolera eggwanga ku lw’omusaayi gw’abatambuze, nga bwe nnakugambye edda. Awo ne beeyongera okulwana nate, omuwagguufu n’azzaayo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira emabega; naye n’addamu n’ajja, era mu bukulu bw’omwoyo gwe n’akuba n’amaanyi mangi omutwe gw’omuwagguufu n’embiriizi ze, n’amuleetera okusuula ekyokulwanyisa kye. Awo n’amukuba, n’amutta, n’amusala omutwe, n’agutwala ku nnyumba y’abagenyi. Era n’atwala omutambuze Omwoyo-Omunafu, n’amuleeta naye mu kifo we yali asula. Bwe baatuuka eka, ne balaga ab’omu nnyumba omutwe gwe, ne baguwanika, nga bwe baakola ku balala edda, okutiisa abo abanaagezaako okukola nga ye mu biseera ebijja.

Awo ne babuuza Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu engeri gye yagwa mu mikono gye.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Awo omusajja omwavu n’agamba nti, Ndi musajja mulwadde, nga bwe mulaba: era olw’okuba okufa kwakonkonanga ku luggi lwange buli lunaku, nnalowooza nti siriba bulungi n’akatono nga ndi waka; kyenava nneewaayo eri obulamu bw’omutambuze, era ntambudde okutuuka wano nga nva mu kibuga ky’Obutakakasa, nze ne kitange gye twazaalibwa. Sirina maanyi n’akatono mu mubiri, wadde mu birowoozo, naye, singa nnali nsobola, newaakubadde nga nnyinza kwewalula bwewaluzi, nandyagadde okumala obulamu bwange mu kkubo ly’omutambuze. Bwe nnatuuka ku mulyango oguli ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo, Mukama w’ekifo ekyo yannyaniriza bwereere; teyawakanya ndabika yange ey’obunafu, wadde omwoyo gwange omunafu; naye n’ampa ebintu ebyali byetaagisa mu lugendo lwange, n’aŋŋamba nsuubirenga okutuusa ku nkomerero. Bwe nnatuuka mu nnyumba y’Omuvvuunuzi, nnafunayo ekisa kingi: era olw’okuba Olusozi Oluzibu lwalabika nga luzibu nnyo gye ndi, nnasitulibwa omu ku baddu be okululinnya. Ddala, nfunye obuyambi bungi okuva eri abatambuze, newaakubadde nga tewali n’omu yayagala kutambula mpola nga nze bwe mpalirizibwa okutambula: naye buli lwe baatuukanga, baŋŋambanga ngume omwoyo, era ne bagamba nti Mukama waabwe ayagala abalina omwoyo omunafu bagumizibwenga, 1 Basessaloniika 5:14; ne beeyongerayo n’obwangu bwabwe. Bwe nnatuuka ku Kakubo k’Okulumba, omuwagguufu ono n’ansisinkana, n’aŋŋamba neetegekere olutalo. Naye, zisanze, nze omunafu, nnali nneetaaga kya kunywa ekizzaamu amaanyi; awo n’ajja n’ankwata. Nnalowooza nti tagenda kunzita. Era bwe yamala okunnyingiza mu mpuku ye, olw’okuba saagenda naye ku bwange, nnakkiriza nti ndivaamu nga ndi mulamu; kubanga mpulidde nti tewali mutambuze n’omu akwatibwa mu buwambe n’emikono egy’ekikambwe, bw’akuuma omutima gwe nga mulamba eri Mukama we, ateekwa, okusinziira ku nteekateeka ya Katonda, okufiira mu mukono gw’omulabe. Nnasuubira okunyagibwa, era ddala nnyagiddwa; naye nga bwe mulaba, ndokose n’obulamu, ekyo kye nneebaliza Kabaka wange ng’ensibuko yaakyo, nammwe ng’abaakozesebwa. Nsuubira n’ebirumbe ebirala; naye kino kye mmaliridde, kwe kugamba, okudduka bwe nsobola, okutambula bwe siyinza kudduka, n’okwewalula bwe siyinza kutambula. Ku nsonga enkulu, nneebaza oyo eyanjagala, ndi munywevu; ekkubo lyange liri mu maaso gange, omwoyo gwange guli emitala w’omugga ogutaaliko lutindo, newaakubadde nga, bwe mulaba, ndi wa mwoyo munafu.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Awo Omwami Ow’amazima omukadde n’agamba nti, Edda tewamanyanga omutambuze omu ayitibwa Omwami Atyatya?

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Okumumanya! Yee, yava mu Kibuga ky’Obusirusiru, ekiri amadaala ana ebukiikakkono w’Ekibuga eky’Okuzikirira, era amadaala ge gamu okuva we nnazaalibwa; naye twamanyagana nnyo, kubanga ddala yali kitange omuto, muganda wa kitange. Ye nange twali ba mbala emu: yali mumpi katono okusinga nze, naye twafaanagana nnyo mu ndabika.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Ndaba nga wamumanya, era nzikiriza nti mwali ba luganda; kubanga olina langi ye enjeru, otunula ng’ono, era n’enjogera yammwe efaanagana nnyo.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Abasinga obungi abaatumanya ffembi bwe batyo bwe baagamba: era n’ekirala, bye nnalaba mu ye, okusinga nnabisanga ne mu nze.

Gaayo: Jangu, ssebo, Gaayo omulungi bwe yagamba, guma omwoyo; nkwanirizza gye ndi ne mu nnyumba yange. Kyonna ky’oyagala, kisabe nga teweekomya; era kyonna ky’oyagala abaddu bange bakukolere, bajja kukikola n’omutima omwangu.

Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’agamba nti, Kino kisa kye nnali sisuubira, era kiri ng’enjuba eyakaayakana okuva mu kire ekiddugavu ennyo. Omuwagguufu Atta-Abalungi yali agenderera kunkolera kisa kino bwe yanziyiza n’amalirira obutandeka kweyongerayo? Yali agenderera nti bw’amala okunyaga ensawo zange, ŋŋende ewa Gaayo omusembeza wange? Naye bwe kityo bwe kiri.

Awo, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu ne Gaayo bwe baali nga boogera bwe batyo, ne wajja omuntu ng’adduka, n’akoona ku luggi, n’agamba nti ewala nga mayiro emu n’ekitundu waliwo omutambuze omu, Omwami Atali-Mutuufu, eyakubiddwa okubwatuka kw’eggulu n’afiira awo w’abadde.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Woowe! Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu bwe yagamba, attiddwa? Yansanga ennaku ntono nga sinnatuuka wano, n’ayagala tutambulire wamu. Era yali nange Omuwagguufu Atta-Abalungi bwe yankwata, naye ye yali wa bigere byangu n’adduka; naye kirabika yadduka agende afe, nze ne nkwatibwa ndyoke mbeere mulamu.

“Ekyo omuntu ky’alowooza nti kigenderera kutta ddala,

Emirundi mingi kye kiwonya mu buzibu obusingayo.

Okulabirira kwa Katonda okwo kwennyini okulabika ng’okufa,

Emirundi mingi kwe kuwa abeetoowaze obulamu.

Nze nnakwatibwa, ye n’awona n’adduka;

Emikono egyakyusibwa gyamuwa okufa, nze ne gimpa obulamu.”

Awo mu kiseera ekyo Matayo n’Okusaasira ne bafumbiriganwa; era Gaayo n’awa Yakobo, muganda wa Matayo, muwala we Foyibe okuba mukazi we; oluvannyuma lw’ekyo ne beeyongera okubeera mu nnyumba ya Gaayo ennaku nga kkumi, nga bakozesa ebiseera byabwe ng’abatambuze bwe bakola bulijjo.

Bwe baali bagenda okusitula, Gaayo n’abafumbira embaga, ne balya ne banywa ne basanyuka. Awo essaawa n’etuuka nga bateekwa okugenda; Omwami Omutima-Omuzira kyeyava asaba okubalirirwa ebyo bye baakozesa. Naye Gaayo n’amugamba nti mu nnyumba ye si mpisa batambuze kusasula olw’okusembezebwa. Abatambuze yabasuzanga ku ndagaano ya mwaka, naye empeera ye yagisuubiranga okuva eri Omusamaliya omulungi, eyamusuubiza nti bw’alikomawo, buli kyonna ky’alibakozesaako alikimuddizaawo n’obwesigwa. Lukka 10:34,35. Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’amugamba nti,

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Omwagalwa, okola ekintu kya bwesigwa buli lw’okolera abooluganda ebirungi na ddala ababeera ku ŋŋendo ne bw’oba tobamanyi. Baategeeza Ekkanisa omukwano gwe wabalaga awamu ne bye wabakolera. Kibeera kirungi singa obasiibuza ekirabo ekiba kisaanidde. 3 Yokaana 5,6. Awo Gaayo n’asiibula bonna, n’abaana be, na ddala Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu. Era n’amuwa eky’okunywa mu kkubo.

Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu, bwe baali bafuluma mu mulyango, n’alabika ng’ayagala okusigala emabega. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yakiraba, n’agamba nti, Jangu, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu, nkwegayiridde genda naffe: nze nnaakukulemberanga, era onooyisibwanga ng’abalala.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Woowe! Sirina munnange ansaanira. Mmwe mwenna muli ba maanyi era bagumu, naye nze, nga bw’olaba, ndi munafu; kyenva nsalawo okujja emabega, nneme okuba omugugu eri nze kennyini n’eri mmwe olw’obunafu bwange obungi. Ndi, nga bwe nnyogedde, omusajja ow’omwoyo omunafu era ogutalina maanyi, era nja kwesittala ne nnafuwa olw’ebyo abalala bye basobola okugumira. Sijja kwagala kuseka; sijja kwagala byambalo bya kweyoleka; sijja kwagala bibuuzo ebitaliimu nsa. Weewaawo, ndi munafu nnyo ne kiba nti nneesittala olw’ebyo abalala bye balina eddembe okukola. Sinnamanya mazima gonna: ndi mukkiriza atamanyi nnyo. Oluusi bwe mpulira abamu nga basanyukira mu Mukama, kinneeraliikiriza kubanga nze siyinza kukola bwe ntyo. Kiri gye ndi nga bwe kiba eri omunafu mu b’amaanyi, oba omulwadde mu balamu, oba ng’ettaala enyoomebwa; ne kiba nti simanyi kye nkola. “Abantu abali mu ddembe lyabwe batera okusekerera abali mu mitawaana, ng’ebizibu bwe biba ku abo ababa batuuse awazibu.” Yobu 12:5.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Naye, ow’oluganda, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yagamba, nnalagirwa okugumyanga abalimu okutya n’okuyambanga abatalina maanyi. Oteekwa okugenda naffe; tujja kukulindanga; tujja kukuyambanga; tujja kwefiiriza ebintu ebimu, eby’endowooza n’eby’empisa, ku lulwo: tetujja kuyingira mu mpaka ez’ebibuusibwabuusibwa mu maaso go; tujja kufuuka byonna gy’oli, okusinga okukuleka emabega. 1 Basessaloniika 5:14; Abaruumi 14; 1 Abakkolinso 8:9-13; 9:22.

Awo, mu kiseera kino kyonna baali ku mulyango gwa Gaayo; era laba, bwe baali bakyali mu bbugumu ly’okwogera kwabwe, Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera n’ayitawo, ng’akutte emiggo gye egy’okwesigamako mu ngalo, era naye yali ku lugendo lw’obutambuze.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’amugamba nti, Musajja, wazze otya wano? Kaakano kaakano nnabadde nneemulugunya nti sirina munnange ansaanira, naye ggwe oli nga bwe nnali njagala. Nkwanirizza, nkwanirizza, Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera omulungi; nsuubira nti ggwe nange tuyinza okuyambagana.

Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera: Nja kusanyuka okubeera naawe, omulala bwe yagamba; era, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu omulungi, okusinga okwawukana, kubanga tusisinkanye bulungi bwe tutyo, nja kukuwola gumu ku miggo gyange.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Nedda, bwe yagamba, newaakubadde nkwebaza olw’omutima gwo omulungi, saagala kuwenyera nga sinnalemala. Naye ndowooza nti bwe kinaabanga kyetaagisa, guyinza okunnyamba okulwanyisa embwa.

Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera: Oba nze kennyini oba emiggo gyange bwe tunaasobola okukusanyusa, ffembi tuli mu buyinza bwo, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu omulungi.

Bwe batyo ne beeyongerayo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’Omwami Ow’amazima ne bakulembera, Christiana n’abaana be ne baddako, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’ajja emabega, wamu n’Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera n’emiggo gye. Awo Omwami Ow’amazima n’agamba nti,

Omwami Ow’amazima: Nkwegayiridde, ssebo, kaakano nga tuli ku kkubo, tubuulire ebintu ebigasa ku abamu abaatukulembera ku lugendo lw’obutambuze.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: N’essanyu lingi. Ndowooza wawulira Omukristaayo bwe yasisinkana edda Apolwoni mu Kiwonvu ky’Okwetoowaza, era n’okutawaana kungi kwe yalina okuyita mu Kiwonvu ky’Ekisiikirize ky’Okufa. Era ndowooza tewayinza butawulira Omwesigwa bwe yagezesebwa Nnyabo Omwenzi, Adamu Eyasooka, omu ayitibwa Obutamatira, n’Ensonyi; abakuusa bana abasinga obubi omuntu b’ayinza okusanga ku kkubo.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Yee, ebyo byonna nnabiwulira; naye ddala Omwesigwa omulungi Ensonyi ye yamukaluubiriza okusinga: oyo yali takoowa.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Weewaawo; kubanga, ng’omutambuze bwe yayogera obulungi, mu bantu bonna ye yalina erinnya eritamusaanira.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Naye nkwegayiridde, ssebo, Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa baasisinkana wa Ayogerayogera? Oyo naye yali wa kitalo.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Yali musirusiru eyeekakasa ennyo; naye bangi bagoberera amakubo ge.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Yabulako katono okulimbalimba Omwesigwa.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Weewaawo, naye Omukristaayo n’amulaga engeri ey’okumutegeera amangu.

Bwe batyo ne beeyongerayo okutuusa lwe baatuuka mu kifo Omubuulizi we yasisinkana Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa, n’abalagula ebyali bigenda okubatuukako mu Katale k’Obutaliimu. Awo omukulembeze waabwe n’agamba nti, Wano we waali Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa we baasisinkana Omubuulizi, eyabalagula ebizibu bye baali bagenda okusanga mu Katale k’Obutaliimu.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Bw’otyo bw’ogamba? Nzikiriza nti essuula gye yabasomera olwo yali nzibu.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Bwe kyali, naye era n’abazzaamu amaanyi. Naye lwaki twogera ku bo? Baali basajja babiri ab’amaanyi ng’empologoma; baali bakakanyazizza obwenyi bwabwe ng’ejjinja. Tojjukira nga tebaatya n’akatono bwe baayimirira mu maaso g’omulamuzi?

Omwami Ow’amazima: Kale: Omwesigwa yabonaabona n’obuzira.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Bwe kyali, era ebirungi eby’ekitiibwa ne bivaamu; kubanga Asuubira n’abalala abamu, ng’olugero bwe lugamba, baakyuka olw’okufa kwe.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Kale, naye nkwegayiridde weeyongereyo; kubanga ebintu obimanyi bulungi.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Mu bonna Omukristaayo be yasisinkana ng’amaze okuyita mu Katale k’Obutaliimu, omu ayitibwa Eyeenoonyeza ye yali kafulu asinga.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Eyeenoonyeza! Yali ani oyo?

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Omusajja omukujjukujju ennyo, omunnanfuusi ddala; omu eyayagalanga okulabika ng’atya Katonda, ensi ne bw’edda ludda wa; naye nga mugezigezi nnyo ne kiba nti yakakasanga obutafiirwa wadde okubonaabona olw’ekyo. Yalina engeri ye ey’eddiini ku buli mbeera empya, ne mukazi we yali amanyi ekyo nga ye. Yakyukanga okuva ku ndowooza emu okudda ku ndala; weewaawo, era yawolerezanga n’okukola bw’atyo. Naye, nga bwe nnasobola okutegeera, yafuna enkomerero embi n’ebigendererwa bye ebyekusifu; era sawulirangako nti omu ku baana be yali assibwamu ekitiibwa eri abo abaatyanga Katonda ddala.

Awo mu kiseera ekyo baali batuuse we basobola okulengera Ekibuga ky’Obutaliimu, Akatale k’Obutaliimu gye kabeera. Bwe baalaba nga batuuse kumpi n’ekibuga, ne bateesa bokka na bokka engeri gye banaakiyitamu; abamu ne bagamba kino, abalala kiri. Ku nkomerero Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Nga bwe muyinza okutegeera, emirundi mingi nkulembeddemu abatambuze nga bayita mu kibuga kino. Kaakano mmanyi omu ayitibwa Omwami Munasoni, Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:16, Omukupulo mu ggwanga, omuyigirizwa ow’edda, mu nnyumba ye mwe tuyinza okusula. Bwe munaalaba nga kirungi, tujja kukyamirayo.

Kirungi, Ow’amazima omukadde bwe yagamba; Kirungi, Christiana bwe yagamba; Kirungi, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu bwe yagamba; era bwe batyo bonna bwe baagamba. Kaakano mulowooze nti bwe baatuuka ku mabbali g’ekibuga obudde bwali buwungeera; naye Omwami Omutima-Omuzira yali amanyi ekkubo eridda ku nnyumba y’omukadde. Bwe batyo ne batuukayo; n’akoona ku luggi, omukadde ali munda n’amanya eddoboozi lye amangu ddala nga yaakaliwulira; n’aggulawo oluggi, bonna ne bayingira. Awo Munasoni, omusembeza waabwe, n’agamba nti, Leero muvudde wala wa? Ne bamugamba nti, okuva mu nnyumba ya Gaayo mukwano gwaffe. Mbategeeza, bwe yagamba, mutambudde olugendo luwanvu. Mugwanidde okuba nga mukooye; mutuule. Bwe batyo ne batuula.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Awo omukulembeze waabwe n’agamba nti, Kale, mutya, bassebo abalungi? Nkakasa nti mukwano gwange abasanyukidde.

Omwami Munasoni: Nange, Omwami Munasoni bwe yagamba, mbaaniriza; era kyonna kye mwetaaga, mukyogere bwogezi, era tujja kukola kye tusobola okukibafunira.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Kye twetaaganga ennyo emabegako, kwe kwali okufuna aw’okusula n’abantu abalungi ab’okubeera nabo, era kaakano nsuubira nti byombi tubirina.

Omwami Munasoni: Aw’okusula, mulaba bwe kuli; naye abantu abalungi, ekyo kirirabika nga kigezeseddwa.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Kale, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yagamba, onootwala abatambuze waggulu mu bisenge byabwe?

Omwami Munasoni: Nja kubatwala, Omwami Munasoni bwe yagamba. Bw’atyo n’abatwala buli omu mu kifo kye; era n’abalaga n’ekisenge eky’okuliiramu ekirungi ennyo, mwe basobola okubeera n’okulya ekyeggulo awamu okutuusa ekiseera eky’okugenda okuwummula lwe kinaatuuka.

Awo bwe baali batudde mu bifo byabwe, nga bawummuddeko katono oluvannyuma lw’olugendo lwabwe, Omwami Ow’amazima n’abuuza nnyini nnyumba oba mu kibuga mulimu abantu abalungi abangi.

Omwami Munasoni: Tulinamu batono: kubanga ddala batono nnyo bw’obageraageranya n’ab’oludda olulala.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Naye tunaakola tutya okulabako ku bamu ku bo? kubanga okulaba abantu abalungi eri abo abali ku lugendo lw’obutambuze kiri ng’okulabika kw’omwezi n’emmunyeenye eri abo abasaabala ku nnyanja.

Omwami Munasoni: Awo Omwami Munasoni n’akuba ekigere kye wansi, muwala we Ekisa n’ayambuka. N’amugamba nti, Ekisa, genda obategeeze mikwano gyange, Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese, Omwami Omusajja-Omutukuvu, Omwami Ayagala-Abatukuvu, Omwami Atayaŋŋanga-Kulimba, n’Omwami Omwenenyi, nti nnina mukwano gwange omu oba babiri mu nnyumba yange abaagala okubalaba akawungeezi kano. Awo Ekisa n’agenda okubayita, ne bajja; era bwe baamala okulamusagana, ne batuula wamu ku mmeeza.

Awo Omwami Munasoni nnyini nnyumba n’agamba nti, Baliraanwa bange, nga bwe mulaba, nnina ekibinja ky’abagenyi abazze mu nnyumba yange; batambuze: bava wala, era bagenda ku Lusozi Sayuuni. Naye, bwe yagamba, mulowooza ono ye ani? ng’asonga engalo ye ku Christiana. Ye Christiana, mukazi w’Omukristaayo, omutambuze omwatiikirivu, eyayisibwa obubi ennyo n’ensonyi mu kibuga kyaffe wamu ne muganda we Omwesigwa. Ekyo ne kibewuunyisa nnyo, ne bagamba nti, Twali tetulowooza n’akatono okulaba Christiana Ekisa bwe yajja okutuyita; kale kino kitwewuunyisa era kitusanyusa nnyo. Awo ne bamubuuza bw’ali, era oba abavubuka bano baali batabani ba bba. Bwe yamala okubagamba nti bwe kiri, ne bagamba nti, Kabaka gwe mwagala era gwe muweereza abafuule nga kitammwe, era abatuuse gy’ali mu mirembe.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Awo Omwami Ow’amazima (bwe baamala okutuula bonna) n’abuuza Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese n’abalala, ekibuga kyabwe kiri kitya mu kiseera kino.

Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese: Mukakase nti mu biseera by’akatale tuba mu kavuyo kangi. Kizibu okukuuma emitima gyaffe n’emyoyo gyaffe nga biri mu nteekateeka ennungi nga tuli mu mbeera enzibu bw’etyo. Oyo abeera mu kifo ng’ekino, era ng’alina ky’akola n’abantu nga be tulina, yeetaaga ekimujjukiza nti ‘Weegendereze’ buli kaseera ka lunaku.

Omwami Ow’amazima: Naye kaakano baliraanwa bammwe bali batya mu by’emirembe?

Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese: Kaakano bakkakkamu nnyo okusinga edda. Mumanyi Omukristaayo n’Omwesigwa bwe baayisibwa mu kibuga kyaffe; naye mu biseera bino, nkiddamu, bakkakkanye nnyo. Ndowooza omusaayi gw’Omwesigwa gubazitoowerera ng’omugugu n’okutuusa kaakano; kubanga okuva lwe baamwokya, bakwatiddwa ensonyi okwokya omulala. Mu nnaku ezo twatyanga okutambula mu luguudo; naye kaakano tusobola okweraga. Mu kiseera ekyo erinnya ly’omuntu eyeeyatula okukkiriza lyali likyayibwa; kaakano, naddala mu bitundu ebimu eby’ekibuga kyaffe, (kubanga mumanyi nti ekibuga kyaffe kinene,) eddiini etwalibwa ng’ey’ekitiibwa. Awo Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese n’abagamba nti, Nkwegayiridde, mmwe mutambula mutya mu lugendo lwammwe? ensi ebatwala etya?

Omwami Ow’amazima: Kitutuukako nga bwe kituuka ku batambuze ab’omu kkubo: oluusi ekkubo lyaffe liba ddungi, oluusi libi; oluusi twambuka lusozi, oluusi tukka; tetutera kuba na kakasa. Empewo tebeera bulijjo emabega waffe, era si buli gwe tusanga mu kkubo nga mukwano gwaffe. Tumaze okusanga ebizibu ebimu eby’amaanyi, era ebikyatulindiridde tetubimanyi; naye ebiseera ebisinga tukisanga nga kya mazima ekyayogerwa edda, nti Omuntu omulungi ateekwa okubonaabona.

Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese: Mwogera ku bizibu; bizibu ki bye mwasanze?

Omwami Ow’amazima: Nedda, buuza Omwami Omutima-Omuzira, omukulembeze waffe; kubanga ye y’asobola okukinnyonnyola obulungi okusinga.

Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Tumaze okulumbibwa emirundi esatu oba ena. Okusooka, Christiana n’abaana be baalumbibwa abasajja babiri abakambwe, be baatya nti bajja kubatta. Twalumbibwa Omuwagguufu Omuyiwa-Musaayi, Omuwagguufu Ennyondo, n’Omuwagguufu Atta-Abalungi. Ddala, ow’enkomerero ffe twamulumba okusinga ye bwe yatulumba. Era bwe kityo bwe kyali: bwe twamala ebbanga mu nnyumba ya Gaayo omusembeza wange era ow’ekkanisa yonna, lumu ne tusalawo okutwala ebyokulwanyisa byaffe tugende tulabe oba tunaasanga omu ku abo abalabe b’abatambuze; kubanga twawulira nti waaliwo omu ow’amaanyi mu kitundu ekyo. Gaayo yali amanyi ekisulo kye okusinga nze, kubanga yabeeranga eyo. Ne tunoonya, ne tunoonya, okutuusa ku nkomerero lwe twalaba omulyango gw’empuku ye: awo ne tusanyuka, ne tuzzaamu amaanyi. Ne tusembera ku mpuku ye; era laba, bwe twatuukayo, yali awalulidde mu kitimba kye n’amaanyi gokka omusajja ono omunaku, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu, era yali anaatera okumutta. Naye bwe yatulaba, ng’alowooza, nga bwe twalowooza, nti afunye omuyiggo omulala, n’aleka omusajja omunaku mu kinnya kye, n’afuluma. Awo ne tumugwamu nnyo, naye ye n’alwana n’amaanyi gonna; naye ku nkomerero n’asuulibwa wansi, omutwe gwe ne gutemebwa, ne guteekebwa ku mabbali g’ekkubo okutiisa abo abandyagadde okukola obubi ng’obwo. Okukakasa nti mbagamba mazima, wuuno omusajja yennyini akikakasa, eyali ng’omwana gw’endiga oguggiddwa mu kamwa k’empologoma.

Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’agamba nti, Kino nnakisanga nga kya mazima, nga kimbonyaabonya era nga kimbudaabuda: kyambonyaabonya bwe yatiisatiisanga okukomba amagumba gange buli kaseera; era kyambudaabuda bwe nnalaba Omwami Omutima-Omuzira ne mikwano gye, n’ebyokulwanyisa byabwe, nga basembera kumpi bwe batyo okumponya.

Omwami Omusajja-Omutukuvu: Awo Omwami Omusajja-Omutukuvu n’agamba nti, Waliwo ebintu bibiri abo abatambula olugendo lw’obutambuze bye beetaaga okuba nabyo; obuvumu, n’obulamu obutaliiko bbala. Bwe batabeera na buvumu, tebasobola kunywerera ku kkubo lyabwe; era obulamu bwabwe bwe bunaabanga bwa mpisa mbi, banaawunyisa erinnya lyennyini ery’omutambuze.

Omwami Ayagala-Abatukuvu: Awo Omwami Ayagala-Abatukuvu n’agamba nti, Nsuubira nti okulabula kuno tekwetaagisa mu mmwe: naye ddala waliwo bangi abatambula ku kkubo, abeeraga nga bannaggwanga eri obutambuze, okusinga okuba bagenyi bugenyi abatambuze ku nsi.

Omwami Atayaŋŋanga-Kulimba: Awo Omwami Atayaŋŋanga-Kulimba n’agamba nti, ‘Kituufu’. Tebalina kyambalo kya mutambuze, newaakubadde obuvumu bw’omutambuze; tebatambula bugolokofu, naye ebigere byabwe bikyamye; engatto emu edda munda, endala ebweru; n’ebibikka amagulu gaabwe biyulise emabega: wano ekiwero, eri ekituli, ne kiswaza Mukama waabwe.

Omwami Omwenenyi: Ebintu ebyo, Omwami Omwenenyi bwe yagamba, bandibinakuwalidde; era abatambuze tebajja kusiimibwa nga bwe beegomba, bo n’Olugendo lw’Omutambuze lwabwe, okutuusa ekkubo lwe linaalongoosebwa okuggyako amabala n’obulema ng’ebyo. Bwe batyo ne batuula nga banyumya era nga bayisa ekiseera okutuusa ekyeggulo lwe kyateekebwa ku mmeeza, ne bagenda okulya, ne bazzaamu amaanyi emibiri gyabwe egyakoowa: awo ne bagenda okuwummula.

Awo ne babeera mu katale ebbanga ddene, mu nnyumba y’Omwami Munasoni, eyawa, ebbanga bwe lyagenda liyitawo, muwala we Ekisa Samwiri, mutabani w’Omukristaayo, okuba mukazi we, ne muwala we Maliza n’amuwa Yusufu.

Ebbanga, nga bwe nnayogedde, lye baamala wano lyali ddene, kubanga tekyali nga mu biseera eby’edda. Abatambuze kyebaava bamanyagana n’abantu abalungi bangi ab’omu kibuga, era ne babakolera buli buweereza bwe baasobola. Okusaasira, nga bwe yali yeemanyiiza, yakolera nnyo abaavu: embuto zaabwe n’emigongo gyabwe kyebyava bimwebaza, era yali eyo ng’ekyokwewunda eri okukkiriza kwe yayatula. Era, okwogera amazima ku Kisa, Foyibe, ne Maliza, bonna baali ba mbala nnungi nnyo, era baakola ebirungi bingi mu bifo byabwe. Era bonna baazaala nnyo; n’olwekyo erinnya ly’Omukristaayo, nga bwe kyayogerwa edda, lyali lirabika nga lijja kusigala nga liramu mu nsi.

Bwe baali bakyali wano, ne wava ekisolo eky’entiisa mu kibira, ne kitta bangi ku bantu b’omu kibuga. Era kyatwalanga abaana baabwe, ne kibayigiriza okuyonsa abaana baakyo. Awo, tewaali muntu mu kibuga eyagezangako n’okukyolekera; naye bonna baddukanga bwe baawuliranga oluyoogaano lw’okujja kwakyo.

Ekisolo ekyo tekyafaanana nsolo yonna ku nsi. Omubiri gwakyo gwali ng’ogw’ogusota, era kyalina emitwe omusanvu n’amayembe ekkumi. Kyayonoona nnyo abaana, naye nga kifugibwa omukazi. Okubikkulirwa 17:3. Ekisolo kino kyateeranga abantu obukwakkulizo; era abantu abo abaayagalanga obulamu bwabwe okusinga emmeeme zaabwe, ne bakkiriza obukwakkulizo obwo. Bwe batyo ne bakigondera.

Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira, wamu n’abo abajja okukyalira abatambuze mu nnyumba y’Omwami Munasoni, ne bakola endagaano okugenda okulwana n’ekisolo kino, oboolyawo basobole okununula abantu b’ekibuga kino mu nzala ne mu kamwa k’omusota guno omuzikiriza bwe gutyo.

Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira, Omwami Omutima-Ogumenyese, Omwami Omusajja-Omutukuvu, Omwami Atayaŋŋanga-Kulimba, n’Omwami Omwenenyi, n’ebyokulwanyisa byabwe, ne bafuluma okukisisinkana. Awo ekisolo ku ntandikwa kyali kikambwe nnyo, era ne kitunuulira abalabe bano n’okunyooma kungi; naye ne bakikuba nnyo, kubanga baali basajja bagumu mu kulwana, ne bakiddusa emabega: bwe batyo ne baddayo mu nnyumba y’Omwami Munasoni.

Ekisolo, mumanye, kyalina ebiseera byakyo ebimanyiddwa mwe kyafulumiranga, okulumba abaana b’abantu b’omu kibuga. Mu biseera ebyo abazira bano ab’ekitiibwa baakirindiriranga, ne bakirumba buli kiseera; ne kiba nti ebbanga bwe lyagenda liyitawo tekyafuna biwundu byokka, wabula n’okulemala. Era tekyonoonye abaana b’abantu b’omu kibuga nga bwe kyakolanga edda; era abamu bakkiriza ddala nti ekisolo kino kijja kufa olw’ebiwundu byakyo.

Kino, n’olwekyo, kyafuula Omwami Omutima-Omuzira ne banne okwatiikirira ennyo mu kibuga kino; ne kiba nti abantu bangi abaali tebalina kuwooma kwa bintu bino, baabassaamu ekitiibwa era ne babawa ekifo. Olw’ensonga eyo, abatambuze bano tebaakolebwako kabi kangi wano. Kya mazima, waaliwo abamu ku b’ekika ekya wansi, abataasobola kulaba okusinga emmese ey’omu ttaka, wadde okutegeera okusinga ensolo; bano tebaassa kitiibwa mu basajja bano, era tebaafaayo ku buzira bwabwe n’ebikolwa byabwe eby’obuvumu.
fields.body_text: Awo ne ndaba nga beeyongerayo ku kasozi akaali katono mu maaso, akaali kaagulumizibwa abatambuze balyoke bayinze okulengera ewala. Ekyo kye kifo Omukristaayo we yasookera okulengera Omwesigwa muganda we. Noolwekyo wano we baatuula ne bawummulamu. Era wano baalya ne banywa ne basanyuka, kubanga baali bawonye omulabe ow’akabi bw’atyo. Bwe baali batudde nga balya, Christiana n’abuuza omukulembeze oba nga yalumiziddwa mu lutalo. Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Nedda, okuggyako akatono ku mubiri gwange; naye n’ekyo tekiriba kya kunfiiriza, wabula kaakano kiraga okwagala kwe nnina eri Mukama wange ne gye muli, era kiriba, ku bw’ekisa, eky’okwongera ku mpeera yange ku nkomerero. Christiana: Naye tewatya, ssebo omulungi, bwe wamulaba ng’ajja n’omuggo gwe? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Kye nteekwa okukola, bwe yagamba, kwe kubuusabuusa amaanyi gange nze, ndyoke nneesige Oyo asinga bonna amaanyi. Christiana: Naye walowooza ki bwe yakusuula wansi ku muggo ogwasooka? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nnalowooza, bwe yagamba, nti ne Mukama wange yennyini bwe yakolebwa bw’atyo, naye ye yawangula ku nkomerero. 2 Abakkolinso 4:10,11; Abaruumi 8:37. Matayo: Mmwe mwenna ne bwe munaalowooza kye mwagala, nze ndowooza nti Katonda atukoledde ebirungi eby’ekitalo, mu kutuggya mu kiwonvu kino, ne mu kutuwonya mu mukono gw’omulabe ono. Nze ndaba nga tewali nsonga lwaki twandiddamu okubuusabuusa Katonda waffe, kubanga kaakano, era mu kifo nga kino, atuwadde obujulirwa obw’engeri eyo obw’okwagala kwe. Awo ne bagolokoka ne beeyongerayo. Awo katono mu maaso gaabwe waaliwo omuti omunene; era wansi waagwo, bwe baagutuukako, ne basanga omutambuze omukadde nga yeebase otulo tungi. Baamanya nti mutambuze olw’engoye ze, n’omuggo gwe, n’olukoba lwe. Awo omukulembeze, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira, n’amuzuukusa; omukadde bwe yayimusa amaaso ge, n’aleekaana nti, Kiki? Muli baani; era mukola ki wano? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Wewummuze, munnange, toba na busungu bwe butyo; wano tewali balala wabula mikwano gyokka. Naye omukadde n’ayimirira, ne yeekuuma, era ng’ayagala okumanya oba bantu ba ngeri ki. Awo omukulembeze n’agamba nti, Erinnya lyange nze Omutima-Omuzira: ndi mukulembeze w’abatambuze bano abagenda mu nsi ey’Eggulu. Omwami Ow’amazima: Awo Omwami Ow’amazima n’agamba nti, Munsonyiwe: nnatya nti muli ku bbinja ly’abo abaanyaga Akkiriza-Kitono ssente ze edda; naye kaakano bwe nneetegereza obulungi, nkitegedde nga muli bantu ba mazima okusingawo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Kale wandikoze ki oba wandisobodde okukola ki okwetaasa, singa ddala twali ba bbinja eryo? Omwami Ow’amazima: Okukola! Nandirwanye okutuusa omukka nga gunzigwaamu: era singa nnakola bwe ntyo, nkakasa nti temwandisobodde kumpangula; kubanga omuntu wa Kristo tayinza kuwangulwa, okuggyako nga ye yennyini yeewaddeyo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Oyogedde bulungi, kitange Ow’amazima, omukulembeze bwe yagamba; kubanga kino kintegeeza nti oli kkookolo ow’ekika ekituufu, kubanga oyogedde amazima. Omwami Ow’amazima: Era kino nakyo kintegeeza nti ggwe omanyi olugendo olw’amazima kye ki; kubanga abalala bonna balowooza nti ffe tuwangulwa mangu okusinga bonna. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Kale, kaakano nga bwe tusisinkanye mu ssanyu bwe tutyo, nkwegayiridde ombuulire erinnya lyo, n’erinnya ly’ekifo gy’ova. Omwami Ow’amazima: Erinnya lyange siyinza kukubuulira, naye nva mu Kibuga ky’Obusirusiru: kiri nga ddiguli nnya emitala w’Ekibuga eky’Okuzikirira. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Owoo, ggwe oli wa mu nsi eyo? Kale ndowooza nga nkuteebereza ekitundu: erinnya lyo ye Amazima Omukadde, si bwe kiri? Omwami Ow’amazima: Awo omukadde n’amyuka mu maaso, n’agamba nti, Si Amazima ng’ekintu obwakyo, wabula Ow’amazima lye linnya lyange; era nsuubira nti empisa zange zinaakwatagana n’erinnya lye bampita. Naye ssebo, omukadde bwe yagamba, wasobola otya okuteebereza nti nze omuntu oyo, nga bwe nva mu kifo ekyo? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nnali nkuwuliddeko edda okuva eri Mukama wange; kubanga amanyi byonna ebikolebwa ku nsi. Naye emirundi mingi nneewuunya nti waliwo omuntu ayinza okuva mu kifo kyo; kubanga ekibuga kyo kibi okusinga n’Ekibuga eky’Okuzikirira kyennyini. Omwami Ow’amazima: Ye, ffe tuli wala nnyo n’enjuba, kye tuva tunnyogoga era nga tetuliiko kye tuwulira. Naye omuntu ne bw’aba mu lusozi lw’ebbalaafu, singa enjuba ey’obutuukirivu emwakira, omutima gwe ogwakwata ebbalaafu gulisaanuuka; era bwe kityo bwe kyali gye ndi. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nkikkiriza, kitange Ow’amazima, nkikkiriza; kubanga mmanyi nti ekyo kya mazima. Awo omukadde n’alamusa abatambuze bonna n’okunywegera okutukuvu okw’okwagala, n’ababuuza amannya gaabwe, n’engeri gye babaddemu okuva lwe baasimbula olugendo lwabwe. Christiana: Awo Christiana n’agamba nti, Erinnya lyange ndowooza nti oliwuliddeko; Omukristaayo omulungi ye yali baze, era bano abana be baana be. Naye oyinza okulowooza omukadde bwe yakwatibwako bwe yamubuulira nti y’ani? Yabuuka, yamwenya, n’abasabira emikisa lukumi, ng’agamba nti, Omwami Ow’amazima: Mpulidde bingi ku bba wo, n’ebikwata ku ŋŋendo ze n’entalo ze yayitamu mu nnaku ze. Kibe kya kukubudaabuda: erinnya lya bba wo liwulirwa mu bitundu byonna eby’ensi eno: okukkiriza kwe, obuzira bwe, obugumiikiriza bwe, n’obwesimbu bwe mu byonna, byali bifudde erinnya lye ery’ettutumu. Awo n’akyukira abalenzi, n’ababuuza amannya gaabwe, ne bamubuulira. Awo n’abagamba nti, Matayo, ofaanane Matayo omusolooza w’omusolo, si mu bubi, wabula mu mpisa ennungi. Matayo 10:3. Samwiri, bwe yagamba, ofaanane Samwiri nnabbi, omusajja ow’okukkiriza n’okusaba. Zabbuli 99:6. Yusufu, bwe yagamba, ofaanane Yusufu mu nnyumba ya Potifali, omulongoofu, era adduka okukemebwa. Olubereberye 39. Ne Yakobo, ofaanane Yakobo omutuukirivu, era ofaanane Yakobo muganda wa Mukama waffe. Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:13. Awo ne bamubuulira ku Kusaasira, n’engeri gye yaleka ekibuga kye n’ab’ekika kye okujja ne Christiana ne batabani be. Awo omukadde ow’amazima n’agamba nti, Okusaasira lye linnya lyo: okusaasira kwe kulikuwanirira ne kukuyisa mu bizibu byonna ebirikulumba mu kkubo lyo, okutuusa lw’olituuka eyo gy’olitunuulira Ensulo y’okusaasira mu maaso n’essanyu. Mu kiseera ekyo kyonna omukulembeze, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira, yali musanyufu nnyo, era ng’amwenyeza banne. Awo bwe baali batambulira wamu, omukulembeze n’abuuza omukadde oba nga tamanyi musajja omu, Omwami Atyatya, eyava mu bitundu by’ewaabwe ng’agenda ku lugendo. Omwami Ow’amazima: Yee, mmumanyi bulungi nnyo, bwe yagamba. Yali musajja eyalina ekikolo ky’ensonga mu ye; naye yali omu ku batambuze abasinga okutawaanya be nnali nsisinkanye mu nnaku zange zonna. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Ndaba nga wamumanya, kubanga omunnyonnyodde bulungi ddala. Omwami Ow’amazima: Okumumanya! Nnali munne ow’oku lusegere; nnabeeranga naye kumpi bulijjo; bwe yasooka okulowooza ku ebyo ebirijja gye tuli oluvannyuma, nnali naye. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nze nnali omukulembeze we okuva mu nnyumba ya Mukama wange okutuuka ku miryango gy’Ekibuga eky’Eggulu. Omwami Ow’amazima: Kale wamanya nti yali muntu wa kutawaanya. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Bwe kyali; naye nnasobola okukigumiikiriza bulungi; kubanga abantu ab’omulimu gwange batera okukwasibwa okukulembera abali nga ye. Omwami Ow’amazima: Kale nno, tukwegayiridde, tuwulire katono ku ye, n’engeri gye yeeyisaamu ng’ali mu bukulembeze bwo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Yali atya bulijjo nti aliremwa okutuuka gye yali ayagala okugenda. Buli kintu kye yawuliranga omuntu yenna ng’akyogerako kyamutiisanga, singa kyalimu akabonero akasembayo obutono ak’okuziyiza. Nnawulira nti yamala omwezi n’okusingawo ng’agalamidde ng’akaaba ku Kinnya ky’Okuggwaamu-Essuubi; era teyaguma, newaakubadde yalaba abalala bangi nga basomoka mu maaso ge, okwetantala, newaakubadde bangi ku bo baamugamba okumuwa emikono gyabwe. Era teyayagala kuddayo. Ekibuga eky’Eggulu — yagamba nti yandifudde singa takituuseeko; naye ate yaggwangamu amaanyi ku buli kizibu, era yeesittalanga ku buli kasubi omuntu yenna ke yasuulanga mu kkubo lye. Kale, bwe yamala ebbanga ddene ku Kinnya ky’Okuggwaamu-Essuubi, nga bwe mbabuulidde, ku makya agamu ag’omusana, simanyi bwe kyali, ne yeetantala, n’asomoka; naye bwe yamala okusomoka, yali tasobola kukikkiriza. Ndowooza yalina Ekinnya ky’Okuggwaamu-Essuubi mu birowoozo bye, ekinnya kye yatambulanga nakyo buli wamu, oba si ekyo teyandibadde bw’atyo nga bwe yali. Awo n’atuuka ku mulyango, mumanyi kye ntegeeza, oguli ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo lino, era naawo n’ayimirira ebbanga ddene nga tannaguma kukonkona. Omulyango bwe gwaggulwawo, yaddanga emabega, n’aleka abalala bayite, ng’agamba nti tasaanira. Kubanga newaakubadde yatuuka ku mulyango ng’abamu tebannatuuka, bangi ku bo baayingira mu maaso ge. Awo omusajja ono omwavu yayimiriranga ng’akankana era ng’azinzeemu; nkakasa nti omutima gw’omuntu gwandimusaasidde okumulaba. Era teyayagala kuddayo. Ku nkomerero n’akwata mu ngalo ze ennyondo eyali ewanikiddwa ku mulyango, n’akonkona mpola omulundi gumu oba ebiri; awo omuntu n’amuggulirawo, naye ne yeezingako n’adda emabega nga bwe yakola edda. Eyamuggulirawo n’avaayo n’amugoberera, n’agamba nti, Ggwe akankana, oyagala ki? Awo n’agwa wansi. Eyayogera naye ne yeewuunya okumulaba ng’azirise bw’atyo, n’amugamba nti, Emirembe gibe gy’oli; golokoka, kubanga nkuggulidde oluggi; yingira, kubanga oli wa mukisa. Awo n’agolokoka, n’ayingira ng’akankana; era bwe yayingira, n’akwatibwa ensonyi okulaga amaaso ge. Kale, bwe yamala okusembezebwa eyo okumala akaseera, nga bwe mumanyi empisa y’eyo bw’eri, n’agambibwa okweyongerayo mu kkubo lye, era n’abuulirwa ekkubo ly’alina okukwata. Bw’atyo n’agenda okutuusa lwe yatuuka ku nnyumba yaffe; naye nga bwe yeeyisa ku mulyango, bw’atyo bwe yakola ku luggi lwa mukama wange Omuvvuunuzi. Yagalamira awo mu mpewo ebbanga ddene nga tannaguma kukoowoola; naye teyayagala kuddayo: era ebiro ebyo ekiro kyali kiwanvu era nga kinnyogovu. Weewaawo, yalina ebbaluwa ey’obwetaavu mu kifuba kye eri mukama wange ng’emusaba amusembeze, amuwe okubudaabudibwa mu nnyumba ye, era amuwe omukulembeze omuzira ow’amaanyi, kubanga ye yennyini yali musajja wa mutima gwa nkoko; naye newaakubadde ebyo byonna, yatya okukoowoola ku luggi. Bw’atyo n’atambulatambula eno n’eri awo okumpi, okutuusa, omusajja ono omwavu, lwe yali kumpi okufa enjala; weewaawo, okwennyamira kwe kwali kungi nnyo nga newaakubadde yalaba abalala bangi nga bayingira olw’okukonkona, naye n’atya okwetantala. Ku nkomerero, ndowooza nnatunula mu ddirisa, ne ndaba omusajja ng’atambulatambula ku luggi, ne mfuluma gy’ali, ne mubuuza oba y’ani: naye, omusajja ono omwavu, amaziga gaali gamuyimiridde mu maaso; ne ntegeera kye yali ayagala. Kale ne nnyingira munda, ne nkibuulira ab’omu nnyumba, era ne tukimanyisa Mukama waffe: n’antuma nate okumwegayirira ayingire; naye nkakasa nti nnakola omulimu omuzibu okukikola. Ku nkomerero n’ayingira; era kino nkyogera ku lwa Mukama wange, yamuyisa n’okwagala okw’ekitalo. Waaliwo ebitundu ebirungi bitono ku mmeeza, naye ku byo ne bimuteekebwa ku sowaani ye. Awo n’awaayo ebbaluwa; Mukama wange n’agitunuulira, n’agamba nti kye yali ayagala kinaamuweebwa. Bwe yamala eyo ebbanga ddene, n’alabika ng’afunye ku buvumu, era ng’agumidde katono. Kubanga Mukama wange, mumanye, wa kisa kingi nnyo eky’omutima, naddala eri abo abatya; kyeyava amuyisa mu ngeri esinga okumuzaamu amaanyi. Kale, bwe yamala okulaba ebintu by’ekifo ekyo, era nga yeetegese okutandika olugendo lwe okugenda mu kibuga, Mukama wange, nga bwe yakola eri Omukristaayo edda, n’amuwa eccupa y’ekyokunywa ekizzaamu amaanyi, n’ebintu ebirungi eby’okulya. Bwe tutyo ne tusimbula, nze nga nkulembedde; naye omusajja yali wa bigambo bitono, wabula yassanga ebikkowe mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka. Bwe twatuuka awali abasajja abasatu abaali bawanikiddwa, n’agamba nti yeeraliikirira nti n’enkomerero ye bw’etyo bw’eriba. Kyokka yalabika ng’asanyuse bwe yalaba omusaalaba n’entaana. Eyo, nzikiriza, yayagala okulwawo katono okutunuulira; era oluvannyuma okumala akaseera n’alabika ng’alina essanyu katono. Bwe yatuuka ku Lusozi Oluzibu, ekyo teyakifaako, era teyatya nnyo empologoma: kubanga mumanye nti ebizibu bye tebyali ku bintu nga bino; okutya kwe kwali ku kukkirizibwa kwe ku nkomerero. Nnamuyingiza mu Nnyumba Ennungi, ndowooza, nga tannaba kwagala. Era bwe yayingira, ne mmumanyisa abawala ab’omu kifo ekyo; naye yakwatibwa ensonyi okwetaba ennyo mu bantu. Yayagala nnyo okubeera yekka; naye bulijjo yayagalanga emboozi ennungi, era emirundi mingi yeekwekanga emabega w’olutimbe okugiwulira. Yayagalanga nnyo n’okulaba ebintu eby’edda, n’okubifumiitirizaako mu mutima gwe. Oluvannyuma yaŋŋamba nti yayagalanga okubeera mu nnyumba ezo zombi gye yali yakava, kwe kugamba, ku mulyango ne mu y’Omuvvuunuzi, naye nti teyaguma kuba muvumu okusaba. Era bwe twava mu Nnyumba Ennungi, ne tukka olusozi, ne tuyingira mu Kiwonvu ky’Okwetoowaza, n’akka bulungi nga bwe sirabangako muntu yenna mu bulamu bwange; kubanga teyafaayo bw’aba wa wansi atya, kasita aba wa ssanyu ku nkomerero. Weewaawo, ndowooza waaliwo ekika ky’okukwatagana wakati w’Ekiwonvu ekyo naye; kubanga sirabangako ng’ali bulungi mu lugendo lwe lwonna okusinga bwe yali mu Kiwonvu ekyo. Wano yagalamiranga wansi, n’agwa ku ttaka n’aligwako mu kifuba, n’anywegera n’ebimuli byennyini ebyamera mu kiwonvu kino. Okukungubaga 3:27-29. Kaakano yagolokokanga buli nkya ng’obudde bukya, ng’atambulatambula eno n’eri mu kiwonvu. Naye bwe yatuuka ku mulyango gw’Ekiwonvu ky’Ekisiikirize ky’Okufa, ne ndowooza nti omusajja wange ŋŋenda kumufiirwa: si lwa kuba nti yali ayagala kuddayo; ekyo yakikyawanga bulijjo; naye yali kumpi kufa olw’okutya. Woowe, ebitonde eby’entiisa binkwata! ebitonde eby’entiisa binkwata! bwe yaleekaana; era saasobola kukimuggyamu. Yakuba enduulu n’okukaaba kungi wano, nga singa baali bamuwulidde, kyandibadde kimala okubazzaamu amaanyi okujja okutulumba. Naye kino nnakissaako nnyo omwoyo, nti ekiwonvu kino kyali kisirifu bwe twakiyitamu, nga bwe kitabangako mu biseera eby’emabega wadde ebyaddirira. Ndowooza abalabe abo abaali wano baali bafunye okuziyizibwa okw’enjawulo okuva eri Mukama waffe, n’ekiragiro obutakwata ku kintu okutuusa Omwami Atyatya lw’alimala okukiyitamu. Kyandibadde kiwanvu nnyo okubabuulira byonna; kale tujja kwogera ku bigambo kimu oba bibiri byokka. Bwe yatuuka ku Katale k’Obutaliimu, nnalowooza nti agenda kulwana n’abasajja bonna ab’omu katale. Nnatya nti eyo tujja kukubwa ffembi ku mitwe, olw’obusungu bwe obungi ku busirusiru bwabwe. Ku Ttaka Eddogo yali atunula nnyo. Naye bwe yatuuka ku mugga ogutaaliko lutindo, era eyo yali mu mbeera enzibu. Kaakano, kaakano, bwe yagamba, agenda kubbira emirembe gyonna, aleme kulaba n’essanyu amaaso ago ge yali atambudde mayiro nnyingi okulaba. Era wano nnakissaako omwoyo ekintu eky’ekitalo ennyo: amazzi g’omugga ogwo gaali makendeevu mu kiseera ekyo okusinga bwe nnali ngalabye mu bulamu bwange bwonna; bw’atyo n’asomoka ku nkomerero, ng’amazzi tegamusussa nnyo ku bigere. Bwe yali ayambuka ku mulyango, ne ntandika okumusiibula, n’okumwagaliza okwanirizibwa obulungi eyo waggulu. N’agamba nti, Nja kwanirizibwa, nja kwanirizibwa. Awo ne twawukana, ne sikyamulaba. Omwami Ow’amazima: Kale kirabika yali bulungi ku nkomerero? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Yee, yee, sibangako na kubuusabuusa ku ye. Yali musajja wa mwoyo ogw’omuwendo, wabula bulijjo yali mwennyamivu nnyo, era ekyo kyafuula obulamu bwe omugugu gy’ali yennyini, era ne kimufuula muntu wa kutawaanya abalala. Zabbuli 88. Yali, okusinga bangi, mwegendereza nnyo ku kibi: yatyanga nnyo okukola abalala obubi, nga emirundi mingi yeegaananga n’ekyo ekikkirizibwa, kubanga teyayagala kwesittaza muntu. Abaruumi 14:21; 1 Abakkolinso 8:13. Omwami Ow’amazima: Naye nsonga ki eyandibaddewo omusajja omulungi bw’atyo okubeera mu kizikiza ennaku ze zonna? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Waliwo ebika by’ensonga bibiri. Emu eri nti, Katonda ow’amagezi ayagala bwe kityo: abamu bateekwa okufuuwa omulere, n’abalala okukaaba. Matayo 11:16. Kaakano Omwami Atyatya yali omu ku abo abakuba eddoboozi ery’awansi. Ye ne banne bafuuwa ekkondeere eddene, eddoboozi lyalyo ery’ennaku okusinga amaloboozi g’ebivuga ebirala: newaakubadde, mazima, abamu bagamba nti eddoboozi ery’awansi gwe musingi gw’ennyimba. Era nze ku lwange, sifaayo n’akatono ku kwatula eddiini okutatandikira mu buzito bwa mutima. Omuguwa ogusooka omuyimbi gw’atera okukwatako gwe gw’eddoboozi ery’awansi, bw’aba ayagala okuteekateeka byonna bikwatagane. Katonda naye asooka kukuba muguwa guno, bw’aba ateekateeka omwoyo gukwatagane naye. Kyokka obunafu bw’Omwami Atyatya bwali wano; teyasobola kukuba nnyimba ndala zonna wabula zino okutuusa ng’anaatera okufa. [Nneetantala okwogera bwe ntyo mu ngero olw’okukuza amagezi g’abasomi abato, era kubanga, mu kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa, abaalokolebwa bageraageranyizibwa ku kibinja ky’abayimbi abafuuwa amakondeere gaabwe n’abakuba ennanga zaabwe, ne bayimba ennyimba zaabwe mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka.Okubikkulirwa 5:8; 14:2,3.] Omwami Ow’amazima: Yali musajja munyiikivu nnyo, nga omuntu bw’ayinza okulaba mu ebyo by’otubuulidde ku ye. Ebizibu, empologoma, oba Akatale k’Obutaliimu, teyabitya n’akatono; ekibi, okufa, ne ggeyeena byokka bye byali eby’entiisa gy’ali, kubanga yalina okubuusabuusa ku mugabo gwe mu nsi eyo ey’Eggulu. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Oyogedde bulungi; ebyo bye byali bimutawaanya; era, nga bw’otegedde obulungi, byava mu bunafu bw’ebirowoozo bye ku nsonga eyo, so si mu bunafu bw’omwoyo ku bikwata ku bulamu bw’omutambuze obw’okukola. Nzikiriza nti, ng’olugero bwe lugamba, yandisobodde okuluma ekisiki ky’omuliro, singa kyali mu kkubo lye; naye ebintu ebyamunyigiriza, tewali muntu n’omu yali asobodde okubyesuulako amangu. Christiana: Awo Christiana n’agamba nti, Okubuulira kuno ku Mwami Atyatya kunkoledde birungi; nnalowooza nti tewali muntu afaanana nze. Naye ndaba waliwo okufaanagana wakati w’omusajja ono omulungi nange: wabula twawukana mu bintu bibiri. Ebizibu bye byali bingi nnyo ne bifubutuka ebweru; naye ebyange nabikuumira munda. Era ebibye byamunyigiriza nnyo, ne bimulemesa okukonkona ku nnyumba ezaategekebwa okwaniriza abagenyi; naye ebyange byali bwe bityo nga binkonkonya n’amaanyi okusingawo. Okusaasira: Singa nange nzikirizibwa okwogera ebiri mu mutima gwange, nteekwa okugamba nti ekitundu ku ye kibadde kibeera ne mu nze. Kubanga bulijjo mbadde ntya ennyanja ey’omuliro, n’okufiirwa ekifo mu Lusuku lwa Katonda, okusinga bwe ntya okufiirwa ebintu ebirala. Woowe, bwe nnalowooza, nfune omukisa okuba n’ekifo eky’okubeeramu eyo! ‘Kimala, ne bwe ndyawukana n’ensi yonna okukifuna. Matayo: Awo Matayo n’agamba nti, Okutya kye kimu ku ebyo ebyandowoozesa nti ndi wala okuba n’ebyo munda mu nze ebigenda n’obulokozi. Naye oba nga bwe kyali bwe kityo eri omusajja omulungi bw’atyo nga ye, lwaki tekiyinza naye kugenda bulungi gye ndi? Yakobo: Awatali kutya tewali kisa, bwe yagamba Yakobo. Newaakubadde bulijjo tewabeera kisa awali okutya ggeyeena, naye, mazima, tewali kisa awatali kutya Katonda. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Oyogedde bulungi, Yakobo; okubye akabonero kennyini. Kubanga mu kutya Mukama amagezi mwe gasookera; era, mazima, abo abatalina ntandikwa tebalina makkati wadde enkomerero. Naye wano tujja kumaliriza emboozi yaffe ku Mwami Atyatya, nga tumaze okumusindikira okusiibula kuno. “Kale, Omwami Atyatya, watya Katonda wo, era watya Okukola ekintu kyonna, ng’okyali wano, Ekyandikulyamu olukwe. Era watya ennyanja n’obunnya? Singa n’abalala bwe batyo! Kubanga abo abatalina magezi go, Beezikiriza bokka.” Awo ne ndaba nga bakyeyongerayo n’emboozi yaabwe. Kubanga Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yamala okwogera ku Mwami Atyatya, Omwami Ow’amazima n’atandika okubabuulira ku mulala, era erinnya lye yali Omwami Akola-Ky’ayagala. Yeeyita omutambuze, bwe yagamba Omwami Ow’amazima; naye nkakasa nti teyayingira ku mulyango oguli ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Wali oyogeddeko naye ku nsonga eyo? Omwami Ow’amazima: Yee, emirundi egisoba mu gumu oba ebiri; naye bulijjo yali nga bw’ali, akola ky’ayagala. Teyafaayo ku muntu, wadde ku nsonga, wadde ku kyakulabirako; ebirowoozo bye kye byamukubiriza, ekyo kye yakola, era tewaali kirala kye baasobola kumukozesa. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nkwegayiridde, yali akkiriza ki? kubanga ndowooza oyinza okukimbuulira. Omwami Ow’amazima: Yali akkiriza nti omuntu ayinza okugoberera ebibi by’abatambuze nga bw’agoberera empisa zaabwe ennungi; era nti bw’akola byombi, ddala alirokolebwa. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Ki? Singa yagamba nti kisoboka n’abasinga obulungi okugwa mu bibi, ng’era bwe beetaba mu mpisa ennungi ez’abatambuze, teyandinenyezeddwa nnyo; kubanga mazima tetwawulibwa ku kibi kyonna ddala, wabula ku bukwakkulizo nti tutunula era tufuba. Naye kino, nkitegedde, si kye kigambo; naye bwe mba nkutegedde bulungi, ky’otegeeza kiri nti yali alowooza nti kikkirizibwa okubeera bw’atyo. Omwami Ow’amazima: Yee, yee, kye ntegeeza ekyo, era bw’atyo bwe yakkiriza era bwe yakola. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Naye yalina misingi ki ku bigambo bye ebyo? Omwami Ow’amazima: Yagamba nti Ebyawandiikibwa bye bimukkiriza. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Nkwegayiridde, Omwami Ow’amazima, tuleetere ebintu ebitonotono. Omwami Ow’amazima: Nja kukikola. Yagamba nti okwebaka ne bakazi b’abasajja abalala kyakolebwa Dawudi, omwagalwa wa Katonda; n’olwekyo naye yali ayinza okukikola. Yagamba nti okuwasa abakazi abasoba mu omu kyali kintu Sulemaani kye yakola, n’olwekyo naye yali ayinza okukikola. Yagamba nti Saala n’abazaalisa abatya Katonda ab’e Misiri baalimba, era ne Lakabu eyalokolebwa bw’atyo bwe yakola, n’olwekyo naye yali ayinza okukikola. Yagamba nti abayigirizwa baagenda ku kiragiro kya Mukama waabwe ne batwala endogoyi ya nnannyini yo, n’olwekyo naye yali ayinza okukola bw’atyo. Yagamba nti Yakobo yafuna obusika bwa kitaawe mu ngeri ey’obukuusa n’obulimba, n’olwekyo naye yali ayinza okukola bw’atyo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Kino kibi nnyo ddala ddala! Era okakasa nti yalina endowooza eyo? Omwami Ow’amazima: Nnamuwulira ng’akiwolereza, ng’aleeta Ebyawandiikibwa ku lwakyo, ng’aleeta ensonga ku lwakyo, n’ebirala. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Endowooza eyo tesaanidde kukkirizibwa n’akatono mu nsi! Omwami Ow’amazima: Ontegeere bulungi: teyagamba nti buli muntu ayinza okukola bw’atyo; wabula nti abo abalina empisa ennungi ez’abo abaakola ebintu ng’ebyo, nabo bayinza okukola bwe batyo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Naye kiki ekisinga obulimba okusinga okusalawo okwo? Kubanga kuba kugamba nti, olw’okuba abantu abalungi edda baayonoona olw’obunafu, kyeyava naye yaweebwa olukusa okwonoona mu bugenderevu n’amalala; oba nti, olw’okuba omwana, ng’asindikiddwa omuyaga, oba ng’eyeesittadde ku jjinja, yagwa n’ayonoonekera mu bitosi, kyeyava naye ayinza okugalamira mu bitosi mu bugenderevu n’ayiringitiramu ng’embizzi. Ani yandirowoozezza nti omuntu ayinza okuzibibwa amaaso bw’atyo olw’amaanyi g’okwegomba okubi? Naye ekyawandiikibwa kiteekwa okuba eky’amazima, kubanga kigamba nti: “Beesittala kubanga bajeemera ekigambo kya Katonda, nga bwe ky’ateekebwateekebwa.” 1 Peetero, 2:8. Okulowooza kwe nti abo abeewaayo eri ebibi by’abantu abatya Katonda bayinza okuba n’empisa zaabwe ennungi, nakwo kubuzaabuzibwa okw’amaanyi ng’okulala. Okulya ekibi ky’abantu ba Katonda, Koseya 4:8, ng’embwa bw’ekomba obucaafu, si kabonero nti omuntu alina empisa zaabwe ennungi. Era sisobola kukkiriza nti omuntu alina endowooza eno ayinza okuba n’okukkiriza oba okwagala mu ye kaakano. Naye mmanyi nti wamuwakanya nnyo; nkwegayiridde, kiki ky’ayinza okwewozaako? Omwami Ow’amazima: Agamba nti, okukola bw’atyo ng’akikkiriza mu ndowooza ye, kiraga obwesimbu bungi nnyo okusinga okukikola ng’ate mu ndowooza okiwakanya. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Okwanukula okwo kubi nnyo. Kubanga newaakubadde okuta enkoba z’okwegomba okubi ng’endowooza zaffe ziwakanya ebintu ng’ebyo kibi; naye okwonoona n’owolereza olukusa olw’okukikola, kisinga obubi: ekimu kyesittaza abakiraba nga tekigenderere, naye ekirala kibatwala mu mutego. Omwami Ow’amazima: Waliwo bangi abalina endowooza y’omusajja ono, naye nga tebalina kamwa ke; era ekyo kye kifuula olugendo lw’omutambuze okunyoomebwa bwe kutyo. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Oyogedde mazima, era kya nnaku; naye oyo atya Kabaka w’Olusuku lwa Katonda aliwona mu byonna ebyo. Christiana: Mu nsi mulimu endowooza ez’ekitalo. Mmanyi omuntu eyagamba nti obudde bw’okwenenya bumala bwe tunaaba tunaatera okufa. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Abantu ng’abo si ba magezi mangi; omusajja oyo, singa yaweebwa wiiki emu okudduka mayiro abiri mu bulamu bwe, teyandyagadde kwongezaayo lugendo lwe okutuusa ku ssaawa esembayo eya wiiki eyo. Omwami Ow’amazima: Oyogedde bulungi; naye abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita abatambuze, ddala bakola bwe batyo. Nga bw’olaba, ndi musajja mukadde, era mmaze ennaku nnyingi nga ntambula mu kkubo lino; era ndabye ebintu bingi. Ndabye abamu abaatandika ng’abagenda okusindika ensi yonna mu maaso gaabwe, naye mu nnaku ntono ne bafa nga bali abaafiira mu ddungu, ne batalaba n’akatono nsi ensuubize. Ndabye abamu abaatalaga kalungi konna we baatandikira okuba abatambuze, era omuntu yandirowoozezza nti tebayinza kuwangaala wadde olunaku lumu, naye ne bafuuka abatambuze abalungi ennyo. Ndabye abamu abaddukira mu maaso mangu, naye oluvannyuma lw’akaseera katono ne badduka mangu bwe batyo okudda emabega. Ndabye abamu abaasooka okwogera obulungi ennyo ku bulamu bw’omutambuze, naye oluvannyuma ne bakwogerako obubi kyenkanyi. Mpulidde abamu, bwe baasooka okutandika olugendo okugenda mu Lusuku lwa Katonda, nga bagamba n’obukakafu nti ekifo ng’ekyo kiriwo, kyokka bwe baali banaatera okutuukayo, ne bakomawo ne bagamba nti tekiriiwo. Mpulidde abamu nga beewaana kye bandikoze singa bawakanyizibwa, naye ne ku nduulu ey’obulimba ne badduka, ne bava ku kukkiriza, ne ku kkubo ly’omutambuze, ne ku byonna. Awo bwe baali batambula mu kkubo bwe batyo, omuntu omu n’ajja ng’adduka okubasisinkana, n’agamba nti, Bassebo, nammwe abanafu, obanga mwagala obulamu, mwerwaneko, kubanga abanyazi bali mu maaso gammwe. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Abo be basatu abaalumba Akkiriza-Kitono edda. Kale, bwe yagamba, tubeetegekedde: awo ne beeyongera mu kkubo lyabwe. Buli we baakyukanga baali balowooza nti banaasisinkana abazigu abo; naye oba baawulira nga Omwami Omutima-Omuzira ali nabo, oba baalina omuyiggo omulala, tebaatuuka ku batambuze. Awo Christiana ne yeegomba okufuna ennyumba y’abagenyi mwe yandiwummulidde n’abaana be, kubanga baali bakooye. Awo Omwami Ow’amazima n’agamba nti, Waliwo emu katono mu maaso gaffe, omubeera omuyigirizwa ow’ekitiibwa ennyo, ayitibwa Gaayo. Abaruumi 16:23. Awo bonna ne basalawo okukyamira eyo; na ddala olw’okuba omukadde oyo yamwogerako bulungi nnyo. Bwe baatuuka ku mulyango ne bayingira nga tebakonkonye, kubanga abantu tebakonkona ku luggi lw’ennyumba y’abagenyi. Awo ne bayita nnannyini nnyumba, n’ajja gye bali. Ne bamubuuza obanga bayinza okusula omwo ekiro ekyo. Gaayo: Weewaawo, bassebo, obanga muli bantu ba mazima; kubanga ennyumba yange ya batambuze bokka. Awo Christiana, Okusaasira, n’abalenzi ne beeyongera okusanyuka, kubanga nnannyini nnyumba y’abagenyi yali ayagala nnyo abatambuze. Ne basaba ebisenge, n’abalaga ekimu ekya Christiana n’abaana be n’Okusaasira, n’ekirala eky’Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’omukadde. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Gaayo omulungi, olina ki eky’ekyeggulo? kubanga abatambuze bano batambudde olugendo luwanvu leero, era bakooye. Gaayo: Obudde buyise, Gaayo bwe yagamba, kale tetuyinza bulungi kufuluma kunoonya mmere; naye ku eyo gye tulina mwanirizibwa, obanga ekyo kinaabamala. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Tujja kumatira ne ky’olina mu nnyumba; kubanga nga bwe nkugezezza, tobulwa kintu kyetaagisa. Awo n’aserengeta n’ayogera n’omufumbi, eyali ayitibwa Lega-Ekirungi, ateekereteeke ekyeggulo ky’abatambuze abangi bwe batyo. Ekyo bwe kyaggwa, n’alinnya nate ng’agamba nti, Mujje, mikwano gyange emirungi, mwaniriziddwa gye ndi, era nsanyuse okuba n’ennyumba mwe mbaanirizza; era ng’ekyeggulo kikyategekebwa, bwe kiba kibasanyusa, katusanyusagane n’emboozi ennungi: bonna ne bagamba nti, Tukkirizza. Gaayo: Awo Gaayo n’agamba nti, Omukyala ono omukadde ye mukazi w’ani? era omuwala ono omuto ye muwala w’ani? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Omukazi ono ye mukazi w’omusajja ayitibwa Omukristaayo, omutambuze ow’edda; era bano be baana be abana. Omuwala ono ye omu ku mikwano gye, gwe yasendasenda okujja naye mu lugendo. Abalenzi bonna bafaanana kitaabwe, era beegomba okutambulira mu bigere bye; weewaawo, bwe balaba ekifo kyonna omutambuze oyo ow’edda we yagalamira, oba akabonero konna ak’ekigere kye, kibaleetera essanyu mu mitima, era beegomba okugalamira oba okulinnya mu kifo kye kimu. Gaayo: Awo Gaayo n’agamba nti, Ono ye mukazi w’Omukristaayo, era bano be baana b’Omukristaayo? Nnamanya kitaawe wa bba wo, weewaawo, ne jjajja we. Bangi ab’olulyo luno baali balungi; bajjajjaabwe baasooka kubeera mu Antiyokiya. Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:26. Bajjajja b’Omukristaayo (nsuubira wawulira bba wo ng’abaogerako) baali bantu ba kitiibwa nnyo. Okusinga abalala bonna be mmanyi, beeraga okuba abantu ab’empisa ennungi n’obuvumu bungi ku lwa Mukama w’abatambuze, n’amakubo ge, n’abo abaamwagala. Mpulidde ku b’ekika kya bba wo bangi abaagumira buli kugezesebwa ku lw’amazima. Suteefano, omu ku baasooka mu nnyumba bba wo mwe yava, yakubwa amayinja ku mutwe. Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:59, 60. Yakobo, omulala ow’ezzadde lino, yattibwa n’obwogi bw’ekitala. Ebikolwa by’Abatume 12:2. Nga sinnayogera ku Pawulo ne Peetero, abantu ab’edda ab’ennyumba bba wo mwe yava, waaliwo Ignatiyo, eyasuulibwa empologoma; Lomano, eyasalibwako ennyama ye ku magumba ebitundutundu; ne Polikaapu, eyeeraga obusajja mu muliro. Waaliwo oyo eyawanikibwa mu kibbo ku musana ennumba zimulye; n’oyo gwe baateeka mu nsawo, ne bamusuula mu nnyanja okufiira omwo. Tekiyinzika ddala kubala bonna ab’ennyumba eyo abaabonyaabonyezebwa ne battibwa olw’okwagala obulamu bw’omutambuze. Era sirema kusanyuka okulaba nga bba wo alese abalenzi abana nga bano. Nsuubira nti balikuuma erinnya lya kitaabwe, ne batambulira mu bigere bya kitaabwe, era ne batuuka ku nkomerero ya kitaabwe. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Ddala, ssebo, balenzi abalabika obulungi: balabika nga balonda n’omutima gwabwe gwonna amakubo ga kitaabwe. Gaayo: Ekyo kye nnyogedde. Kale ennyumba y’Omukristaayo esuubirwa okweyongera okubuna ku maaso g’ettaka, n’okuba ennyingi ku nsi yonna; Christiana k’anoonyeze batabani be abawala, be banaayogereza okuwasa, n’ebirala, erinnya lya kitaabwe n’ennyumba ya bajjajjaabwe bireme okwerabirwa mu nsi emirembe gyonna. Omwami Ow’amazima: ‘Kiba kya nnaku ennyumba ye okugwa n’esaanawo.’ Gaayo: Okugwa tegiyinza kugwa, naye okukendeera eyinza okukendeera; naye Christiana k’akkirize okubuulirira kwange, era ekyo kye kkubo ery’okuginyweza. Era, Christiana, nnannyini nnyumba y’abagenyi bwe yagamba, nsanyuse okukulaba ggwe ne mukwano gwo Okusaasira wano wamu, babiri abalungi. Era bwe mba nga nnyinza okukuwa amagezi, sembeza Okusaasira akubeere wa kumpi: bw’anaakkiriza, aweebwe Matayo omwana wo omubereberye. Eryo lye kkubo ery’okukuuma ezzadde ku nsi. Awo okwogerezeganya kuno ne kumalirizibwa, era ekiseera bwe kyayitawo ne bafumbiriganwa: naye ebyo tulibyogerako oluvannyuma. Gaayo ne yeeyongera n’agamba nti, Kaakano nja kwogera ku lw’abakazi, okubaggyako ekivume kyabwe. Kubanga ng’okufa n’ekikolimo bwe byayingira mu nsi ku bw’omukazi, Olubereberye 3, bwe bityo n’obulamu n’okuwonyezebwa bwe byajja: Katonda n’atuma Omwana we, eyazaalibwa omukazi. Abaggalatiya 4:4. Weewaawo, okulaga nga abo abajja oluvannyuma bwe baakyawa ennyo ekikolwa kya nnyaabwe, abakazi mu Ndagaano Enkadde beegombanga abaana, oba olyawo omukazi omu ku bo yandibadde nnyina w’Omulokozi w’ensi. Nja kuddamu okugamba nti Omulokozi bwe yajja, abakazi be baasooka okumusanyukira, okusinga omusajja yenna oba malayika. Lukka 1:42-46. Sisomangako nti omusajja yenna yawa Kristo wadde akasente akamu; naye abakazi baamugoberera ne bamuweereza okuva ku byabwe. Lukka 8:2,3. ‘Yali mukazi eyanaaza ebigere bye n’amaziga’, Lukka 7:37-50, era mukazi eyasiiga omubiri gwe amafuta olw’okuziikibwa. Yokaana 11:2; 12:3. Baali bakazi abaakaaba amaziga bwe yali ng’agenda ku musaalaba, Lukka 23:27, era bakazi abaamugoberera okuva ku musaalaba, Matayo 27:55,56; Lukka 23:55, ne batuula okwolekera entaana ye bwe yaziikibwa. Matayo 27:61. Baali bakazi abaasooka okubeera naye ku makya ag’okuzuukira kwe, Lukka 24:1, era bakazi abaasooka okutegeeza abayigirizwa be nti azuukidde mu bafu. Lukka 24:22,23. Noolwekyo abakazi baweereddwa ekisa kingi, era mu bintu bino beeraga nti bagabana naffe ekisa eky’obulamu. Awo omufumbi n’atumira okubategeeza nti ekyeggulo kinaatera okuggwa, n’atuma omuntu okwaliira ekitambaala ku mmeeza, n’okuteekako essowaani, n’okutegeka omunnyo n’omugaati. Awo Matayo n’agamba nti, Okulaba ekitambaala kino, n’ekintu kino ekikulembera ekyeggulo, kinzaalamu enjala esinga gye nnabadde nayo. Gaayo: Bw’atyo buli kuyigiriza okukuweerezebwa mu bulamu buno kukuzaalemu okwegomba okusingawo okutuula ku kyeggulo kya Kabaka omukulu mu bwakabaka bwe; kubanga okubuulira kwonna, n’ebitabo, n’emikolo gyonna egy’eno, biri ng’okwaliira essowaani n’okuteeka omunnyo ku mmeeza, bw’obigeraageranya n’embaga Mukama waffe gy’alitukolera bwe tulituuka mu nnyumba ye. Awo ekyeggulo ne kireetebwa. Ekisooka, ekisambi ekisitulibwa n’ekifuba ekiwuubibwawuubibwa ne biteekebwa ku mmeeza mu maaso gaabwe; okulaga nti bateekwa okutandika ekijjulo kyabwe n’okusaba n’okutendereza Katonda. Ekisambi ekisitulibwa, Dawudi kye yasitulanga n’omutima gwe eri Katonda; n’ekifuba ekiwuubibwawuubibwa, omutima gwe we gwali, kwe yeesigamanga ku nnanga ye bwe yagikubanga. Ebyabaleevi 7: 32-34; 10:14,15; Zabbuli 25:1; Abaebbulaniya 13:15. Ebyokulya ebyo ebibiri byali bibisi era birungi nnyo, era bonna ne babiryako nnyo. Ekyaddako kye baaleeta yali ccupa ya wayini, omumyufu ng’omusaayi. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 32:14; Balam 9:13; Yokaana 15:5. Awo Gaayo n’abagamba nti, Munywe nga temwekomako; guno gwe mubisi gw’omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ogusanyusa omutima gwa Katonda n’ogw’abantu. Awo ne banywa ne basanyuka. Ekyaddako yali ssowaani y’amata agalimu obukunkumuka bw’omugaati bungi; Gaayo n’agamba nti, Abalenzi be baganywa, balyoke bakule. 1 Peetero 2:1,2. Awo ne baleeta, mu nnyiriri, ssowaani ya muzigo n’omubisi gw’enjuki. Gaayo n’agamba nti, Mulye ku kino nga temwekomako, kubanga kirungi okusanyusa n’okunyweza okusalawo kwammwe n’okutegeera kwammwe. Kino kye kyali ekyokulya kya Mukama waffe bwe yali omwana: “Bw’alituuka okwawula ekirungi n’ekibi aliba alya muzigo na mubisi gwa njuki.” Isaaya 7:15. Awo ne babaleetera ssowaani y’ebibala bya apo, era byali biwoomu nnyo. Awo Matayo n’agamba nti, Tuyinza okulya apo, kubanga ebibala ng’ebyo bye byakozesebwa omusota okulimbalimba nnyaffe eyasooka? Awo Gaayo n’agamba nti, “Ebibala bya apo bye byatulimbalimba, Naye ekibi, so si bibala, kye kyayonoona emmeeme zaffe: Ebibala ebyagaanibwa, bwe biriibwa, byonoona omusaayi; Okubirya nga tulagiddwa, kitugasa: Kale nywa ku nsuwa ze, ggwe kkanisa, ejjiba lye, Era lya ku bibala bye, ggwe okwagala kwe kuzirisizza.” Awo Matayo n’agamba nti, Nnabuusabuusizza kubanga emabegako nnalwala olw’okulya ebibala. Gaayo: Ebibala ebyagaanibwa bijja kubalwaza; naye si ebyo Mukama waffe by’akkirizza. Bwe baali nga boogera bwe batyo, ne baleeterwa ssowaani endala, era yali ssowaani y’ebinyeebwa. Oluyimba 6:11. Awo abamu ku mmeeza ne bagamba nti, Ebinyeebwa byonoona amannyo amagonvu, naddala amannyo g’abaana: Gaayo bwe yawulira ekyo, n’agamba nti, “Ebyawandiikibwa ebizibu bye binyeebwa, (sijja kubiyita balimba,) Ebisusunku byabyo bikuuma ensigo eri abalya: Bwasa ebisusunku, onoofuna ekyokulya; Bireeteddwa wano mmwe okubyasa n’okubirya.” Awo ne basanyuka nnyo, ne batuula ku mmeeza okumala ebbanga ddene, nga boogera ku bintu bingi. Awo omukadde n’agamba nti, Nnannyini nnyumba omulungi, nga tukyaasa ebinyeebwa byo, bw’oba nga kikusanyusa, tunnyonnyole ekikokko kino: “Waaliwo omusajja, abamu ne bwe baamubala ng’omulalu, Gye yakoma okusuula ebibye, gye yakoma okuba n’ebingi.” Awo bonna ne bassaayo omwoyo, nga beewuunya Gaayo omulungi ky’anaayogera; n’atuula akasirise akaseera, n’alyoka addamu bw’ati: “Oyo awa abaavu ebintu bye, Alifuna ebyenkana nabyo, n’emirundi kkumi okusingawo.” Awo Yusufu n’agamba nti, Ddala, ssebo, saalowooza nti oyinza okukivumbula. Ayi, Gaayo bwe yagamba, ntendekeddwa mu kkubo lino okumala ebbanga ddene: tewali kiyigiriza ng’obumanyirivu. Nnayiga ku Mukama wange okuba ow’ekisa, era nkizudde mu bumanyirivu nti nkiganyuddwamu. Omuntu agaba obuteerekereza, yeeyongera bweyongezi kugaggawala; naye akwatirira kye yandigabye, yeeyongera kwavuwala. Omuntu omu ayinza okwefuula omugagga ate nga taliiko ky’alina, ate omulala ne yeefuula okuba omwavu so nga mugagga nnyo. Engero 11:24; 13:7. Awo Samwiri n’agambira nnyina Christiana mu kaama nti, Maama, eno nnyumba ya musajja mulungi nnyo: katubeere wano ebbanga ddene, era muganda wange Matayo afumbiriganwe wano n’Okusaasira, nga tetunnaba kweyongerayo. Gaayo, nnannyini nnyumba, bwe yawulira ekyo, n’agamba nti, N’omutima gwange gwonna, mwana wange. Awo ne bamalayo omwezi n’okusingawo, Okusaasira n’aweebwa Matayo okuba mukazi we. Bwe baali bakyabeera eyo, Okusaasira, nga bwe yali empisa ye, yatungiranga abaavu amakooti n’engoye, era ekyo kyaleetera abatambuze erinnya eddungi ennyo. Naye tuddeyo ku mboozi yaffe: Ekyeggulo bwe kyaggwa, abalenzi ne basaba ekitanda, kubanga baali bakooye olw’okutambula: Gaayo n’ayita omuntu abalage ekisenge kyabwe; naye Okusaasira n’agamba nti, Nze nnaabagalamiza. N’abagalamiza, ne beebaka bulungi: naye abalala ne batuula ekiro kyonna nga tebeebase; kubanga Gaayo nabo baali bakwatagana nnyo nga tebamanyi ngeri gye banaayawukanamu. Bwe baamala okwogera ennyo ku Mukama waabwe, ku bo bennyini, ne ku lugendo lwabwe, omukadde Omwami Ow’amazima, oyo eyakokkolera Gaayo ekikokko, n’atandika okusumagira. Awo Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Ki, ssebo, otandise okusumagira; kale, weekanguke, kaakano kino ekikokko kikyo. Awo Omwami Ow’amazima n’agamba nti, Katukiwulire. Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’addamu nti, “Oyo ayagala okutta, asooka kuwangulwa: Ayagala okubeera omulamu ebweru, asooka kufiira waka.” Ha, Omwami Ow’amazima bwe yagamba, kino kizibu; kizibu okunnyonnyola, era kisinga obuzibu okukikola. Naye jjangu, nnannyini nnyumba, bwe yagamba, bw’oba nga kikusanyusa, ndekera ggwe omugabo gwange: kinnyonnyole, nange nnaawuliriza by’onoogamba. Nedda, Gaayo bwe yagamba, kyaweebwa ggwe, era kisuubirwa nti ggwe onookyanukula. Awo omukadde n’agamba nti, “Asooka kuwangulwa ekisa, Oyo ayagala okutta ekibi; Oyo ayagala okunkakasa nti mulamu, Ateekwa okwefiira yekka.” Kituufu, Gaayo bwe yagamba; okuyigiriza okulungi n’obumanyirivu bikiyigiriza. Kubanga, okusooka, okutuusa ekisa lwe kyeraga ne kiwangula emmeeme n’ekitiibwa kyakyo, emmeeme tebeera na mutima n’akatono okuwakanya ekibi. Ate era, obanga ekibi miguwa gya Setaani, emmeeme mwe yasibibwa, eyinza etya okulwanagana nakyo nga tennasumululwa ku bunafu obwo? Eky’okubiri, era tewali muntu amanyi amagezi oba ekisa ayinza kukkiriza nti omuntu oyo ayinza okuba ekijjukizo ekiramu eky’ekisa, ng’ate muddu w’obwonoonefu bwe. Era kaakano kinzijjukidde, nja kubabuulira olugero olusaanira okuwulirwa. Waaliwo abasajja babiri abaatandika olugendo; omu yatandika nga muto, omulala nga mukadde. Omuvubuka yalina okulwanagana n’obwonoonefu obw’amaanyi; obw’omukadde bwali bunafu olw’okuggwaamu amaanyi g’omubiri. Omuvubuka yatambula n’ebigere bye bulungi ng’omukadde, era mu buli ngeri yali mwangu nga ye. Kati ani ku bo, oba ani, ebirabo by’ekisa bye byayakaayakana okusinga, ng’ate bombi baali balabika nga bafaanagana? Omwami Ow’amazima: By’omuvubuka, tewali kubuusabuusa. Kubanga ekyo ekiwakanya okuziyizibwa okusinga obunene, kye kisinga okulaga nti kye kisinga amaanyi; naddala bwe kitambula kyenkanyi n’ekyo ekitasanga wadde ekitundu ky’okuziyizibwa okwo, ng’obukadde bwe butakisanga. Ate era, ndabye nti abakadde beesiima olw’ensobi eno; kwe kugamba, nga balowooza nti okuggwaamu amaanyi g’omubiri kwe kuwangula obwonoonefu olw’ekisa, bwe batyo ne beerimbalimba. Ddala abakadde abalina ekisa be basinga okusobola okuwa abavubuka amagezi, kubanga be basinze okulaba obwereere bw’ebintu: naye, omukadde n’omuvubuka bwe batandikira wamu, omuvubuka y’asinga okufuna omukisa okulabisa obulungi omulimu gw’ekisa mu ye, newaakubadde obwonoonefu bw’omukadde mu butonde bwe businga obunafu. Bwe batyo ne batuula nga boogera okutuusa obudde lwe bwakya. Awo ab’omu nnyumba bwe baagolokoka, Christiana n’alagira mutabani we Yakobo asome essuula; n’asoma essuula 53 eya Isaaya. Bwe yamala, Omwami Ow’amazima n’abuuza lwaki kyagambibwa nti Omulokozi yali wa kuva “mu ttaka ekkalu;” era nti “teyalina kitiibwa wadde obulungi.” Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’agamba nti, Ku kibuuzo ekisooka nziramu nti, kubanga ekkanisa y’Abayudaaya, Kristo mwe yava, mu kiseera ekyo yali eweddemu kumpi obulamu bwonna n’omwoyo gw’eddiini. Ku kyokubiri ngamba nti, ebigambo ebyo byogerwa mu kamwa k’abatakkiriza, abo, olw’okuba tebalina liiso lisobola kulaba mu mutima gw’Omulangira waffe, kyebava bamusalira omusango nga basinziira ku bunaku bw’endabika ye ey’ebweru; nga bali abo abatamanyi nti amayinja ag’omuwendo omungi gabikkiddwako ekikuta ekitali kirungi, bwe bazuula erimu, olw’obutamanya kye bazudde, ne balisuula nate, ng’abantu bwe basuula ejjinja eryabulijjo. Kale, Gaayo bwe yagamba, kaakano nga muli wano, era nga bwe mmanyi nti Omwami Omutima-Omuzira mukugu mu by’okulwanyisa bye, bwe kinaabasanyusa, bwe tunaamala okuwummula, tujja kutambulako mu nnimiro, tulabe obanga tuyinza okukola ekirungi. Mayiro nga emu okuva wano waliwo omuwagguufu ayitibwa Atta-Abalungi, atawaanya nnyo oluguudo lwa Kabaka mu bitundu bino; era mmanyi awo w’abeera. Ye mukulu w’ababbi bangi: ‘kyandibadde kirungi’ singa tumugoba mu bitundu bino. Awo ne bakkiriza ne bagenda: Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’ekitala kye, n’enkoofiira ey’ekyuma, n’engabo; n’abalala n’amafumu n’emiggo. Bwe baatuuka mu kifo we yali, ne bamusanga ng’akutte omusajja ayitibwa Omwoyo-Omunafu mu ngalo ze, abaddu be gwe baali bamuleetedde, nga bamukwatidde mu kkubo. Omuwagguufu yali amunyaga, ng’agenderera oluvannyuma okumukomba amagumba; kubanga yali wa kika ky’abalya ennyama y’abantu. Kale, olwalaba Omwami Omutima-Omuzira ne mikwano gye ku mulyango gw’empuku ye, nga balina eby’okulwanyisa byabwe, n’ababuuza kye baagala. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Twagala ggwe; kubanga tuzze okuwoolera eggwanga ku lw’abatambuze bangi be wattira, bwe wabawalula okubaggya ku luguudo lwa Kabaka: kale fuluma mu mpuku yo. Awo ne yeesiba eby’okulwanyisa n’afuluma, ne beesogga olutalo, ne balwana okusukka essaawa emu, ne balyoka bayimirira okussa omukka. Atta-Abalungi: Awo omuwagguufu n’agamba nti, Lwaki muli wano ku ttaka lyange? Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Okuwoolera eggwanga ku lw’omusaayi gw’abatambuze, nga bwe nnakugambye edda. Awo ne beeyongera okulwana nate, omuwagguufu n’azzaayo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira emabega; naye n’addamu n’ajja, era mu bukulu bw’omwoyo gwe n’akuba n’amaanyi mangi omutwe gw’omuwagguufu n’embiriizi ze, n’amuleetera okusuula ekyokulwanyisa kye. Awo n’amukuba, n’amutta, n’amusala omutwe, n’agutwala ku nnyumba y’abagenyi. Era n’atwala omutambuze Omwoyo-Omunafu, n’amuleeta naye mu kifo we yali asula. Bwe baatuuka eka, ne balaga ab’omu nnyumba omutwe gwe, ne baguwanika, nga bwe baakola ku balala edda, okutiisa abo abanaagezaako okukola nga ye mu biseera ebijja. Awo ne babuuza Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu engeri gye yagwa mu mikono gye. Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Awo omusajja omwavu n’agamba nti, Ndi musajja mulwadde, nga bwe mulaba: era olw’okuba okufa kwakonkonanga ku luggi lwange buli lunaku, nnalowooza nti siriba bulungi n’akatono nga ndi waka; kyenava nneewaayo eri obulamu bw’omutambuze, era ntambudde okutuuka wano nga nva mu kibuga ky’Obutakakasa, nze ne kitange gye twazaalibwa. Sirina maanyi n’akatono mu mubiri, wadde mu birowoozo, naye, singa nnali nsobola, newaakubadde nga nnyinza kwewalula bwewaluzi, nandyagadde okumala obulamu bwange mu kkubo ly’omutambuze. Bwe nnatuuka ku mulyango oguli ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo, Mukama w’ekifo ekyo yannyaniriza bwereere; teyawakanya ndabika yange ey’obunafu, wadde omwoyo gwange omunafu; naye n’ampa ebintu ebyali byetaagisa mu lugendo lwange, n’aŋŋamba nsuubirenga okutuusa ku nkomerero. Bwe nnatuuka mu nnyumba y’Omuvvuunuzi, nnafunayo ekisa kingi: era olw’okuba Olusozi Oluzibu lwalabika nga luzibu nnyo gye ndi, nnasitulibwa omu ku baddu be okululinnya. Ddala, nfunye obuyambi bungi okuva eri abatambuze, newaakubadde nga tewali n’omu yayagala kutambula mpola nga nze bwe mpalirizibwa okutambula: naye buli lwe baatuukanga, baŋŋambanga ngume omwoyo, era ne bagamba nti Mukama waabwe ayagala abalina omwoyo omunafu bagumizibwenga, 1 Basessaloniika 5:14; ne beeyongerayo n’obwangu bwabwe. Bwe nnatuuka ku Kakubo k’Okulumba, omuwagguufu ono n’ansisinkana, n’aŋŋamba neetegekere olutalo. Naye, zisanze, nze omunafu, nnali nneetaaga kya kunywa ekizzaamu amaanyi; awo n’ajja n’ankwata. Nnalowooza nti tagenda kunzita. Era bwe yamala okunnyingiza mu mpuku ye, olw’okuba saagenda naye ku bwange, nnakkiriza nti ndivaamu nga ndi mulamu; kubanga mpulidde nti tewali mutambuze n’omu akwatibwa mu buwambe n’emikono egy’ekikambwe, bw’akuuma omutima gwe nga mulamba eri Mukama we, ateekwa, okusinziira ku nteekateeka ya Katonda, okufiira mu mukono gw’omulabe. Nnasuubira okunyagibwa, era ddala nnyagiddwa; naye nga bwe mulaba, ndokose n’obulamu, ekyo kye nneebaliza Kabaka wange ng’ensibuko yaakyo, nammwe ng’abaakozesebwa. Nsuubira n’ebirumbe ebirala; naye kino kye mmaliridde, kwe kugamba, okudduka bwe nsobola, okutambula bwe siyinza kudduka, n’okwewalula bwe siyinza kutambula. Ku nsonga enkulu, nneebaza oyo eyanjagala, ndi munywevu; ekkubo lyange liri mu maaso gange, omwoyo gwange guli emitala w’omugga ogutaaliko lutindo, newaakubadde nga, bwe mulaba, ndi wa mwoyo munafu. Omwami Ow’amazima: Awo Omwami Ow’amazima omukadde n’agamba nti, Edda tewamanyanga omutambuze omu ayitibwa Omwami Atyatya? Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Okumumanya! Yee, yava mu Kibuga ky’Obusirusiru, ekiri amadaala ana ebukiikakkono w’Ekibuga eky’Okuzikirira, era amadaala ge gamu okuva we nnazaalibwa; naye twamanyagana nnyo, kubanga ddala yali kitange omuto, muganda wa kitange. Ye nange twali ba mbala emu: yali mumpi katono okusinga nze, naye twafaanagana nnyo mu ndabika. Omwami Ow’amazima: Ndaba nga wamumanya, era nzikiriza nti mwali ba luganda; kubanga olina langi ye enjeru, otunula ng’ono, era n’enjogera yammwe efaanagana nnyo. Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Abasinga obungi abaatumanya ffembi bwe batyo bwe baagamba: era n’ekirala, bye nnalaba mu ye, okusinga nnabisanga ne mu nze. Gaayo: Jangu, ssebo, Gaayo omulungi bwe yagamba, guma omwoyo; nkwanirizza gye ndi ne mu nnyumba yange. Kyonna ky’oyagala, kisabe nga teweekomya; era kyonna ky’oyagala abaddu bange bakukolere, bajja kukikola n’omutima omwangu. Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’agamba nti, Kino kisa kye nnali sisuubira, era kiri ng’enjuba eyakaayakana okuva mu kire ekiddugavu ennyo. Omuwagguufu Atta-Abalungi yali agenderera kunkolera kisa kino bwe yanziyiza n’amalirira obutandeka kweyongerayo? Yali agenderera nti bw’amala okunyaga ensawo zange, ŋŋende ewa Gaayo omusembeza wange? Naye bwe kityo bwe kiri. Awo, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu ne Gaayo bwe baali nga boogera bwe batyo, ne wajja omuntu ng’adduka, n’akoona ku luggi, n’agamba nti ewala nga mayiro emu n’ekitundu waliwo omutambuze omu, Omwami Atali-Mutuufu, eyakubiddwa okubwatuka kw’eggulu n’afiira awo w’abadde. Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Woowe! Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu bwe yagamba, attiddwa? Yansanga ennaku ntono nga sinnatuuka wano, n’ayagala tutambulire wamu. Era yali nange Omuwagguufu Atta-Abalungi bwe yankwata, naye ye yali wa bigere byangu n’adduka; naye kirabika yadduka agende afe, nze ne nkwatibwa ndyoke mbeere mulamu. “Ekyo omuntu ky’alowooza nti kigenderera kutta ddala, Emirundi mingi kye kiwonya mu buzibu obusingayo. Okulabirira kwa Katonda okwo kwennyini okulabika ng’okufa, Emirundi mingi kwe kuwa abeetoowaze obulamu. Nze nnakwatibwa, ye n’awona n’adduka; Emikono egyakyusibwa gyamuwa okufa, nze ne gimpa obulamu.” Awo mu kiseera ekyo Matayo n’Okusaasira ne bafumbiriganwa; era Gaayo n’awa Yakobo, muganda wa Matayo, muwala we Foyibe okuba mukazi we; oluvannyuma lw’ekyo ne beeyongera okubeera mu nnyumba ya Gaayo ennaku nga kkumi, nga bakozesa ebiseera byabwe ng’abatambuze bwe bakola bulijjo. Bwe baali bagenda okusitula, Gaayo n’abafumbira embaga, ne balya ne banywa ne basanyuka. Awo essaawa n’etuuka nga bateekwa okugenda; Omwami Omutima-Omuzira kyeyava asaba okubalirirwa ebyo bye baakozesa. Naye Gaayo n’amugamba nti mu nnyumba ye si mpisa batambuze kusasula olw’okusembezebwa. Abatambuze yabasuzanga ku ndagaano ya mwaka, naye empeera ye yagisuubiranga okuva eri Omusamaliya omulungi, eyamusuubiza nti bw’alikomawo, buli kyonna ky’alibakozesaako alikimuddizaawo n’obwesigwa. Lukka 10:34,35. Awo Omwami Omutima-Omuzira n’amugamba nti, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Omwagalwa, okola ekintu kya bwesigwa buli lw’okolera abooluganda ebirungi na ddala ababeera ku ŋŋendo ne bw’oba tobamanyi. Baategeeza Ekkanisa omukwano gwe wabalaga awamu ne bye wabakolera. Kibeera kirungi singa obasiibuza ekirabo ekiba kisaanidde. 3 Yokaana 5,6. Awo Gaayo n’asiibula bonna, n’abaana be, na ddala Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu. Era n’amuwa eky’okunywa mu kkubo. Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu, bwe baali bafuluma mu mulyango, n’alabika ng’ayagala okusigala emabega. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yakiraba, n’agamba nti, Jangu, Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu, nkwegayiridde genda naffe: nze nnaakukulemberanga, era onooyisibwanga ng’abalala. Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Woowe! Sirina munnange ansaanira. Mmwe mwenna muli ba maanyi era bagumu, naye nze, nga bw’olaba, ndi munafu; kyenva nsalawo okujja emabega, nneme okuba omugugu eri nze kennyini n’eri mmwe olw’obunafu bwange obungi. Ndi, nga bwe nnyogedde, omusajja ow’omwoyo omunafu era ogutalina maanyi, era nja kwesittala ne nnafuwa olw’ebyo abalala bye basobola okugumira. Sijja kwagala kuseka; sijja kwagala byambalo bya kweyoleka; sijja kwagala bibuuzo ebitaliimu nsa. Weewaawo, ndi munafu nnyo ne kiba nti nneesittala olw’ebyo abalala bye balina eddembe okukola. Sinnamanya mazima gonna: ndi mukkiriza atamanyi nnyo. Oluusi bwe mpulira abamu nga basanyukira mu Mukama, kinneeraliikiriza kubanga nze siyinza kukola bwe ntyo. Kiri gye ndi nga bwe kiba eri omunafu mu b’amaanyi, oba omulwadde mu balamu, oba ng’ettaala enyoomebwa; ne kiba nti simanyi kye nkola. “Abantu abali mu ddembe lyabwe batera okusekerera abali mu mitawaana, ng’ebizibu bwe biba ku abo ababa batuuse awazibu.” Yobu 12:5. Omwami Omutima-Omuzira: Naye, ow’oluganda, Omwami Omutima-Omuzira bwe yagamba, nnalagirwa okugumyanga abalimu okutya n’okuyambanga abatalina maanyi. Oteekwa okugenda naffe; tujja kukulindanga; tujja kukuyambanga; tujja kwefiiriza ebintu ebimu, eby’endowooza n’eby’empisa, ku lulwo: tetujja kuyingira mu mpaka ez’ebibuusibwabuusibwa mu maaso go; tujja kufuuka byonna gy’oli, okusinga okukuleka emabega. 1 Basessaloniika 5:14; Abaruumi 14; 1 Abakkolinso 8:9-13; 9:22. Awo, mu kiseera kino kyonna baali ku mulyango gwa Gaayo; era laba, bwe baali bakyali mu bbugumu ly’okwogera kwabwe, Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera n’ayitawo, ng’akutte emiggo gye egy’okwesigamako mu ngalo, era naye yali ku lugendo lw’obutambuze. Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu: Awo Omwami Omwoyo-Omunafu n’amugamba nti, Musajja, wazze otya wano? Kaakano kaakano nnabadde nneemulugunya nti sirina munnange ansaanira, naye ggwe oli nga bwe nnali njagala. Nkwanirizza, nkwanirizza, Omwami Anaatera-Okuwenyera omulungi; nsuubira nti ggwe nange tuyinza okuyambagana.
